title: Goblin Camp
shortDescription: Build a new home for your goblins! Grow your settlement from a little encampment to a bustling city in a beautiful procedurally generated northern forest. Fish, farm, explore the forest and harness the spirits in a unique fantasy citybuilder inspired by Finnish mythology.
fullDescription: In Goblin Camp, you’re in charge of a little band of goblins who want to make a new home for themselves in the middle world. Featuring 60 unique structures, over 100 items and over 80 crafting recipes, as well as 31 unlockable technologies, Goblin Camp has a lot for you to discover! Grow your camp from a collection of shacks and lean-tos into a bustling city of stone, develop new technologies and watch your goblins learn new skills and abilities. Explore a procedurally generated map in a beautiful northern forest: find ruins and resources, use slash-and-burn farming and fertilizers to feed your population, and channel the spring flood with our advanced water simulation. Meet spooky ghosts and the walking dead, use your shaman’s magic to summon spirits to help your goblins in their tasks, and light a bonfire every summer to make your sacrifices to the Keepers of the Woods and Waters. Customize your playing experience with our broad array of customization options, from terrain features and game mechanics to individual enemies, including Peaceful Mode with no combat at all. As your camp grows, the game grows with it: our easy-to-use manager interfaces let you take care of the big picture and free you to focus your attention where you like. Welcome to Goblin Camp!

title: Monster Mop Up
shortDescription: Rescue the scared little Ragamuffins from the human world and clean up all evidence of their existence. Mop stains, burn poop, and get rewarded with high tech gear and upgrades. Save enough, and you can even expand your home, decorate it, and live happily ever after with your fluffy little friends!
fullDescription: Welcome to the Ministry of Monster Concealment! As our newly appointed Custodian, it's your time to shine (literally) and polish every corner while saving your fluffy Ragamuffin friends from the unfamiliar human world. The Ministry appreciates your dedication and your efforts will be rewarded accordingly. You will have opportunities to purchase upgrades, expand your living space, and add charming decorations to your home! FEATURES Ri(n)se and shine! Explore, clean and dispose - leave no trace behind! Restore each of them to their former glory: from tiny homes to banquet halls and medieval hotels! Search and Rescue! These scared, fluffy goofballs are lost in the human world and need your help to return home. Hidden in the most unexpected places, your mission is to find and rescue every last one of them! Provided you can catch them, of course. Upgrade Your Gear! Even the best tools can do with upgrades! Your home is fitted with a shop stocked with upgrades, or discover hidden pickups throughout your adventures to become the Custodian of the Month (or Year, if you’re good enough). Decorate and Expand Your Home! Alongside being a Custodian, you get to be an Architect and Designer! Your home is a sanctuary for you and your little Ragamuffin buddies. Expand your living space and choose from over 150+ furniture and decorative item choices! Create a cozy haven that reflects your style (or lack thereof, as long as you’re happy with it). Poop Scoop! Encounter a variety of unique messes left behind by your fluffy friends, each with its own unique abilities! Handle the Ragamuffins wisely - if mishandled, you’ll have even more poop on your hands. Burn or flush it all away and keep the place tidy! (can add: We hope you aren’t too squeamish) Complete the Monsteropedia! Collect all the Ragamuffins and learn about each one in your very own Monsteropedia! Learn their names, ages, and interests, and enjoy the delightful company of your new fluffy flatmates. Monster Mop Up is inspired by other amazing games: PowerWash Simulator, House Flipper, Viscera Cleanup Detail as well as other amazing simulator games Check them out too if you have not already!

title: Magic Inn
shortDescription: Reclaim glory in Magic Inn, a charming tavern life simulator. Take on the role of an exiled wizard-turned-innkeeper, overseeing everything from menus, rooms, guests, and staff in a fully magical customizable inn. Engage in card battles to spark conversations and foster relationships with guests.
fullDescription: Follow this step-by-step guide to craft a 5-star inn, the epitome of fantasy and magic. 5-star Service Recruit top chefs, or hone your own skills and become one yourself! Forge ties with local farmers for quality ingredients and offer a delectable menu for your guests. A 5-star inn draws royalty and fame, so you must prepare the rarest of items. Build relationships with winemakers, trade with merchants, or search the corners of the world for rare gems. Impress even the King upon his arrival! Pals with Ghosts? Under the moonlight, the sight of pale ghosts may send most people running, but not you. Discover the secrets, master the spell to unlock a world of friendly ghosts. Serve and befriend these charming spirits, and in return, you’ll receive whimsical rewards beyond your imagination. Cheat a little! Friends are an innkeeper’s greatest asset! Making friends is simple: talk to guests, help them, serve well, or even give gifts. Each guest matters. Interact, learn, aim for personalized service, and build lasting relationships. Strong friendships help innkeepers gain resources and referrals from powerful contacts. Easy, right? When the power of friendship may not be enough, there’s nothing wrong with taking a few shortcuts. A 5-star rating is determined by judges disguised as guests. Pay the local detective to reveal the judge's identity, or use money and favors to sway the judge. Keep it discreet: nobody needs to know! Success! Congratulations on achieving the 5-star rating! Success, wealth, friends in high places: you’ve done it all! But now, it’s time to uncover a tale of tragedy, redemption, and of course, magic. With abundant resources in hand and wand, you can shape this magical world. Enjoy the journey! Key Features: Embark on a journey about tragedy and redemption, all starting with a magical humble inn. Manage the menus, staff, and rooms of your completely customizable inn. Learn and harness magic spells in order to help with inn management. Engage in conversation-driving card battles which simulate actions such as negotiation, persuasion, and attraction. Build relationships with guests and members of the inn’s staff. Collect magical creatures and items as you journey through this enchanted universe.

title: Promise Mascot Agency
shortDescription: Explore a cursed Japanese town! Recruit mascot friends and come to the rescue when disaster strikes! Solve the mystery of your exile! Help a living finger work through her many anger issues! Turn Promise Mascot Agency into the best agency in Japan in this open-world narrative adventure!
fullDescription: Welcome to Promise Mascot Agency From the creators of Paradise Killer comes a mind-bending open-world narrative adventure mascot management simulator where mascots are more than just symbols - they’re unpredictable forces of nature! Step into the chaos, unravel the conspiracies, drive a tiny truck and try to keep it all together in Promise Mascot Agency ! Welcome to the Mascot Hustle You thought mascots were just fluffy, innocent brand ambassadors? Think again. The Mascots are all living, breathing, fully formed personalities, with dreams, fears, and the occasional breakdowns of their own- just like us! Whether it’s Trororo , a charming cat who’s a little too obsessed with "adult video" or sweet, silken To-Fu , who can’t stop sobbing, your job is to befriend, mentor, and (hopefully) get these mascots to finish their jobs without causing a major catastrophe. Play Your Cards Right Sending your mascots out to work is never as easy as it sounds. One minute they’re promoting delicious food, the next they’re stuck in a doorway or starting a kitchen inferno. Need help? Good thing Kaso-Machi is full of intrepid everyday heroes ready to lend a hand (if you’ve managed to befriend them, of course). Unlock Hero Cards, featuring Kaso-Machi’s lovable local weirdos like Captain Sign , Japan’s only road-sign superhero (don’t ask questions), or Mama-San , a bar owner with a serious latex collection. These heroes will step in to provide help when your mascots inevitably lose control. Tear Through Town in Your Upgradable Kei Truck Kaso-Machi is a town full of secrets, and Michi isn’t just stuck in an office managing mascots - he’s on the road in his rusty (but upgradeable!) Kei Truck . This nifty little ride may look like a heap of junk, but with a few tweaks, it’ll have nitro boosts , glider wings , and even the ability to launch Pinky☆ - Michi’s maniacal mascot assistant - like a missile . Use your truck to explore the strange, forgotten town, unlock collectibles, and uncover hidden mysteries. Who knew a Kei Truck could be your best friend in a town where literally everything else hates you?! Crime! Drama! A Walking Finger?! Exiled after an ambush that left his clan in shambles, Michi finds himself piecing together the mystery of what really happened, while the town seems to actively conspire against him. Nightmare spirits seem a little too interested in your business, and there’s an ever-present sense that something’s very, very wrong in this place… Buy Now... Or Pinky☆ Will Find You Think you can resist? Think again. The mascots know where you live. Step into the world of Promise Mascot Agency and claim your place in this brave new world of mascot domination.

title: Exotica 2: Pet Shop Simulator
shortDescription: Exotica 2: Pet Shop Simulator is a cozy management game where you design and run your own exotic pet shop. Care for over 70 animals, raise babies, breed rare color variants, customize your store, and manage customers and staff.
fullDescription: Step into Exotica 2: Pet Shop Simulator, where your shop buzzes with life, and every animal is a treasure waiting to be discovered. Grow your business by choosing which creatures to buy, breed, and sell, then reinvest your earnings to watch your cozy store flourish at your own rhythm. Enjoy a warm, sim-lite adventure where running your pet shop is all about gentle progress, delightful animal encounters, and business growth without any pressure or confusing systems. Run a Real Pet Shop Business Begin with a humble shop and shape its future with every decision you make. Choose your animals, plan your breeding, and set your prices as you welcome customers and watch your profits grow. Each step forward feels satisfying and unrushed, letting your business blossom in its own time. Animals - The Heart of Your Shop Animals are the soul of your shop. Nurture them from tiny babies, discover new breeds, and share your favorites with eager customers. As you grow, you meet over 70 unique species, including rare and eye-catching variants that make your store truly special. Pick animals up, hold them, carry them around the shop, and place them in habitats! Breeding & Hatching Breeding is a natural part of your journey. Pair animals, hatch eggs, and discover rare color or pattern variants over time. Some animals become more special as they grow, giving you exciting moments of discovery and long-term goals. Build and Customize Your Store Shape your pet shop into a space that feels truly yours. Arrange walls, floors, and decorations, tweak lighting and signs, and fill every corner with personality. Watch as your animals explore their surroundings, bringing your unique vision to life. Customers, Staff, and Automation Customers have different personalities and don’t always accept your suggestions. Handle sales yourself, or hire employees to handle daily tasks such as cashiering, animal care, cleaning, and stock transfers. Each employee has strengths and weaknesses, letting you automate routine work and focus on growth. Game Features: Build and run your own exotic pet shop while growing a lively business. Design your shop freely by shaping the layout, structures, and decorations. Customize your shop with a wide range of textures and lighting options. Unlock over 70 animal species, from cats and dogs to reptiles, birds, and fish. Watch animals roam freely around your shop, bringing it to life. Breed animals in real time and discover rare color or pattern variations. Feed animals, clean habitats, maintain spaces, and provide enrichment. Manage aquariums easily with automatic water filling and draining. Meet customers with different personalities and reactions. Use the cash register, handle payments, and review purchase summaries. Hire employees with unique strengths, weaknesses, and animal phobias. Earn star points to unlock new animals, items, and objects.

title: Platypus Reclayed
shortDescription: 22 years after its first appearance, the iconic Platypus is coming back, featuring updated gameplay, new weapons and additional content. Get ready to dive into the heart-pounding action of this fast, frantic, and incredibly fun arcade-style shoot-em-up!
fullDescription: Reclaimed. Remade. Reclayed. The Legendary Platypus Returns! 22 years after its first appearance, the iconic indie shoot ‘em up Platypus is coming back, better than ever! Led by the original creator Anthony Flack, alongside the talented Claymatic team, we're embarking on a journey to bring the beloved classic into the present. Platypus Reclayed isn't just a simple remaster—it's a complete revamp. Reprogrammed from scratch and updated for modern hardware, with all-new models and artwork photographed in 4k widescreen, featuring updated gameplay, new weapons and additional content. Get ready to dive into the heart-pounding action of this fast, frantic, and incredibly fun arcade-style shoot-em-up! Colossatropolis: A City in Chaos The once-thriving metropolis of Colossatropolis is now bursting at the seams. Towering skyscrapers dominate the skyline, while pollution chokes the air - and parking is a nightmare. Desperate times call for desperate measures, and Colossatropolis sets its sights on neighbouring Mungola for expansion. But little do they know, Mungola isn't going down without a fight... The Legendary F-27 "Platypus" Takes Flight In the heart of Mungola, a single squadron of fighter planes stands as the last line of defence—the legendary F-27 "Platypus". Despite their age, these antique aircraft are the Mungolan people's last hope for freedom. Are you ready to pilot the Platypus and take on the mighty Colossatropolan battle fleet? The original handmade shooter! Features That Will Keep You Coming Back for More Two-Player Simultaneous Action: Team up with a friend for double the fun! Stunning Claymation Graphics: Experience the beauty of claymation like never before with all-new high definition artwork. Addictive, Exciting Gameplay: Get ready for heart-pounding action that will keep you on the edge of your seat. title: GIRLS MADE PUDDING
shortDescription: "When there's nobody there to see you, you disappear." In Girls Made Pudding, two girls tour a series of towns that people have disappeared from.
fullDescription: "When there's nobody there to see you, you disappear." In Girls Made Pudding, two girls tour a series of towns that people have disappeared from. Follow them on the road as they find out the mysteries of this world. The Gameplay Come for a Ride In most games, you're always trying to reach a destination. In Girls Made Pudding, everything happens during the journey. Nothing will happen if you stay where you are, and the more you travel, the more dialogue you'll get. Keep the bike moving and the girls chatting and eventually you'll unfold this story's mysteries. Gathering and Cooking While you're traveling, you'll find ingredients that you can cook with. Eating those dishes will lead to new dialogue branches for the two girls. Try cooking whatever fits the mood of the story in that moment. Hunger and Sleeping As they travel, the girls slowly get hungrier. Make sure to keep them fed. However, you can turn off the hunger mechanic in the difficulty settings. Also, after a while, night will fall, ending your journey for they day. You'll need to find an empty home to sleep until morning. The Story "When there's nobody there to see you, you disappear." It's weird, but it's been like this for a while now. Almost half a year. The journey started with Sumibi's wish—"I want to eat that pudding again." She and Nikomi go on a bike trip, traveling from town to town while looking for ingredients and meeting new people. Little by little, they start understanding what happened to the world. They keep traveling and they keep looking at each other... lest they disappear. The Characters Sumibi A bike-riding girl on a journey. She was a regular at the café where Sumibi use to work. Nikomi A girl traveling along with Sumibi. She used to work at a café but she's not very good at baking and cooking. shortDescription: GONE Fishing is a 1-8 player survival horror game where you and your friends must work together to stay alive, by fishing. fullDescription: Welcome to Gone Fishing , a  1-8 player co-op horror game where players must fish together to satisfy the hunger of an ancient lake monster's never-ending hunger before each night falls. Cast your line, catch fish, and gather bait. But beneath the surface, something stirs and it's getting hungry... Only a full offering can delay the inevitable. Key Features: Immersive Fishing System: Catch a variety of fish species, each with unique behaviors, fight patterns, and sizes. Dynamic Bait Collection: Hunt for live bait, frogs, worms, spiders, and bats, that each react differently to your presence. Atmospheric Horror: Peaceful days turn into tense nights as the monster grows more aggressive with each failed offering. Co-Op Survival: Coordinate with your team to gather, fish, and survive, or risk being dragged into the lake one by one. Balloon Merchant: A mysterious trader floats in at midday, offering upgrades and totems that may be the difference between survival and doom. Gone Fishing blends the calm of fishing with the creeping dread of survival horror. Feed the lake monster… or become its next feast. How To Play Gather Bait from the surrounding landscape. Bait lets you catch bigger fish, and big fish like big bait. Pressing TAB, or whatever inventory button you’ve chosen, will allow you to equip the bait once caught. Go Fishing in the lake. Hold LMB to cast your line. When you get a bite, click LMB at the right moment to set the hook. If your timing is off, the fish becomes harder to reel in. Hold LMB to reel it in, but be careful—too much tension and the line snaps, too little and the fish escapes! Sacrifice Fish To The Lake Monster by dropping the fish in the altar with ‘G’ or your drop key! Or drop your fish in the Hot Air Balloon Trader’s basket to earn money for Upgrades and Totems! title: Devil Spire Falls

fullDescription: Devil Spire Falls is a procedurally generated, open-world, hardcore action-RPG built around dynamic and interconnected systems and mechanics. The first Devil Spire fell. Now the rest of the world is next Create your own unique character and delve into this dark fantasy world where the actions of heroes past caused the first Devil Spire to fall, and spread an accursed fog throughout the land... And the monsters that lurked within. A whole world to explore and conquer Explore the overworld, conquer dungeons, become the town hero, raze every village to the ground, hunt monsters, slay bosses, slaughter bandits or nomad camps, kill that merchant, run away, build your own home, gather your party, go on quests, farm, fish, mine, hunt, tame... The possibilities are endless! True freedom to do whatever you want In this world where nothing is predetermined... Everything is permitted. No character is so important it can't be killed. No dungeon is made to be an easy or even fair challenge. No obstacle can't be smartly circumvented or brute-forced through. You will enter a world of its own, unconcerned with your well-being, and unprotected against your machinations! And of course, your choices are permanent, and they matter. Featuring Fully customizeable character creation, including facial features, with several Races, Classes and Origins, backed by a deep, real RPG system with 7 attributes, skills, perks, equipment, magic and more! 18 unique weapon classes with their own special properties! From swords to flails, from bows to muskets, and from throwing knifes to javelins. You're sure to find one that suits your tastes! Or just use your own fists and feet! 35 Skills with 9 Perks each! Unlock special attacks, acquire new actions, get rid of limiters, learn how to craft mighty weapons, build your own house, double-jump, or simply unlock a door and disarm traps, etc. With enough training, your powers will know no limits! Create your own spells with over 100 effects, from buffing to burning, invisibility to telekinesis, shrinking to transforming... You must use every tool at your disposal to outmaneuver your enemies, conserve your stamina, leave them stunned and confused, and emerge victorious! Physics and environmental shenanigans: Throw items at enemies, kick them off cliffs, build your own bridges and stairs, sneak past them while snuffing out lights, use the traps and whatever else is around you to come out on top! The Urge to conquer a newly risen Devil Spire does not leave your mind. Will you repeat the errors of the past, discover the truths behind the massive towers, or simply take their power as your own? fullDescription: Your terrarium awaits! Grab your flashlight and embark on a delightful journey to create a new home for tiny, fascinating creatures. Fill your terrarium with a variety of insects. Take on the role of a caretaker, ensuring your little companions are well-fed. Let your quests and journal guide your progression. Earn coins and unlock new insects by completing missions. Purchase upgrades to make the hunt phase a breeze. The game has a lot of Steam achievements for you to unlock. We value your time, so every achievement is designed to be fun and attainable. No endless grinding required! Tailor the game to your preferences or abilities: You can adjust the time limit and light radius of your torchlight.   All you need is a mouse or trackpad. Sit back, relax, and enjoy! If you focus on the main quests and journal, you can complete the game in a single session. What you do in The Night Crawler : The hunt: Click to collect insects during night hunt phases, you can only see around your mouse! The house: Learn facts about your discoveries; manage your creatures' appetite by feeding them; complete quests and earn money to buy food and gear. The Night Crawler does not offer: A simulation. Exploration or movement: it’s a mouse only game! Hours of gameplay: It’s a tiny game, fully finishable in under an hour.

title: Cafe Cafe: Idle Bird Collector
shortDescription: A charming and cozy idle game that sits anywhere on your screen, where you'll befriend your very own flock of adorable birds. Serve delicious snacks, discover each bird's unique preferences, and watch your cafe flourish!
fullDescription: Oh, you're the new manager? Pleased to meet you! Chirp!~ Let's work together on making our very own cafe, where all of our bird friends can come relax, enjoy tasty snacks and have a great time! Can you help me figure out every bird's favorite snacks? Learn recipes: Grow your menu selection over time by re-investing your earnings into more profitable snacks and drinks. From matcha lattes to strawberry shortcakes, help Chef Cafe become the best at their craft! Stock up on food: Keep a steady supply of food at the ready, so that your bird friends can keep ordering to their heart's content! Invite your bird friends: When everything is ready, send your invitations and watch your hard work pay off as your friends enjoy the wonderful snacks and drinks you've prepared for them! Cafe Cafe features a gacha system with  NO micro-transactions  whatsoever, so you can enjoy fun surprises completely stress-free! All of the meals you serve both grant you coins  (which you can use to progress through the game) and gems  (which you can use for the gacha). Befriend a varied and colorful cast of adorable birds and dress them up with cute accessories and outfits, all through this cozy take on gacha mechanics ! KEY FEATURES Idle Gameplay:  stock up on food and send out your invitations, then watch as your birds place their orders and eat at their own pace Adorable Bird Friends:  collect a variety of charming birds, and dress them up with adorable outfits and accessories Gacha with NO micro-transactions:  experience the thrill of gacha without spending any additional money! title: King's Lynn Leisure Farm
shortDescription: King's Lynn Leisure Farm is a farm idle game with racing driver theme. Here, you can collect a variety of cute animals, play with them, feed them, and send them out to work. You can also collect various vehicles to decorate your farm. Enjoy your time on the farm with your little animal friends!
fullDescription: This game is a PC port of the web-based "King's Lynn Leisure Farm". Save data is shared and the game is permanently free. If you discovered this game through a Steam recommendation, here's something you should know: this is a fan game designed for F1 fans. We're not saying you can't play this game if you're not an F1 fan — but if you're part of the F1 fan community, or you know some of the drivers, or you're familiar with some racing memes, you'll have a much better experience here. We welcome you to learn more about this motorsport full of passion and dreams! King's Lynn Leisure Farm is a farm simulation idle game where you'll collect various animals, play with them, feed them, and send them out to work. You can also collect different vehicles to decorate your farm. Spend quality time on the farm with the animals! The farm boasts over 30 collectible animals! Servals, bubble fish, frogs, koalas…  Each has its own unique preferences and personality. You'll search for their favorite foods, teach them to talk, and buy them various special outfits. Grow alongside them! Animals can form bonds with each other, and they can mate and lay eggs! After hatching, the eggs can give you a variety of amazing vehicles. Scooters, tractors, race cars, rockets, champagne, trophies… the farm offers up to 80 different vehicles. Your animals can ride these vehicles, each with unique appearances and animations. Come collect all the fantastic vehicles! The farm also features whimsical fairy-tale adventure stories starring your animals. Completing these stories unlocks corresponding fairy-tale costumes. During their free time, animals can also play padel to strengthen their bonds. You can assign the right animals to various jobs to earn money, which can be used to decorate your farm as you like… You’re in for a relaxing and joyful experience!

title: In Trusted Hands
shortDescription: Dive into the daily work of a cozy workshop in a big city, accompanied by relaxing atmospheric music. Manage client data, balance energy and stress, and make choices that shape the story and its outcome.
fullDescription: In Trusted Hands is a narrative-driven repair shop simulator where fixing phones turns dealing with people’s private lives. Messages, photos, and hidden files can surface during repairs, placing you in the middle of secrets you were never meant to see. As the story unfolds, customers with complicated pasts cross your path, and strangers with unclear motives begin asking for information in exchange for money. Every decision matters — what you share, what you hide, and who you choose to help can change lives, shape the city, and affect your own future. You run a small phone repair shop under constant pressure: exhaustion, stress, rent, and inspections are part of daily life. The repair process is intentionally simple, keeping the focus on moral choices, relationships, and long-term consequences rather than technical complexity.

title: D.E.C.A.Y.
shortDescription: Survive 365 days to earn absolute freedom. Become the operator of a remote D.E.C.A.Y. bunker, explore the scorched sectors of the United States with your robot companion, gather resources, and maintain the Atlas network in hardcore VR, where order is a matter of choice.
fullDescription: The world collapsed after a nuclear war. Cities were reduced to ruins, roads vanished beneath the ash, and the territory of the former United States was divided into scorched, deadly sectors. From the ruins of the old world emerged D.E.C.A.Y. - the Department of Environmental Control and Yield . Officially, it is an agency responsible for distributing what remains of vital supplies. In reality, it is a cynical, ruthless, and final force struggling to maintain control over a dying planet. You are the operator of a remote bunker designated “Facility 16”. You signed a contract with the organization for exactly 365 days. One year of autonomous service under total isolation and extreme risk in exchange for a single reward - absolute freedom. Provided, of course, that you survive long enough to receive your final settlement. Key Features: Your bunker is your fortress and your workplace. Maintain life-support systems, repair equipment at workbenches, calibrate the neuro-sensory modules of your personal PDA, and keep track of your supplies. Every new 24-hour cycle changes the balance of threats and available resources on the surface. The sky is under your control. Your primary duty is to maintain the A.C.C.S. “Atlas” surface network. These massive installations sustain a radiation and thermal shield over the region, preventing the sun from scorching the surface. Monitor the power grid from the bunker’s main terminal, venture outside, locate expensive nuclear batteries, and perform “hot” replacements. Remember: the shutdown of even a single node immediately redistributes the load, causing neighboring Atlas units to drain several times faster. A loyal mechanical companion. You have access to a specialized search bot capable of accompanying you on the surface and assisting during dangerous expeditions. Only its built-in sensors and manipulators can detect emissions from the rifts, scan them, and safely extract valuable post-nuclear modifiers. Protect the bot while it works - without it, you may return to the bunker empty-handed. The treasures and curses of the rifts. The crystalline modifiers recovered by your bot provide powerful advantages, but many also carry dangerous side effects. Install a stable “Amber Heart” in your suit to slightly increase your health, or risk using the blazing “Death Stone,” capable of devastating your body’s protective systems. You can also surrender the dangerous mineral to the Department, which uses its destructive energy to manufacture heavy special-purpose ammunition. Wasteland politics. Not everyone agrees with the Department’s methods. Beyond the sealed bunker doors, you will face raiders, feral mutants, and soldiers of the high-tech faction known as “Legacy.” When their heavily armored enforcers, the “Judges,” arrive in your sector, you will need to use your entire tactical arsenal to survive. Hardcore VR immersion. Experience realistic environmental interaction and authentic shooting physics. The game features 32 weapons - from assault and sniper rifles to pistols, heavy fire axes, and baseball bats. Discover deeply detailed weapon mechanics: for example, the heavy M88 “Hunter” carbine requires you to manually rotate the bolt handle and pull it back after every powerful shot. As you complete more directives, one thing becomes increasingly clear: the orders issued by your superiors do not always match the reality on the ground. Eventually, you will have to decide whose contracts to accept and what order truly means to you. You have no squad. No permanent support. No safe zones. There is only you... Your search bot... Your bunker... And the countdown to freedom...

title: Monstergirl Hunters
shortDescription: A citybuilder where you collect your citizens. Capture monstergirls, craft their gear, and enact laws to turn them into compliant workers or fighters. Grow your colonies across 12 islands to fulfill the unique needs of your monstergirls. Or turn them all into unpaid interns and go humanity first.
fullDescription: You have been sent to colonize a string of islands infested with a wide variety of monstergirls. While these monstergirls are aggressive and must be pacified, they also serve as a source of labor and produce unique goods, so you'll need them to build your cities. Capture Monstergirls Every monstergirl is an individual with her own stats, genes, and productivity. Your monstergirls need to be housed, geared up, and put to work to create the goods your colony needs. You can also enlist them into your party to help pacify and capture more monstergirls Build Massive Cities Your islands can have hundreds of monstergirls, but to upgrade them you have to fulfill their needs. All monstergirls are different: Alraune eat fruits; Ratkin eat cheese; Harpies eat eggs.And that's only the first stage, as your population gets more diverse and demanding, you have to navigate a complex web of production chains to keep everybody happy. Enact Laws As you house more monstergirls, or sell them off to the empire, you'll have to decide whether to tolerate or oppress them. Or maybe you only dislike Spidergirls, and have no problem tolerating all other races. Each law has unique effects and bonuses, leading to (at least) two completely different playthroughs. You can try getting a nine-tailed Foxgirl with tolerance, or cage Harpies and turn them into moveable jukeboxes that buff nearby workplaces. Craft Equipment Use your colony's production output to craft gear for your monstergirls to increase your colony's production output to craft even more gear for the monstergirls you capture to craft even more gear. Equally, monstergirls can be trained to become better workers, fighters, or just look more visually appealing. And all of this can of course be automated, to create the perfect workers from the moment they hatch. Embrace Genomics When two monstergirls like eachother very much, they hug for a long time, and a new monstergirl is created with a selection of genes from both. By carefully deciding how to hug and with which gifts, you can further improve these genes and create the ultimate monstergirl. Build the Ultimate Monstergirl Empire There are 12 hand-crafted islands to settle each with unique effects and resources. They can trade with eachother, allowing for small specialist colonies optimized for productivity or large metropolitan islands filled with hundreds of needy nobles.

title: Lepidarium
shortDescription: Relax and collect hundreds of unique butterflies and moths in this cozy idle game. Watch caterpillars transform from larva to chrysalis to winged beauty, customize lush greenhouses, and discover rare species from monarchs to atlas moths.
fullDescription: Welcome to Lepidarium — your personal butterfly and moth sanctuary built from sun-dappled leaves, blooming flowers, and quiet glass walls. Discover, care for, and raise hundreds of unique winged species across beautifully crafted greenhouses. With a single click, your butterflies leave the greenhouse and flutter freely across your real desktop — gentle, transparent companions drifting over your windows while you work, study, or browse. They never get in the way: clicks pass right through them, and a tap of ESC sends them home. Your living collection, alive on your screen. Build the ultimate lepidoptera library. Each species is assigned one of seven rarity tiers — from Common to Ancient. Unlock stunning visual variants: Normal, Painted, Golden, and Rainbow. Complete your collection and discover species you've never seen before, from delicate monarchs to majestic atlas moths. Witness nature's greatest transformation in real time. Feed tiny caterpillars and watch them spin silk cocoons. Hold your breath as chrysalises crack open and brand-new wings emerge. Release them for instant rewards, or keep them in your greenhouse for steady passive income. Every decision shapes your strategy. Your greenhouse keeps flourishing in the background while you work, study, or browse the web. The automatic feeding system keeps your caterpillars and butterflies happy and fed; when you return, gathered rewards are waiting. No pressure, no timers — just progress at your own pace. Choose from plants, feeding stations, perch branches, and day-night lighting cycles. Customize multiple greenhouses exactly the way you want. Build a cozy cottage garden, or a humid rainforest canopy — this is your sanctuary, your rules. Climb the rankings by total collection value or by the number of unique species you've discovered. See how your greenhouse measures up against butterfly keepers worldwide.

title: Soulbound: Online
shortDescription: Soulbound is a pixel-art action roguelite with an MMORPG overworld. Run fast-paced bullet-heaven dungeons solo or in 3-player co-op, raid bosses, craft gear from your loot, and build out your personal base. Join thousands of players in the quest to explore, trade, and build a new world.
fullDescription: Fight Together. Die Together. Loot Forever. Soulbound is a pixel-art action-MMO where every dungeon run reshapes your build. Charge into roguelite dungeons with friends in 3-player co-op, chain devastating ability combos from 100+ combinations, and return to a living open world where you farm, craft, and uncover a mystery that runs deeper than any dungeon floor. A New Take On The MMO: Where Every Dungeon Run Is Different Soulbound splits its world in two: a shared overworld full of quests and adventure, and brutal instanced dungeons that never play the same way twice. Every floor reshuffles encounters, hazards, and loot and every room unlocks new relics that warp your abilities in ways you didn't plan for. This is a one of a kind MMO-meets-roguelite hybrid that fuses our favourite meta progression systems with the chaos of survivor-like combat. 100+ Ability and Relic Combos To Build Out Enter the dungeon and pick from 10+ abilities that create unique class builds with branching relic paths. Stack a chain-lightning relic on your mage's Pyrosphere and watch mobs evaporate. Layer life-steal onto a berserker's hammer and turn your AoE into a heal for your party. Every relic run offers new synergies you've never tried, and the best builds are the ones nobody planned. As you swap your gear, you swap your class instantly. Tank for your friends on Monday, rain bullets on Thursday, your character is every class you want it to be, whenever you want it to be. Explore A Huge, Shared Open World With Friends  Step out of the dungeon and the pace shifts. Soulbound's open world is a shared space where thousands of players farm, gather, trade, and quest side by side. Tend your crops, fish a quiet river or stumble into a quest line that unlocks an ability you didn't know existed. The overworld is where you discover the skills and upgrades that make your next dungeon run deadly. Every life skill feeds back into your progression with cooking restoring stamina, gathering unlocking crafting materials for gear and buffs and mining unlocking crafting stations to build the weapons that defines your class. Customise Your Character With Hundreds of Gear Pieces and Thousands of Looks Gear in Soulbound does two things: makes you powerful and makes you you. Separate cosmetic slots mean your stats never dictate your style as you collect handmade, uniquely animated pixel-art armor sets, rare cosmetic drops, and companion pets. Mix and match freely and make your character look exactly how you want. Build Your Home, Tend To Your Farm and Level Up Your Stations Every player gets their own base, and it's where your meta progression lives. Inside it, you construct and upgrade stations that unlock new gear tiers, potions that tip dungeon runs in your favor, and meals that push your stamina further. Decorate every room with furniture, trophies, and a full room-layout editor. Invite your friends and start building your guild base. Something Is Wrong With This Lore Rich World You awaken inside a digital universe that feels alive… but hostile. Early in your journey, you encounter The Anima , enigmatic and malevolent entities that overwhelm you with impossible force. Death isn’t the end, however. You’re recovered by a robotic rescuer and brought to your Virelda, a safe haven, workshop, and base of operations. As a Pioneer, you’ve got a lot to do before you can stand against The Anima. Key Features MMO × Roguelite hybrid: Persistent character progression meets instanced dungeons. 10+ distinct ability classes with branching relic paths (100+ unique build combos per run). Classless character progression, try a new build anytime. 3-player co-op dungeons and 5+ player raids. Handmade pixel-art world. Deep crafting ecosystem, grow crops, upgrade stations, cook food, forge gear, brew potions. Full player housing that you can build, upgrade, and decorate with a room-layout editor. Separate cosmetic system with hundreds of gear pieces and cosmetic slots. Mystery-driven narrative, uncover the truth behind the Anima through environmental storytelling. Built for long-term play with live events, seasonal content content, new dungeon tiers, and expanding world zones. Wishlist now and get notified when the game enters Early-Access!

fullDescription: Welcome to Reptilarium — your personal reptile sanctuary built from humid leaves, sun-warmed stones, and quiet glass walls. Discover, care for, and grow hundreds of unique reptile species across beautifully crafted terrariums. Bring Your Reptiles to Your Desktop With a single click, your reptiles leave the terrarium and roam freely across your real desktop — calm, transparent companions wandering over your windows while you work, study, or browse. They never get in the way: clicks pass right through them, and a tap of ESC sends them home. Your living collection, alive on your screen. Collect Hundreds of Unique Reptile Species Build the ultimate reptile library. Each species is assigned one of seven rarity tiers — from Common to Ancient. Unlock stunning visual variants: Normal, Painted, Golden, and Rainbow. Complete your collection and discover species you've never seen before, from tiny geckos to majestic chameleons. Watch Eggs Hatch and Babies Grow Witness the wonder of life as eggs crack open and tiny hatchlings emerge. Watch them grow into magnificent adults in real time. Release them for instant rewards, or keep them in your terrarium for steady passive income. Every decision shapes your strategy. Earn While You're Away Your terrarium keeps growing in the background while you work, study, or browse the web. The automatic feeding system keeps your reptiles happy and fed; when you return, gathered rewards are waiting. No pressure, no timers — just progress at your own pace. Design Your Dream Terrariums Choose from background themes, lighting, decorations, and day-night settings. Customize multiple terrariums exactly the way you want. Keep them lush and tropical, or stark and desert-bright — this is your sanctuary, your rules. Compete on Global Leaderboards Climb the rankings by total collection value or by the number of unique species you've discovered. See how your sanctuary measures up against reptile keepers worldwide.

title: Stonewards
shortDescription: DWARF COMBAT! Stonewards is a 1-4 player co-op first-person roguelite defense game. Lead a crew of stubborn dwarves from your base camp to aid nearby kingdoms, mine deep for resources, forge powerful upgrades, and hold the line against relentless monster attacks.
fullDescription: DWARF COMBAT! Grab your pickaxe. Tighten your beard. Try not to blow up the kingdom. Stonewards is a solo and 1-4 player co-op first-person roguelite defense game where a band of battle-ready dwarves leaves their base camp to answer distress calls from nearby dwarven kingdoms. Each mission sends you to a threatened stronghold on the edge of disaster. Your job is simple: dig fast, forge smart, and defend like your beard depends on it. Monsters are coming. The walls are cracking. The horn is about to sound. DIG After each wave, rush into procedurally generated mines to gather precious metals, rare materials, and whatever shiny rocks look important enough to steal. Explore twisting tunnels, uncover hidden caves, and haul your loot back before the next attack begins. Take too long, and your friends will be defending the kingdom one dwarf short. And yes, they will complain about it. FORGE A dwarf without a forge is just an angry short man with excellent facial hair. Between waves, spend your mined resources to craft arrows, repair defenses, and unlock randomized upgrades. Stack raw strength, strange powers, tougher walls, or trust your team’s latest “brilliant” plan. Nothing could possibly go wrong. DEFEND The monsters have one goal: breach the stronghold and bring the kingdom down. Hold the walls, cover the gates, coordinate with your crew, and use every crafted tool at your disposal. When the enemy pushes through your outer defenses, fall back, regroup, and remind them why attacking a dwarven stronghold was a terrible idea. If the kingdom falls, the mission is over. If you survive, drink later. Dig now. FEATURES 1-4 Player Co-op & Solo -  Rally the crew or go full lone-dwarf. Whether you fight alone or with up to three friends, the monsters are coming either way. Answer the Call of the Dwarven Kingdoms -  Travel from your base camp to defend nearby dwarven realms against incoming monster attacks. Each mission is a desperate stand for survival. Mine the Mountain -  When the wave ends, the clock starts. Dive into procedural mines, gather valuable resources, and get back before the next horn sounds. Stockpile & Forge -  Bring your loot back to craft arrows, repair walls, and unlock randomized roguelite upgrades that shape each run. Hold the Line -  Take your place on the walls, defend the stronghold, and stop the horde before they overwhelm the kingdom. Dig Deep. Forge Hard. Defend Harder.

title: Gaming Burnout Treatment Center
shortDescription: Digital ED Treatment Center is a random launcher for players in a gaming slump. We help you rediscover the joy of play and unearth hidden gems buried in your library. Click to start your treatment and reignite your gaming vigor!
fullDescription: Gaming ED Treatment Center Gaming ED Treatment Center is a randomized game launcher specifically designed for players suffering from "Backlog Paralysis"—those who own a mountain of games but have lost the spark to actually play any of them. Our mission? To dive deep into your dusty Steam library, unearth those "hidden gems" you bought during a 90% off sale and forgot existed, and help you rediscover your gaming vigor! We know the truth: often, it’s not that the games aren’t good—it’s the mental exhaustion of Choice Overload . Feeling "Drained"? "Thousands of games in the library, yet I’m browsing the store for more. I spend thirty minutes scrolling through my search bar, only to give up and go to sleep." If this sounds like you, we have bad news: you are in the mid-to-late stages of "Digital ED." Welcome to the Digital ED Treatment Center. It’s time for your recovery. Start Your Treatment Immediately! Comprehensive Diagnosis: We perform a deep dive into your Steam library and play-time analytics to find the buried treasure in your collection. Rapid Therapy: Stop overthinking! Click "Start Treatment" and let the Hand of Fate pick the forgotten masterpiece you’re playing tonight. Surprise Check-ups: Did you pull a game you bought three years ago and never even installed? Congratulations—that might just be your next Game of the Year! Customized Prescriptions: Filter by installation status and more. Choose between a "Gentle Routine" or the highly effective "Shock Therapy." We have a mode for every patient. Minimalist UI: No social media clutter, no distractions. Just you, your library, and the button that decides your destiny. Customized Analysis Report: Generates an exclusive gamer personality analysis report based on the contents of your game library! Note: This product is not a substitute for actual medical advice. Common side effects include, but are not limited to: sleep deprivation, sudden bursts of excitement, a massive spike in your electricity bill, and potential hardware overheating.

title: Elite Dangerous
shortDescription: Take control of your own starship and blaze your trail in an ever-changing galaxy. Master the arts of combat, mining and trade or venture out into the unknown across a 1:1 scale universe.
fullDescription: Discover the next chapter of the legendary Elite saga. Elite Dangerous is the definitive massively multiplayer space epic, bringing gaming’s original 1984 open world adventure to the modern generation with a seamless, connected galaxy, a player‑shaped evolving narrative, and the entire Milky Way recreated at full galactic scale.  Against this vast backdrop, take to the stars in your own starship and do whatever it takes to survive in an ever-changing futuristic galactic sandbox. Acquire wealth and power, develop your skills and knowledge, and earn the right to stand tall among the ranks of the iconic Elite.  In an age of galactic superpowers and interstellar war, your story influences the connected experience and handcrafted evolving narrative. From discovering new worlds, to exhilarating space combat and a fully-realised economy for trade, the galaxy is waiting.  The 400-billion star systems of the Milky Way form the vast and dynamic stage for Elite Dangerous' open-ended gameplay. Constructed using real astronomical data, the stars, planets, moons, asteroid belts, and black holes of our galaxy are rendered at true galactic scale. Chart a course through star systems never before visited by other Commanders and explore the surface of strange and unfamiliar worlds with a Surface Recon Vehicle.  Over 35 distinct spacecraft are ready for you to command, from lightweight exploration vessels to gigantic behemoths ready for battle. Build a diverse collection of ships and outfit them to match your playstyle. Customise every component, weapon and optional module to enhance and alter your ships’ capabilities.    Hunt, explore, fight, mine, smuggle and trade across the galaxy. Forge your path solo or with up to three friends in a Wing. Join a Squadron full of like-minded Commanders and share the highs and lows of your interstellar adventures together.  With the System Colonisation mechanic, the power to claim and expand your very own star systems is in your hands. Whether creating a thriving new economy, a bustling trade hub, or a new port of operations, the galaxy awaits your vision.  The Elite Dangerous galaxy revolves around players’ actions. In an age of galactic superpowers and interstellar war, every player’s personal story influences the space simulation and handcrafted, evolving narrative.  Co-operate with fellow Commanders in pivotal Community Goal events that can permanently alter the state of the galaxy, earning exclusive rewards and recognition for your contribution in the process.   Align with a galactic superpower and alter the interstellar landscape with Powerplay. Support your power or undermine a rival through a variety of means, from hacking starport advertisements to attacking gigantic Stronghold Carriers. Every contribution matters.  Experience unpredictable encounters with other players in a vast, massively multiplayer space. Experience the connected galaxy alone in Solo mode or with players across the world in Open Play, where every pilot you face could become a trusted ally or your deadliest enemy.   The universe of Elite Dangerous continues to grow and expand with new features and content. Regular major updates provide new opportunities and gameplay for you to discover and change the way you play.

title: Tetris® Effect: Connected
shortDescription: Tetris® Effect: Connected adds an all-new robust multiplayer expansion to the huge variety of addictive and innovative single-player modes that Tetris Effect is known for, with all-new co-op and competitive online and local multiplayer modes!
fullDescription: Tetris® Effect: Connected is Tetris like you've never seen it, or heard it, or felt it before—an incredibly addictive, unique, and breathtakingly gorgeous reinvention of one of the most popular puzzle games of all time, from the people who brought you the award-winning Rez Infinite and legendary puzzle game Lumines. Music, backgrounds, sounds, special effects—everything, down to the Tetriminos themselves—pulse, dance, shimmer, and explode in perfect sync with how you're playing, making any of the game's 30+ stages and 10+ modes something you'll want to experience over and over again. Plus cross-platform multiplayer modes for competitive and cooperative play! An exhilarating single-player experience full of surprises. Over 30 different stages, each with its own music, sound effects, graphical style and background that all evolve and change as you play through them. Enter the Zone, a mechanic unique to Tetris Effect: Connected Players can stop time (and Tetriminos falling) by entering “the Zone” and either get out of a sticky situation that could otherwise lead to “Game Over,” or rack up extra Line Clears for bonus rewards. Cross-platform multiplayer lets you play with players from all over the world! Players on different platforms can easily join Friend Match rooms with the Room ID feature. title: Alaska Gold Fever
shortDescription: Step into the role of a gold prospector during the Alaskan gold rush and build your own empire from scratch. Mine resources, refine different forms of gold, and upgrade your tools to increase efficiency. Explore diverse mines, survive the harsh climate, and complete engaging story and side quests!
fullDescription: Mine Gold Like During the Real Gold Rush! Experience a gold mining process inspired by historical methods from the gold rush era. Break rocks, collect ore, and separate gold from the soil using various tools and machines. Then smelt it into gold bars that you can sell at the bank. During the game you will find different forms of gold: gold dust gold flakes gold nuggets Each type has a different value and requires the proper refining process. As you progress through the game, you will unlock better tools and mining techniques. A System of Mines to Discover In the game you can discover and explore a total of 9 mines. 5 small mines for quick expeditions 3 medium mines with branching tunnels 1 large multi-level mine Each mine has its own unique atmosphere and several to dozens of segments to discover. Working in a mine is dangerous. If you do not place supports correctly, tunnels may collapse. Build reinforcement structures, expand your infrastructure, and explore deeper underground. Upgrade Tools and Equipment Your tools determine how fast and efficiently you can mine gold. Create upgraded versions of your equipment and enhance them using rare materials and gemstones. Possible upgrades include: increased tool durability faster resource extraction ability to break harder rock additional equipment upgrades Alaska, 1896 – A Rich Storyline Thousands of people arrive in northern America in search of fortune. Most will return empty-handed. Only a few will make history. Maybe you will be one of them. In Alaska Gold Fever you start as an ordinary gold prospector with simple tools and a big dream. Explore the wild lands of Alaska, mine gold, hunt, develop your businesses, and build an empire at the edge of 19th-century civilization. In the game you can expect many interesting and engaging storylines as well as unusual characters, such as the Pastor. A large number of fascinating stories and quests await you. The game offers: a main storyline side quests hidden treasures mysterious locations Crafting and Survival Life in Alaska requires strategy and proper preparation. Gather resources and craft useful items in different workshops such as: tool workshop carpentry workshop fur workshop campfire and kitchen Preparing meals and resting provides bonuses that increase work efficiency, cold resistance, and character stamina. Hunt Wild Animals The wild nature of Alaska is both a threat and a valuable source of resources. By hunting animals you can obtain: meat hides furs hunting trophies The quality of the materials you obtain depends on the weapon used and your hunting skills. Fight Extreme Cold The deeper you venture into the Alaskan wilderness, the lower the temperature becomes. To survive in the extreme climate you must: wear warmer clothing prepare proper meals manage your energy and stamina Lack of preparation can quickly end your expedition. Build Your Own Businesses Gold mining is only the beginning. You can develop different ventures and build your own economic empire: new mines farms producing food and milk a hotel for travelers and gold prospectors Hire workers, manage production, and expand your enterprises. Automate Your Mines The largest mines can be transformed into real enterprises. Hire miners who will work for you and generate a steady income. This allows you to focus on exploration, business development, and discovering new lands.

title: HumanitZ
shortDescription: HumanitZ is an isometric, open-world sandbox survival game set in a world ended by a zombie outbreak. Survive alone or with friends by scavenging, crafting, building, and fighting to last as long as ‘humanly’ possible. You can’t change the past, but you can fight for the future of humanity.
fullDescription: A zombie outbreak wiped out civilization as we know it. Hordes of zeeks gnawed their way to the top, becoming the world’s apex predator. Regular humans are now an endangered species, with isolated pockets struggling to survive in this new, unforgiving world. Welcome to HumanitZ, an isometric, open-world, sandbox survival game, where you can try to make a difference and put humanity back where it belongs - at the top of the food chain. Will you gamble on cities and scavenge loot, knowing hordes of zeeks might be around the corner? Or do you try to survive off the land in the country, through hunting, fishing, and farming? Survive in an Open Sandbox World A vast, cruel world stretches from untamed wilderness to dense urban cities, with each location offering resources and risk. Exploration is rarely safe and never predictable as you face infected wildlife, zeek hordes, and hostile survivors roaming the landscape. Drivable vehicles become essential tools for survival, allowing you to cross dangerous territory, haul supplies, carry companions, and push farther into hostile environments. Will you find aid and trade at survivor camps, or violent confrontation as you take over enemy bandit bases? If the infected and other survivors aren’t enough, hunger, exposure, and a dynamic weather system constantly threaten your chances of making it through another day. For those willing to keep moving forward when others stop, the path leads to The Island, and the truth behind the outbreak and its terrors left undiscovered. Live off the Land! Pick through the ruins of the old world and scavenge resources to survive, or retreat to the hills to avoid the shambling remnants of humanity. Set up a farm, forage, hunt wildlife, or fish to sustain yourself. Each choice can mean the difference between lasting another day or becoming part of the ruins. Solo, Co-op & Online Play Survive your way. Play solo, cooperatively, or online in PvE and PvP modes with dedicated servers and proximity voice chat. Whether you face the apocalypse alone or with friends watching your back, the choice is yours.  In a desolate world, even solo survivors learn quickly that befriending a dog or horse companion can mean the difference between life and death. Robust Character Customization Design your chosen survivor with professions, afflictions, and a skill-tree system.  Then outfit your survivor with a plethora of weaponry and gear that shape how you endure the apocalypse. Craft and Build for Survival Use an extensive crafting and building system to create what you need to survive, from gear and consumables to vehicles. Craft and customize weapons with attachments and modifications to survive relentless threats and hunt game. Upgrade vehicles with armor, weapons, and storage capacity to adapt to the risks ahead. Then construct a safe house, fortify your base against threats using defensive structures like electrified fences and concrete barricades, or reclaim a burned-out house as a new place to live. Endure the Zeeks Not all zeeks are slow and stupid. Adapt and improvise against numerous zeek variants, or you'll risk becoming zombie fodder.  Customize your game sessions using extensive game-altering settings, or push yourself further by enabling Permadeath Mode if you dare. The apocalypse claims everyone, eventually. If not through a zombie’s maw, then through hunger, exposure, treacherous terrain, or other people. How long will you last?

Make the most of your limited time and resources so you can prepare sufficiently for the future. Against titanic enemies, you must rely on not just strength but wit. title: Wildfrost
shortDescription: Take on the elements in Wildfrost, a tactical roguelike deckbuilder! Journey across a frozen tundra, collecting cards strong enough to banish the eternal winter…
fullDescription: The sun has frozen over... The world has succumbed to the Wildfrost. Now only Snowdwell and its survivors stand as the last bastion against an eternal winter... Build up a deck of powerful card companions and elemental items, as you battle to banish the frost once and for all! Perfect your card battling and deck-building skills, and set out on a quest to bring an end to The Wildfrost! Begin each journey with your chosen tribe Leader, each gifted with different randomised skills and stats, before mapping out your chosen path into the unforgiving frosty landscape. Rescue and recruit frozen companions you find along the way, unearth lost treasures, and spend your hard-earned blings with travelling merchants. The decisions you make and routes you take during each run will help craft a powerful deck, unique to you each time you play. Collect a huge array of cute, but mighty card companions, as well as handy items and clunker cards to aid you in battle. Experiment with different elemental card combinations to find your winning formula. Your companion cards aren’t just disposable minions for dealing out damage; upgrade and customise your favourites by adding wobbly charms to enhance their powers, making your deck a powerful (and adorable) force to be reckoned with! Plan ahead with the help of a dynamic counter system to map out your next move and fend off frosty foes. While Wildfrost battles are turn-based, cards don’t attack every turn. Instead they have a ‘counter’ which counts down the amount of turns until they’re ready to automatically make their move! By keeping an eye on enemy monsters’ counters, you can plot ahead your perfect play. Buff your companions? Stall an enemy attack? Or maybe count down your own timer to wreak havoc fast! It’s up to you to strategically turn the tide in your favour. Need a rest? Take shelter in the cosy town of Snowdwell. Here survivors have gathered to keep warm using the power of the Luminice, a giant shard of hot ice. These new areas will unlock fun and useful new things to use during your adventures, with new cards, tribes, cosmetics, challenges to complete, and events to encounter. Choose from a multitude of ship chassis and then kit your selection out with a variety of weapon systems, defensive upgrades, and internal modules. Find unique synergies between your options as each choice comes with an associated set of cards for your deck, with additional cards and upgrades unlocked at your discretion after each victorious encounter – will you dodge dangerous regions, or face them head-on in the hopes of acquiring powerful new options for the journey ahead?. Gather crew to operate your equipment, managing their morale and taking advantage of their unique skills and the benefits they provide your outfit, as well as their relationships with the factions you might encounter. Seek out upgrades and new crew members as you traverse the galaxy – unexpected equipment combinations will provide powerful card synergies, each with their own risks and rewards. Explore diverse tactical options as you engage in turn-based card battles where resource management, strategic foresight, and adaptive thinking will determine the victor. Your sensors will pick up on enemy activity, letting you know what to expect when they strike. Calculate cooldown times and strategize around enemy equipment that poses the greatest threat to you in upcoming turns. Will you prioritize disabling specific equipment with focused fire, or will you instead rely on using defensive countermeasures to stand your ground as you burn past enemy shields and punch through their hulls? Not all equipment is created equal, and your options are determined by the unique capabilities of your loadout, and the resulting cards at hand. The right order of operations can be the difference between a powerful alpha strike that obliterates a weaker ship, or an impenetrable defensive stack that buys you more time to chip away at a tough adversary. Hack enemy equipment, overheat their ships, overwhelm their point defense systems, and devise unique combinations with which to dominate space warfare. Seek out the mysterious Signal as you carve your own unique path through the tense narrative encounters of Breachway. If at first you don’t succeed, try and try again – each run improves your odds of success with better knowledge and tools, while the varied events will send you down unexpected journeys full of twists and turns keeping each run fresh. Engage with pirates and converse with members of four unique factions that might help or hinder you in various ways. Grapple with morally gray decisions as you come across people spread throughout the systems, coloring how the world looks at you and your crew. The right faction relationships, properly managed, can unlock access to extremely powerful arsenals, but your ties with each of the factions will determine how your story unfolds – will you be swayed by the genetically enhanced Starkin and their desire for unity by any means necessary, or does the independence of the Free Roamers call to you instead? Breachway puts you in charge of a rag-tag crew piloting a lone warship on a grand adventure – strategize and synergize your way on each run through the galaxy.

Venture ever deeper in the cursed jungle in search of The Mound, rumored to hold treasures beyond imagination.

title: Under The Yoke
shortDescription: Under The Yoke is a 2D medieval peasant life-sim. Make your mark in the Domesday book as you control a family of serfs through 250 years of English history. Cultivate your lands, craft goods and hone your reputation as you navigate the tumultuous Middle Ages. Your family’s future is yours to shape!
fullDescription: Step back in time and embark on a remarkable journey through the heart of Norman England, spanning over 250 years of fully realised Medieval English history. Begin your humble life as a lowly serf playing your own custom character. Armed with just an acre of land, a ramshackle cottage, and enough provisions to survive winter, your quest for prosperity begins. Guide your family through the Middle Ages, from one generation to the next. Each character boasts distinct personalities, needs, and skills, and it's your duty to oversee every facet of their lives, from their livelihoods to their social circles and even their daily sustenance. Every character possesses three defining traits—Mind, Body, and Spirit—that dictate their compatibility with others, preferred activities, and unlock unique event options. Choose wisely, as each trait brings both advantages and disadvantages, impacting their daily toil and needs. Keep your characters content and productive by attending to their essential needs: Satisfy their Taste with over 50 authentic medieval ingredients. Grant them Rest , allowing them precious respite from their laborious routines. Nurture their Faith through immersive Middle Ages church experiences. Foster their Social connections by participating in genuine medieval social gatherings and building lasting bonds with fellow villagers. Surviving in the Middle Ages demands a diverse skill set. Master the arts of Farming, Herbalism, Cooking, Husbandry, Carpentry, and Tailoring as you engage in the myriad tasks of a medieval peasant's life. From plowing fields to shearing sheep, there's always work to be done, though the season and the changing value of goods will keep you on your toes. While you focus on your family, the village thrives around you. Forge friendships, pursue romance, and interact with your neighbours. But beware, as rival families vie for elections and jury seats. Consider forging alliances to collectively prosper. Life as a peasant extends beyond the fields. Enhance your cottage and garden with handcrafted furniture that can elevate the value of your goods, whether for personal use or lucrative market sales. If space becomes a constraint, negotiate with your Lord for a larger cottage or garden to accommodate more furniture. Farming entails more than just crops—farm animals provide vital resources. Purchase and breed cows, horses, goats, sheep, pigs, and chickens, each with their own unique needs and benefits. Opt for the strength of an ox or the speed of a horse, or reap the rewards of wool from sheep and the fertiliser from pigs. Revive the age-old Hallmote tradition—an annual gathering of villagers to address legal disputes and elect local officials. Dive into the realm of politics, with rewards for winning elections and voting for allies. Your male family members might also be summoned for jury duty during village disputes. Negotiate your feudal dues and responsibilities with your Lord. From farmland to meadowland, your home to your garden, all aspects of your life are open to negotiation. As a serf, you'll toil on your Lord's demesne or face fees, but earning their respect could pave your path to freedom. Rise to a freeman status and expand your rights, from baking your own bread to hunting in the forests. Under The Yoke intricately replicates the medieval rights system. Immerse yourself in medieval England's vibrant tapestry through a dynamic event system, featuring hundreds of unique events that ensure every play-through remains fresh. From social intrigues to attending church, your choices shape your family's legacy throughout the ages. Experience history like never before as your characters respond to the pivotal events of their time. With our dynamic event system, we weave 250 years of history from 1085 to 1335 into your personal narrative, enabling you to walk in the shoes of the common man as the world evolves around you.

title: Deep Rock Galactic: Rogue Core
shortDescription: DEEP ROCK GALACTIC: ROGUE CORE is a 1-4 player co-op shooter with sci-fi dwarves, procedurally-generated caves and random roguelike upgrades. Explore maze-like mines and blast through hordes of alien abominations — no two runs are the same. Move quickly, work together and shoot first to survive.
fullDescription: Our deep-level mining operations have gone dark. Deep Rock Galactic needs them back online at any cost. We’re sending in a crack squad of Reclaimers to breach and secure the mines, and kill whatever’s down there. Your survival is not necessary for the success of this mission. Step into the boots of the Reclaimers, Deep Rock Galactic’s elite corporate security force. In fast-paced 1-4 player co-op gameplay , you’ll fight through alien-infested mines as five playable classes: GUARDIAN: The walking shield. An expert in area denial and close protection. Damages enemies with concussive blasts, and restores the team’s armor. FALCONER: The aerial attacker. Deploys an airborne assault drone to electrify enemies. In an emergency, can even revive teammates from afar. RETCON: The hologram berserker. Can warp back to a previous point in spacetime, restoring health and ammo to recover from dangerous situations. Lethal in all time zones. SPOTTER: The marksman. Highlights and weakens targets with toxin darts, spots enemies through walls, and can deploy ammo crates for use in extended firefights. SLICER: The melee expert. Carries an energy blade capable of dismembering all but the toughest opponents. Mobile, agile, aggressive. No two runs are the same. The roguelike format means you’ll scavenge your weapons and equipment from within the mines, and collect resources to upgrade your gear and abilities. Choose from a deep pool of upgrades for your weapons and abilities, discovering lethal synergies and snowballing in power as you fight your way down to the Rift Gate. Linger too long, and the Reaperworms will hear you. Explore each level of the mine for upgrades, equipment and resources — but remember that each stop costs precious time. Stick with your team, move quickly, and push forward at all costs. Nobody said this would be easy. But death is only a setback. Dive, dig, die, and dive again. Procedurally-generated caves mean every single mission gives a unique challenge of traversal and exploration. Featuring 100% destructible terrain , you can dig, carve and explode the caves around you to level the playing field. Fight your way deeper through natural caverns and enormous industrial structures. These mines are infested with Corespawn: the most aggressive, resilient and intelligent alien life we’ve ever encountered on Hoxxes IV. 20+ different enemy types and 3 different bosses are lying in wait. Use whatever means necessary to eliminate them. Between missions, you’ll find yourself aboard the RV-09 Ramrod. Here, you and your squad can access rich metaprogression and extensive character customization to bring into your next deployment . Lift weights, braid your beard, hit the dance floor, and have a beer with your team. Think you’ve got what it takes to brave the depths? Wishlist Rogue Core and contact a local Reclaimers recruiting station today. THE RESOLUTE. THE RELENTLESS. THE RECLAIMERS.

shortDescription: Kingdomino is a cosy 1-4 player tile-laying strategy game of kingdom building. Place colorful dominoes, match terrains, and crown your lands to create the most prosperous realm. The official adaptation of Kingdomino, the winner of the prestigious 2017 Spiel des Jahres award. Complete special quest objectives, earn community points, and participate in time-limited events that bring players together. Unlock and collect unique Meeples and Castle designs to make your realm truly your own! Seamless multiplayer gaming across all devices. Challenge friends and rivals, whether they're playing on PC or mobile - True cross-platform compatibility ensures you'll always find opponents ready to battle! HOW TO PLAY Each player builds a kingdom by connecting domino-like tiles showing different terrains. Dominoes have two squares with different or matching landscapes, some featuring crowns that multiply points. Start with your castle tile. Take turns selecting from available terrain tiles. Connect tiles to matching landscapes (forests, fields, lakes, mountains) Build strategically to create large territories with multiple crowns. Score points by multiplying territory size by the number of crowns. Games take 10-20 minutes, making Kingdomino perfect for quick sessions or hours of strategic kingdom building!

fullDescription: A Cozy Farming Game That Respects Your Time Happy Harvest is an idle farming game that finds the perfect balance between active and passive gameplay. Whether you're actively planting and harvesting or letting your farm run while you're away, every moment feels rewarding. Start Small, Dream Big You begin with almost nothing, just enough for a single lettuce seed. Each harvest brings a small profit. Each unlock feels earned. Watch as your patch of lettuce gradually transforms into rows of exotic crops. Before you know it, you're growing mystical Crystal Berries worth thousands of Leaf Tickets each. The Seasons Turn Spring gives way to Summer, Autumn, and Winter. Each Season paints your farm in warm new colours and boosts a different set of crops. Plan your harvests around the season, or take control entirely with the late-game Weather Control upgrade and set the season yourself. Progression That Feels Right The numbers climb at a satisfying pace. Grow your farm at a steady rate. Unlock individual upgrade paths for each crop, expand your plots, and automate your farm to run while you focus on what matters! The Research Lab Once you've proven yourself, the Research Lab opens its doors. Invest Extracts which can be earned from different crops, into a skill tree of permanent upgrades. Boost specific crops, amplify seasonal bonuses, and push your farm further than raw upgrades alone. Crop Mastery Harvest a crop enough times and you'll master it! This unlocks a unique passive reward that changes how that crop works forever. Free lettuce. Double extracts from tomatoes. Faster growth across the board! The Prestige System When you've built a bigger farm, choose to start over for Prestige Gems: permanent currency that buys permanent upgrades. Each prestige makes future runs faster and more rewarding. Preserve unlocked plots, boost all crop values, increase automation speed. The sense of progression never stops! Ascension Beyond Prestige lies Ascension: a deeper reset that raises your permanent Ascension Level. Each level multiplies your Leaf Ticket earnings by another 100%, and unlocks powerful upgrades unavailable anywhere else. Unlock new mechanics and level up your farm even further! Even While You Sleep Your automated farm keeps working when you close the game. Come back to everything your farm earned while you were away!
