title: Black Book
shortDescription: “Black Book” is a dark RPG Adventure, based on Slavic myths, in which you play as a young sorceress. Fight evil forces in card-based battles and explore the world, where humans live alongside mythological creatures.
fullDescription: A fusion of card-based RPGs and Adventure games, “Black Book” is a haunting tale of a young sorceress, who gave her life to serve the dark forces. Dive into the cold, yet alluring world of Slavic folktales - and uncover the secrets that hide in the darkness. A young girl named Vasilisa, destined to become a witch, decides to throw her fate away and marry her beloved - but that dream is shattered when her betrothed dies under mysterious circumstances. Aching for her lost love, Vasilisa seeks out the Black Book - a demonic artifact, said to be powerful enough to grant any wish to the one who uncovers all 7 of its seals. Join Vasilisa in her adventures across the rural countryside, as she solves the woes of common folk by confronting demons and performing exorcisms. Uncover the seals of Black Book Unleash hellish spells on your enemies! Collect spell cards and new skills as you progress. A Historic Adventure Solve riddles and complete side-quests as you learn more about life in the Slavic countryside. Lead a Demonic Flock Send demons to do your bidding, but be careful - idle demons will torture you if you don’t find them something to do! Myths and legends Explore a world based on Northern Slavic mythology. Learn from an in-game encyclopedia, created with the help of expert anthropologists - and find all folk tales hidden within the game!

title: Touhou: Lost Branch of Legend
shortDescription: Welcome to Eientei, combine multiple colors of mana to build your ideal deck, duel with gensokyo girls, and chase back the mysterious moon treasure. Also, enjoy the unpredictable Roguelike with fantasy Danmaku!
fullDescription: While the princess of the moon, Kaguya Houraisan, was hosting the Lunar Capital Exhibition, the Divine Treasue known as "The Jeweled Branch of Hourai" was stolen! Reimu Hakurei is now tasked to find the culprit, resolve the incident, and recover the precious Lunarian Exhibit! Lost Branch of Legend is a roguelike deckbuilder starring the girls of Gensokyo, where you collect cards, find exhibits and face off against the girls and their awesome powers! The various Shining Exhibits can permanently add Mana to play cards. The different colors of mana provided by each can drastically affect your deck's playstyle. We have designed over 500 danmaku patterns，each and every one of them capturing the charm of Gensokyo. Don't worry, they can safely be blocked by a barrier! Reimu Hakurei The Hakurei Shrine Maiden, who's always seen when an incident occurs. If she gets the Lunar Treasure, she won't have problems with donations or worshipers for the rest of the year. Reimu specializes in using Red and White Mana. An all-rounder good on both offense and defense, such a minor incident is easy with her expertise in resolution! Marisa Kirisame An ordinary magician living in the Forest of Magic and a compulsive collector. She already had an intrest in the Lunar Treasure, but she's seeking treasures in general, so of course she'd be involved with the incident. Marisa specializes in using Black and Red Mana. Brew potions, charge up your power, and finish them off with a flashy blow! Nothing's impossible with firepower! Sakuya Izayoi The elegant head maid of the Scarlet Devil Mansion and a servant of the ever capricious Scarlet Devil. Surprisingly willing to get her knives dirty, she's eager to get any incident resolved ASAP. Sakuya specializes in using White and Blue Mana. Toss knives, stop time, and welcome your foes to a world filled with silver blades pointed at them! Cirno A fairy from the Misty Lake who regularly pulls pranks on people. In search of prank material, she brought her friends to the expo. Cirno specializes in using Blue and Green Mana. Freeze your enemies, call on Teammates, and show everyone the might of the The Strongest Fairy! And More! • Five playable characters, each with two starting loadouts. • Over 160 Exhibits to recover! • Over 500 Cards to collect! • Over 55 enemies to fight, 23 of them being familiar faces of Gensokyo! • 37 events to encounter!

title: Food Truck Simulator
shortDescription: Renovate, equip and restore the shine of the food truck that belonged to your father. Create recipes, cook the food and serve customers across an entire city. Customize and upgrade your food truck to reach more customers and expand your menu.
fullDescription: Your father owned a food truck. Though the vehicle has grown old, it has become a cornerstone of your family's legacy. Now, in the blink of an eye, your father's gone. Now, the food truck belongs to you. Will you walk in your father's footsteps and live up to his name? Only one way to find out. You can't take the 'truck' out of 'food truck'. Before you can set your stalls up, you have to actually get from your garage to wherever you decide to vend for the day. Be mindful of traffic, and congestions too! When you feel you're short on time do as your father did and veer off the beaten path. First come, first served! You might've thought that all there is to this business is fast food, but now that you're on the other side of the counter it's time to think again. Even so much as a slice of cheese can turn a classic burger into a cheeseburger special. So, what will it be, sir? Ketchup or mustard? Customers can be impatient and needy a lot. You'll find that you don't have all that much time to get them what they want and fit their palate as well. It'll be a challenge, but it's one your father has overcome, and surely so can you. Practice makes perfect, so go and knock them off their feet with your quality food! As your prestige grows, so does your repertoire of tricks and tools. Stay up to date with your fame as you follow your in father's footsteps. Make sure to outfit yourself with the newest, top-of-the-line equipment you (and your wallet) can muster. Ride the wave of fame. The truck belongs to you and as the hands that own it change, so too should its décor. Adjust anything from the exterior's color to the interior layout, the bumpers, lights, and wheels. Show the city you're no less than your father was and hit the streets like you own them. Each day is a new adventure, and each adventure requires sufficient provisions. Ingredients aren't permanent and will rot and spoil as the hours tick on by. Remember to stock up on not only the freshest but most desirable produce your clientele might demand of you. The truck is dirty and has fallen to disrepair. Honour dad's memory by polishing it one last time. It's been a while since the truck has seen any use. Grab a bucket and a sponge, find a broom and get to cleaning. You'll need to be thorough, and it might take a while to make the truck spick and span, but now you have a duty to fulfill. Get to it! Key Features Renovating and expanding food truck. Wide range of customization options. Large catalogue of equipment options to choose from. Create your own recipes. Driving with traffic system. Detailed cooking system. Different locations across an entire city with different types of customers. Various events. Managing Living city with dynamic day and night cycle.

title: We Were Here Forever
shortDescription: You both awaken imprisoned inside the sinister Castle Rock - were you betrayed, or simply not that clever? Find out in the greatest co-op puzzle adventure in the We Were Here Series! Do you and your partner have what it takes to face the dark forces of this realm or will you be trapped… forever?
fullDescription: You and your fellow prisoner are trapped in the realm of Castle Rock - were you betrayed, or simply not that clever? To escape, you must explore the sinister castle for puzzles and plot your escape together. Secrets and riddles are hidden in the shadows. Just be aware that nothing is what it seems in this mysterious Antarctic adventure. Can you two escape together, or will you be trapped… forever? Locked up in the dungeons, deep in the bowels of Castle Rock, you and a fellow prisoner must seek a way out and return to stand again beneath the icy Antarctic skies - but escaping this nightmare will not be so easy, let alone escaping the castle itself. Freeing yourselves from your cells and escaping the Keep is only the beginning - but does one truly escape Castle Rock? Fresh mysteries await, and you’ll have to make some choices about how to proceed. Your journey leads from the dark prison through the royal halls to the outside. Outside the Keep, you will discover the story of Rockbury, it’s inhabitants, and plans of a resistance formed against the King to escape this icy place. Hope will lead you on to an eerie Graveyard and have you descend down into the dark waters of the Foundry. You two have been brought here for a purpose. You might even be the missing piece of a puzzle set in motion long ago, in a time long forgotten. But someone, or something, desperately seeks to solve that puzzle, by any means necessary. Only an unshakeable bond with your partner will give you any hope of survival in the face of such dreadful desire… Does one truly escape Castle Rock? Feature list Two player co-op: the puzzles you encounter take two to solve - you both have a role to play! Communicate via walkie-talkies, and act as each other’s eyes and ears Connect through experience: when you find yourself in sudden danger, will you freeze, or can you keep cool and explain things clearly to your friend - before your time runs out… On the edge of your seat: be part of a thrilling adventure in the lively world of Castle Rock as you and your friend take on the ancient powers aligned against you Spine-tingling story: there is much to discover… and much to fear - you’ve met the Jester, but is he even the most powerful being within the walls of Castle Rock? NOTE: This game is co-op only. It requires both players to have a working PC-compatible microphone and an internet connection. Talk Your voice is all you have... at first. You and your fellow prisoner must escape from Castle Rock and uncover an ancient mystery. All you have to start with is a pair of walkie-talkies - can you work together on the same wavelength? Solve Two partners, one purpose. Get on the same page! Immerse yourself in an intriguing cooperative experience as you and your partner puzzle your way through a series of thrilling situations. Search for a way out through brand new environments, together. Escape The King awaits us... The frozen grounds and dark chambers of Castle Rock hold many secrets and hidden dangers. Unravel the web you find yourself trapped within, for there are hungry eyes watching. The fallen king of the castle has plans for you… can you truly escape from his sinister grasp? Every game in the We Were Here Series is a standalone co-op adventure – the stories are connected but you don’t need to play them in order. You can also learn more about the history of Castle Rock in the We Were Here Stories: Chronicles of Castle Rock - a six part live-action video series available on the Total Mayhem Games YouTube.

title: Cooking Simulator VR

fullDescription: Become the supreme chef in VR! - The kitchen gets a next-gen upgrade! Step into a realistic VR kitchen filled with every tool, appliance, and any ingredient you could imagine. From griddles and gas burners to knives, blenders, and blowtorches — it’s all here, waiting for you to experiment. Every ingredient responds to your actions: slice potatoes, flip steaks, or simmer soups with authentic physics and haptic feedback. Feel the resistance of the knife as you cut, and watch food change in temperature, texture, and appearance in real time. Build your career from rookie to world-class chef in Career Mode , or let your imagination run wild in Sandbox Mode  where the only limit is your creativity (or your tolerance for kitchen fires). Key Features: Next-Gen VR Immersion – Rebuilt in Unreal 5.5 with 4K visuals, enhanced physics, and dynamic day/night lighting. Precision Cooking – More accurate VR hand tracking, refined cutting, stirring, and flipping mechanics. 100+ Recipes & Ingredients – From steaks and salmon to spices and sauces, experiment with endless combinations. Lifelike Tools & Utensils – Griddles, cookers, ovens, knives, pans, spatulas, blenders, and more. Realistic Physics & Haptics – Every slice, stir, and pour feels authentic through VR feedback. title: Dungeons 4

fullDescription: Once upon a time in a realm far, far away, everything was lush and green. The unicorns mingled among the trees and the elves and humans lived peacefully in harmony with their surroundings. Yet somewhere at the edge of a clearing half-hidden among the trees, obscured by a rising veil of fog in the hazy half-darkness of a weather-beaten hut, a shape huddles over a large and ominously glowing crystal ball. A mumbling voice sings ancient formulae, urging the swirling glowing mists inside the crystal to part and give an insight into the future. “All is in flux, nothing seems certain. Come, oh vagaries of space and time, separate the veil and show us what is yet to come”, the voice grumbles with the hint of an eye faintly reflecting the glow in front of its hood. The shape’s audience, only barely visible in the dim light, leans in closer and listens intently. “Time ebbs and flows, forming pools and wrinkles… but when the mists part only vague images rise from beyond the veil. Shhhh—don’t come too close, you don’t want to disturb my delicate magical weavings do you?” The shape, still bent over the orb, mutters and shoos the other back a bit more into the shadows. “Ah, now it seems to be clearing a little. I can see… something… several somethings, hints of voices echoing in the haze. A baby, something happening on Hill Doom and the coming together of the Council of Snots – what could all this mean?” In a flash, the light reflected in the eye turns red and a distant evil laughter echoes through the woods. Stay tuned for the return of the Soothsaying Evil! The Absolute Evil and its trusted *cough* servant, the Dark Elf Thalya, return in Dungeons 4 after the events of its fabulous predecessor to bring about their triumph over the forces of good once more. Build a cozy and comfortable Dungeon to suit your creatures’ needs and rule over them, then send them out into the Overworld to kindly remind the good people living there that the Absolute Evil rules over their lands. Gather your Evilness in new and dynamic ways and unleash it upon the lush green forests and plains of the Overworld to turn them over to the dark side. But make sure that your Dungeon is well-secured by traps and defended by your creatures, for those pesky Overworlders won’t just twiddle their thumbs while you turn their land into the Absolute Evil’s most pleasurable holiday paradise . But what is that noise? “Gold, gold, gold and gems, gold and gems and gold!” The ancient song echoes throughout the underworld, accompanied by the clanging steel of hammers and axes. The Dwarves have arrived to claim their share of the abundant resources and together with the Elves and Humans of the Overworld, they send out their raiding parties to find the Dungeon’s heart. Dungeons 4 keeps the spirit of its predecessor, but everything is now bigger, better, and with even more dynamic Evilness™ . Everything is better with Dwarves™: The Dwarves have arrived to build their underground strongholds and the hardy little fellows (although they don’t like being called that) compete with the Ever-Expanding Evil for space and resources. It makes your Dungeon great again: Dungeons are up to four times larger than before and there are many more creatures who wait for the All-Commanding Evil’s orders to conquer the Overworld. Now the time has come for massive armies and truly sprawling dungeons! Ripe for the taking: The Overworld is bigger than ever before. Gain Evilness by beating Mini Bosses like the obsessively harmonious Unicorn and use it to transform the Overworld into stunning biomes of pure evil. New and shiny: An ability-based Perk system for Thalya, the Absolute Evil’s trusted *cough* and most loyal subordinate, grants her impressive new powers. The Absolute Evil can now enjoy taking over the world, governing the creatures and slapping subordinates even more with the customizable Evil Hand. Minions, everywhere: The Horde, the Undead and the Demons wait to do the Absolute Evil’s bidding, with more creatures than ever eagerly following the gesturing Evil’s orders, and Snots will play a much more prominent role this time. Many ways to tell the story: A long campaign, narrated by the beloved English Narrator from previous titles, as well as several skirmish maps all to challenge your rule as the Absolute Evil. Change the world: Spread your Evilness across the Overworld to bring lush and green environments over to the dark side, now shining even more vibrantly and beautifully evil as you spread your evilness across many new biomes. Work together, slay together: 2-player co-op multiplayer with both players managing one Dungeon together. All maps from the skirmish mode and the campaign are playable in co-op.

Set up custom games with wild rulesets, or jump into community-run servers and embrace the chaos. No matchmaking. No ranks. Just pure, dumb fun. Tight, free-flowing combat that’ll have you screaming for your mom to get the camera. Everything is dodgeable so if you get clapped, that’s on you. Or a goldfish piloting a mech. Or a Russian samurai. Or ramen with legs. Each characters comes with it’s own unique skillset and there’s a character design for everyone—even the freaks 👁️👄👁️. Whether it’s turning into a giant metallic duck, speccing into turretmancy, or literal poison, every game will present you with freshly randomized build combos to gamba with. Build synergies, get winnergies. Block escape routes with a crane’s payload, transform into a vending machine for a sneaky ambush, or do a drive-by in a 1942 Panzerkampfwagon Tiger Tank. BAPBAP is a PvP sandbox where nothing make sense but also everything makes sense. On top of all that, you could get ganked by a roaming giga slime, fish up a nuclear bomb or come face to tentacle with [redacted]  - the better you are at adapting, the more you’ll win. Whether it’s the turnaround 1v3, hitting a sweet multi-target knock up or just watching your mates get hit by their own trap – BAPBAP is here to help you get that sweet hit of dopamine in this increasingly depressing world. Welcome to BAPBAP, where logic goes to die.

title: OVIS LOOP
shortDescription: A pixel-art action roguelike with dynamic combat, player-led combo crafting and a post-apocalyptic battle of wolf and lamb. Step into the shoes of the robot-sheep Omega to wield sci-fi weapons and gather evolving skills to protect your flock. Jump into the loop and create a unique combat style.
fullDescription: Step into a world where combat never has to go the same way twice. Engage the lupine enemy in dynamic combat, with responsive and precise battle controls. Find a host of ferocious enemies, ranging from the smallest minions to hulking monstrosities – with an army augmented by the despicable Doctor Wolf. Unlock new weapons, skills and abilities to pick up on each run, but Protectors beware! One wrong move and while Omega will persist through death, any modifications collected will be lost as you hit a new Loop with a fresh loadout – it’s time to steel your woollen form, and protect the flock. After defeating enemies, players will download and evolve critical skills to help you fight through the Loop. Rather than just acquiring new skills, Ovis Loop gives you the choice between passive and active upgrades for each skill. Decide to buff the skill you have, or add an additional chained skill to carry on carving your way through Doctor Wolf’s minions. Our skill and combo system allows you to play your way. Focus on strengthening just one skill, or embrace the dynamic force of the chain, it’s up to you. Each Alpha enemy and Doctor Wolf’s augmented monstrosities provide increasingly difficult challenges as you progress through the Loop. As well as harbouring secrets about Ovis Loop’s world and inhabitants, they also learn from your own playstyle. Whether you like to charge in, use area of effect or dive in and out, each boss will adapt to meet your challenge. Focus on dodging and find a boss that aggressively pursues. If you prefer to rush in, it’ll retreat to find space. You define the battle, but each Loop is designed to test you with more than simple pattern recognition. Overcome each challenge through intuitive action and a build that works for you. An unconventional story, maybe, but this is not the tale you have heard before. As well as powerful new skills and abilities, you’ll uncover secrets about Ovis Loop’s post-apocalyptic world and (more importantly) about our hero Omega. Become the Shepherd, protect your flock, and delve into the mysteries you find in each Loop. Ovis Loop is the chronicle of just one lone sheep, trapped in a brutal, looping war with a lupine enemy. In this fight, you must stand alone, but Ovis Loop gives you the tools to succeed, for those with wool made of steel. --- This game uses generative AI for assisted translation, with manual review and optimization to ensure language quality and gameplay experience. (AI Languages Used: Traditional Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, Portuguese, Latin American Spanish, Spanish, French, German, Russian)

title: Re:Night
shortDescription: Re:Night is a strategy game that blends turn based tactics with roguelike deckbuilding. In each run, build your deck, plan your tactics, and experiment with countless 3-character team combinations. Journey to a mysterious town, break the endless cycle of night, and bring dawn back to the world.
fullDescription: Re:Night is a strategy game that combines turn-based tactical combat with roguelike deckbuilding. Build your deck over the course of each run while navigating battlefields filled with tactical possibilities. Any combination of three characters can create more than 20 unique builds, and the interaction between multiple strategic systems delivers deep, rewarding, and highly replayable combat. Travel to a mysterious town, break the endless cycle of night with your own hands, and restore dawn to the world. Tactical combat introduces strategic mechanics such as frontline and backline positioning, flanking, blocking, and protecting allies. Combined with elemental counters, equipment, and item effects, these systems create countless opportunities for powerful combinations. Command three characters simultaneously in every battle, each with a distinct role. Whether focusing on burst damage, battlefield control, healing, or environmental interactions, careful coordination and party synergy are the keys to victory. Fire, Water, and Grass form a cyclical elemental counter system. Exploit elemental advantages to unleash devastating critical hits and deal massive damage. Coordinate your three characters to trigger elemental critical hits while positioning them to deny your enemies the same advantage. Every move requires careful planning, but victory also depends on adapting to an ever-changing battlefield. Every character features unique talents and an exclusive pool of character-specific cards. Combine more than 300 cards with over 200 pieces of equipment and items to create more than 20 distinct builds for any three-character party. Become an unstoppable brawler, a demolition expert, or a relentless lancer. Even the stone walls of the battlefield can become powerful weapons. In Re:Night, your imagination is your greatest strength. Undo your last action, rewind to the start of the current turn, or even restart the battle from the very beginning at any time. Never let a single mistake ruin your adventure, and face unfamiliar enemies with the freedom to explore different strategies. Study enemy behavior, experiment with different positioning, card sequences, and elemental combinations, then use each rewind to test new ideas, refine your strategy, and discover your own path to victory. Every run offers a fresh adventure, with diverse maps, random events, challenging battles, and unexpected encounters waiting to be discovered. Begin your journey beside the stream outside the town, venture through the dangers hidden within the village, and ultimately ascend to a castle shrouded in mystery. With every adventure, you'll unlock new content, playable characters, and even greater challenges to overcome. Each character has their own memory fragments, known as Chrono Shards. Collect them to unlock hidden cards and equipment, expanding your tactical options with every discovery. Gather every Chrono Shard to uncover the truth behind the endless cycle of night.

title: Seasons Turning
shortDescription: A farming sim focused on exploration instead of repetition, where you must discover every seed you plant, solve puzzles, explore dungeons, and appease the mafia cat army. No stamina bar. No broken tools. No combat. Save whenever. Play at your own speed.
fullDescription: Season's Turning is a solo-developed, combat-less farming sim focused on exploration and environmental immersion. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and explore dungeons to unveil the mystery behind a diminished countryside town. The town's success is tied to your own as you try to prove that you're a stable, responsible enough adult to adopt your younger sister. Navigate a dynamic economy and changing product demand with the help of advanced farming techniques like irrigation, companion planting, and gene splicing. And don't forget to appease the local barn cat gang to keep those pesky crows off your crops. RESPECT FOR YOUR TIME Everybody plays games at different paces and for different lengths of time. I designed this game from the start to allow players to change the speed of the day, and save whenever they like. I’ve also added features to help circumvent some traditionally slow farming sim actions, such as irrigation, a bicycle, fast travel, and a scythe that lets your harvest your crops by twirling around in circles. FARMING TIED TO EXPLORATION You cannot buy most seeds in this game. You must go out in the world, discover new plants, and harvest your seeds from them. Some of these plants are rare, farther away, or hidden in a secret area where you need to solve a puzzle or use a special item to enter. ENVIRONMENTAL IMMERSION The wind in this game is a physical object. It’ll blow the plants, trees, and your own character’s hair and clothes in real time as it passes across the world. The volume of rustling leaves is location-based to each tree individually, as are smaller sounds like critters and wind chimes, making you feel like you’re really in the world. The weather can be intense. When it’s raining in town, you can hear it hitting the rooftops, or on the canopy of the forest. It'll be softer when you're indoors, and ping off the panes of windows you're close to. There are different scales to which it can rain or snow, and different effects on you if you don’t dress appropriately for the weather. A TOWN FULL OF LIFE The town of Hiraeth is home to more than 35 unique characters. You can’t woo them with gifts, but they each have their own personality and goals. Isla's got a crush on the mapmaker. John doesn't know how to connect with his sons. Kiara's uncle's pressuring her about college and Noah just wants to start a small business before he's 15.  They all have hobbies, relationships with each other, problems they’re trying to solve, and opinions about you. Helping them won’t just make new friends, it may also improve the town, open new shops, attract more people to your own business, reveal a secret, or even unlock the entrance to a dungeon. ARCHITECTURE & BUILDING The buildings in this game aren’t just miniature versions of house exteriors. When you enter a building, you aren’t teleported to a different location for the interior. You’re still in the same location. You can see what’s going on outside the windows. You can stroll out onto a balcony or terrace and watch the NPCs across the street go about their business. When it comes to your own house, you have the amount of customization you could expect from going to a home builder in the real world. You can choose from a collection of floorplans, customize your siding, roofing, window type, window frame, shutters, trim, flooring, and paint. The total combinations of options are well into the thousands. CHARACTER CUSTOMIZATION There are 29 base hair styles, 13 bangs, and 8 beards to choose from, as well as 32 skin tones, 64 eye and hair colors, and more options related to customization unlockable after some quests. Your character is whatever gender you want them to be at any time you want them to be it. I didn’t draw gender-specific body types, and you can wear whatever clothes or hairstyles you want (given a trip to the salon or clothing store). For clothes, there are 100 tops, 100 bottoms, 100 hats, 50 shoes, and 40 socks. TOTAL FEATURE SCOPE: A fully upgradeable town, where new businesses will appear or improve based on your interactions with the townsfolk At least 70 harvestable plants & ingredients 32 fish, with individual preferences and a stockable fish pond Immersive weather and sound systems A cyclical game clock, which controls lighting, season, weather, environmental effects, available activities, npc schedules, and interactions 4 individually themed dungeons Player progression and skills A multitude of options for furniture, decorations, clothing, and housing customization Unique items found throughout the world which allow players special abilities (for example, an hourglass that can freeze time) A detailed economy with changing market value Systems for crafting, cooking, candlemaking, painting, brewing, pickling, dying, and arranging bouquets with your harvested resources Genetic seed manipulation Companion Planting Harvesting and watering mechanics that respect your time No stamina bar Adjustable game speed, and other anti-stress options Save any time of the day Lovable mafia farm kittens A bike for faster travel, from the beginning I really love making this game and hope you enjoy playing it just as much ^-^ p.s. Your desktop turns into a cozy aquarium where fish swim over your games, your work, or whatever you’re doing, bringing a gentle and playful vibe to your day. Designed for idle play, Desktop Fishes lets you enjoy a relaxing aquarium experience at your own pace. Your fishes will thrive even when you're busy doing other things ✨✨Features✨✨ 🥚 Growth Cycle Every fish starts as a tiny egg. You’ll see them wiggle, hatch, and slowly grow into adults — each stage is its own little moment to enjoy. 🕶️ Dress them up Give your fish some style with hats, glasses, and fun accessories, making each one feel unique and full of character. 💞  Breed and discover new fish Let your fish reproduce and pass down traits to their babies. Your aquarium grows seaweed fast, and it’s up to you to cut it back! Luckily, your fish munch on the extra plants, helping you keep the tank clear and lively. 🐙 The octopus market A strange but merchant with plenty of goods. Buy food, toys, and odd accessories that add charm (and weirdness) to your aquarium. 🌳 Skill tree! (because everything’s better with a skill tree) Expand your aquarium through a set of upgrades. Unlock perks, change the behaviour of your fish, and customize your experience however you want! 🖼️ Wallpaper mode Choose how your aquarium lives on your desktop. Let the fish swim over your windows like an overlay, or place them behind everything as a living wallpaper. Dive into the fun, explore endless fishy combinations, and bring your desktop to life with your own vibrant, swimming friends!

title: Outcity
shortDescription: Tired of big city life, you move to Outcity to start fresh in the countryside. Build your farm your way in a cozy sandbox where imagination has no limits and friendly villagers help your homestead grow into a thriving village. Gather your determination, your creativity, and get to work!
fullDescription: Welcome to Outcity! Outcity is a cozy sandbox farm simulator where creativity grows as freely as the crops you plant. Start fresh in the countryside, transform untamed lands into your dream homestead, and build a thriving community from the ground up. 🌱 Build your dream farm from scratch on wild, untamed lands. 💬 Assign villagers to help farm, gather, defend, and grow your settlement. 🗺️ Explore vast biomes and unlock new regions filled with unique resources. 💀 Experience light nighttime raids as mischievous skeletons target your farm. 💎 Discover rare treasures in endlessly generated underground caves. 🎣 Fish in tranquil lakes and collect rare catches. 🏡 Customize every detail of your homestead with total creative freedom. ✨ Unlock over 140 upgrades across farming, fishing, construction, automation, combat, and more! Build Without Limits Create anything you can imagine, from a cozy cottage garden to a sprawling countryside metropolis. Tidy layouts, artistic designs, creative chaos — every path, field, and decoration is yours to shape. Outcity gives you the freedom to express your style and build the countryside world you've always imagined. Explore and Expand Across Unique Biomes Your journey will take you through lush meadows, arid hillsides, and fertile lowlands. Each region offers exclusive crops, valuable resources, and new opportunities for expansion. Venture into fresh territories, discover what the land has to offer, and let your creativity shape every corner of the map. Grow Through Deep and Meaningful Progression The land is alive — and as you learn to care for it, your world grows with you. Outcity features over 140 upgrades spanning farming, fishing, construction, automation, exploration, and light combat. Each one enriches the way you plant, build, gather, and defend, creating a natural sense of progression that unfolds as you play. Experiment with soil types, irrigation systems, and planting strategies to help your farm flourish, or unwind with peaceful fishing and quiet exploration in search of hidden secrets scattered throughout the valley. A Living Community That Works With You As your farm expands, the valley fills with life. The townsfolk who settle nearby aren’t just decoration — they’re part of your world. Build relationships, enjoy light moments of flirtation, and assign villagers to help with farming, harvesting, gathering, and even protecting your land. Their support adds a relaxed layer of strategy and helps your settlement feel like a true community growing together. A Peaceful Valley… Most of the Time When night falls and the valley grows quiet, mischievous skeletons begin to wander. Some appear tucked into hidden corners of the world, while others emerge near your farm, targeting crops, fences, and anything left unguarded. They’re more playful than terrifying, but they bring just enough trouble to keep evenings interesting. Choose how you want to handle them: defend your homestead with crafted tools, rely on helpful villagers to fight alongside you, or stay safely indoors until morning if you prefer a quieter night.  Uncover Treasures and Rare Resources Beneath Outcity’s peaceful farmland lies a vast network of endlessly generated caves, each one deeper and more rewarding than the last. Venture underground to uncover legendary seeds, powerful tools, precious minerals, and ancient artifacts hidden throughout mysterious caverns. Every trip underground opens new possibilities for growth, creativity, and adventure. This is Outcity Your refuge. Your pace. Your world. No pressure. Just creation, exploration, and the satisfaction of building something that's genuinely yours!

title: Fields of Fortune
shortDescription: Leave the everyday stress behind and start a new, relaxed life on a peaceful island. Build structures and craft new items, manually or with automation. The choice is yours. This is your island.
fullDescription: 🌱 Plant, nurture, and build smart production chains! In Fields of Fortune, you decide how you want to play. Relaxed and hands-on, or step by step through automation. Through quest lines with short dialogues directly in the game, you’ll learn about new tools, machines, and systems, without time pressure and without complicated tutorials. Gently automated, if you want. Fully relaxed, when you need it. ⚙️ Automation you truly understand Automation is a core part of Fields of Fortune, but it’s introduced gradually and in a playful way. You start with simple processes and learn step by step: Conveyor belts for automatic transport Splitters for precise distribution Machines to process your resources Many systems are unlocked and explained through quests, directly in the game. 🪓 Professional logging, fully automated Your little harvest bot takes care of the work: cuts down trees plants new saplings automatically transports logs onward Via conveyor belts, the logs are delivered straight to the sawmill, where they are processed into lumber fully automatically. Neat, sustainable, and surprisingly cute. 🏗️ From idea to production chain What starts small grows with you. Combine conveyor belts, splitters, and machines into large, fully automated production chains that process multiple resources at once and keep your farm supplied long-term. Plan your layouts, optimize routes, and watch an idea turn into a working system. 🏛️ The Academy to deepen your knowledge As you progress through the game, you unlock the Academy. Here you can gradually learn all four disciplines: 🐾 Animal Care 🌱 Plants ⚗️ Alchemy 🌿 Herbs Each specialization unlocks new buildings, recipes, and possibilities. Within each discipline, however, you make conscious talent choices, allowing you to shape your playstyle individually without missing out on content. 🚤 Set sail and discover new islands Sail to procedurally generated islands full of surprises. Discover new plants and herbs, encounter strange animals, and find hidden treasures. Everything you collect can be brought back home. Who knows what the next island holds? 🏝️ Your own paradise, the way you want it You start small, with a few tools and a big idea. You freely place fields and buildings, developing your land piece by piece, by hand or through automation. In town, you can trade, take on tasks, and earn rewards. Animals are also part of your farm. You take care of food, water, and enclosures, and collect what they provide. Relaxed or optimized, you decide how you play. 🧩 Features at a glance 🌾 Calm pixel world focused on farming, crafting & animal care ⚙️ Deep, guided automation with conveyor belts & machines 🧑‍🌾 Professions & specializations through the Academy 🏗️ Large production chains from small to complex 🏝️ Procedurally generated islands with new resources ✨ seasonal events 🕊️ No combat, no time pressure. Play at your own pace ⭐ Now in Early Access Fields of Fortune is now available in Early Access. Play it now and help shape the game with your feedback.

title: Dreamcards
shortDescription: A roguelike deckbuilder about dreams. Choose cards, by combining 6 different strategies during the day, and at night build your deck while facing the nightmare, to uncover a great mystery.
fullDescription: Explore the world of dreams in this esoteric roguelike deckbuilder . In the battle against the nightmare, use your cards to apply effects and combos that will lead you to victory. Build a unique deck each campaign by interacting with distinct characters and acquiring new cards. Here, deckbuilding decisions happen both before and during matches: every choice matters! Throughout the match, buy cards from the shop and manipulate the flow of your deck, making it smoother and stronger. The match is divided into action and buy phases . In the action phase, you use your cards to move through your deck and accumulate imagination points . These points are used to acquire cards during the buy phase and power up your deck. The game features over 100 unique cards divided into 6 different strategies that can be mixed as you like Your goal in the match is to accumulate conscience points during the acquisition phase. Use these points to reach a lucid dream state and defeat the monster . Surpass the monster’s score for 7 nights to get rid of it—but be careful! If you fail even one night, the monster will overpower you with a nightmare. The cards represent actions and characters from your daily life with whom you interact during the day . At night, you use these cards in your dream, creating a bizarre narrative with unexpected interactions between characters and actions. Discover the dark memories linked to each card in this roguelike deckbuilder with hand-drawn illustrations and cards created by the main character themself: The Self .

title: Trials Survivors
shortDescription: Fight through endless hordes in trials bestowed by constellation patrons. Upgrade skills, collect relics, and craft broken builds in true roguelite fashion! Rediscover the fantasy behind the words hack and slash and bullet heaven. Will you survive the densest monster Survivor-like ever created?
fullDescription: Shape your experience - Your way Trials Survivors is a roguelite that fuses the simplicity of survivor-style gameplay with the loot-driven depth of hack and slash RPGs. Each skill is hand-crafted and endlessly upgradeable, letting you forge unique builds as you face trials set by the constellations. Overcome the odds, embrace the loot, and ascend into an unkillable god. As an agent of the stars, you must complete their Trials, survive impossible odds, and push back the encroaching darkness. Choose from multiple archetypes to define your starting loadout. Your main spell is aimed manually, while all other spells auto-target nearby enemies, letting you focus on movement, survival, and securing loot. Each run is divided into Trials , cosmic challenges that test your skills, such as surviving for 3 minutes or defeating a set number of elite enemies before time runs out, escort relics or destroy ominous totems... Completing Trials rewards you with experience and upgrades. Collect new spells, enhance your powers, and build devastating synergies to unleash chaos. Collect Relics , powerful remnant of power that boost any of your stats. Relics are a part of the  permanent progression and unlock more  player power in every run... Each relics has an associated cost, leveling gives you increased relics capacity and it's up to you to shape the fantasy you want to play. Also, there is no level cap , you can keep leveling to infinity and beyond . Each Relic grants stats : from global additional projectiles , to increased pierce , extra chain count , bonus damage , and more ! If a stat exists on a spell, chances are there’s a Relic that can supercharge it. The result? Absolute build freedom, and total disregard for visual clarity. We love monster density . This game was built from the ground up to handle absurd numbers of enemies and projectiles on screen. Our dream? To let you craft an overpowered build worthy of the greatest Hack&Slash games, in under 30 minutes of survival gameplay . And we truly believe we can deliver on that promise. If that sounds like your kind of chaos, we’d love to have you on board. fullDescription: The cozy yet deadly farming game that marries relaxation and base defense in a bright post-apocalypse. Plant, nurture, and decorate your little refuge by day. Hold the line by night. You are Rory, a stubborn farmer trying to survive in this world. When The Fall happened, you went into cryosleep and waited for the right time to wake up. Now that you are awake, you are supplying food to the survivors. Let go of the stress and relax with this simple and satisfying gameplay. Grow crops, sell your harvest, and reinvest in seeds, tools, and upgrades to slowly turn a tiny homestead into a flourishing refuge. Start with a limited farm and expand it plot by plot, unlocking new crops, decorations, and mechanics along the way. Make it grow bigger and more beautiful until you have the best farm there is. Night brings waves of Unfed. They will breach your walls to get inside, so clever layout and strong defenses matter more than ever. Build barricades, turrets, traps, and use your super Death Mecha to defend your farm against a variety of zombies, each with different effects and unique ways of disrupting your farming experience. Once the night is over, repair your walls through mini-games and rise again! Unlock new farm upgrades and optimize your production. Less water consumption? More crops produced? Faster-growing crops? More firepower for your Mecha? You can have all that and make your experience smooth and unique. Having an optimized farm is cool, but having a beautiful, optimized farm is better! Decorate and customize your farm to feel at home, even in the middle of an apocalypse of the Unfed. Now that you know what's waiting for you in Can't Stop Rory, let's build the best farm in history!

title: Cozy Farm Manager
shortDescription: Cozy farming meets management sim - Hire and develop a team of farmhands, fulfill major contracts, combat pests with chemicals or biodiversity, and manage a limited water supply. Grow your farm’s reputation through thoughtful planning, sustainable choices, and smart business decisions!
fullDescription: Take charge of your own thriving farm where every decision counts - Balance worker satisfaction with productivity, develop specialized staff, commit to the right contracts, control your farm’s pest population, manage your water supply, and choose how your farm evolves as your reputation grows! Will you focus on biodiversity and building a skilled workforce, or streamline operations through chemicals and advanced technology? The future of your farm is in your hands. Visit your local TalentCo recruiting agency every day to see potential new hires with unique skillsets and salary expectations Assign jobs to your farmhands: Let them handle basic tasks around the farm like watering, harvesting, building, mining, chopping, and caring for livestock! Ensure you have the cash to pay your farmhands’ daily salaries, or their happiness will fall, and they may quit the farm Challenge your team members with new tasks! This will develop their skillsets over time Approve or decline their day-off and raise requests – Will you risk their happiness to save on productivity and salary costs? Keep in mind the happiness of your workforce can boost or damage your farm’s reputation over time! Just like real farming, pests are a constant threat to your crops. Once they get a foothold, they can spread to neighboring crops, and eventual wipe out entire fields! Plant a diverse range of crop types to slow pests Attract predatory insects (butterflies, bees, and dragonflies) by growing flowers, and building apiaries - Let them “manage” the pests! Build chicken coops and encourage your chickens to wander around your crops – Pests make for great chicken feed! Spray pesticide to eliminate pests – A costly option but is extremely effective Water sources can run dry. Yes, even your starting pond Precious rain not only waters your crops for the day but replenishes your water stores Build rain barrels and water towers to collect as much rain as possible on rainy days Keep an eye on the weather forecast to plan for upcoming rainfalls and inevitable droughts Run underground piping and connect your sprinklers to water stores. Be mindful though! Sprinklers can use a lot more water than a water jug Start out by selling your farm’s products to the local farmer’s market Commit to major contracts with traveling company reps - After all, the local farmer’s market can only buy so much of your harvest Fulfill contract requirements and meet deadlines to grow your farm’s reputation. But don’t overcommit! A missed contract can be very damaging to your farm’s reputation Do you want to improve your workforce, unlock farm tech, expand your biodiversity, or upgrade your business acumen? Decide your farm’s evolution at every reputation level-up Unlock staffing upgrades to grow and enhance your team of farmhands Unlock farm technology like sprinklers, water pumps, tillers and seed spreaders to expand your farm through technological advancement Unlock and upgrade crops & buildings to strengthen your farm’s biodiversity and sustainability Unlock business enhancements like upgrading the local farmer’s market or improving contract opportunities to increase sales!

title: Timber Life
shortDescription: Build and customize your homestead of timber, crops, and animals, while you manage the eco diversity of a small town. Go off exploring and foraging in the woods while evading predators. Craft goods and get to know the local townsfolk in this wholesome and cozy farming life sim.
fullDescription: Overview Build and customize your homestead of timber, crops, and animals, while you manage the eco diversity of a small town. Go off exploring and foraging in the woods while evading predators. Craft goods and get to know the local townsfolk in this wholesome and cozy farming life sim. Features in the game already: Customize your character to reflect your taste, with virtually unlimited combinations!  Select a character background to give your character a story, complete with stat modifiers for the different skills. For example, an artisan will gain crafting experience at a faster rate but combat experience at a slower rate. Every plant in the game has a health value determined by several factors including sun/shade, temperature, water, and more. At the start of the game, only maple and pine trees are part of the ecosystem along with invasive shrubs. You must work to bring back the biodiversity into the system to help the animals return and the town thrive. Be sure to grow a wide variety of crops and fruits on your farm, and check out the beautiful wildflowers in the summer! The year is divided into 8 different seasons (Early/Late Spring, Early/Late Summer, Early/Late Fall, Early/Late Winter) on the calendar, but the weather shifts dynamically as the year progresses. Leaves change and fall based on individual trees rather than all at once. Rainfall impacts the amount of water in the soil, which in turn impacts plant health, and temperature can dictate which plants will thrive and when.  Each forest tree has a separate item to forage which is only available at certain times of the year and tree seeds only drop when the real life equivalent tree typically drops seeds, so you must remain active with your foraging. There are also 5 different wild berry bushes and 11 different wildflowers that will spawn and grow across the map, once introduced to the environment. The map is already quite large, with more areas planned to be added! Animals play a key role and are also dynamic. There will be farm animals for which you can care (and take advantage of their byproducts or meat production), along with wild animals that you can watch for fun or hunt for meat.  But be careful if you're out deep in the woods or at night, because the predators will also be out hunting! There is a real estate progression system, whereby you can start by renting a room at the inn each night, or save up to buy your own property. There is 1 apartment and 1 house in town, and then 6 different open plots of land of various sizes (and prices). On the open plots, you can build homes and accessory buildings as you build your homestead, small farm, timber property, or ranch. Crafting is a big part of the game, as you can collect resources while foraging, mining, or lumberjacking. Those resources can then be used to create all kinds of products and goods that you can sell for a profit. Plus there's plenty of foods to cook with either supplies from the grocer or the ingredients you grow! The town may be small, but there's plenty to do. First, stop in the tavern & inn to get a bite to eat and a bed to sleep. Then be sure to head over to do some shopping at the carpenter's shop where you can buy furniture or use the sawmill to convert logs into planks (until you get your own sawmill!), the grocery store to get ingredients for cooking, the farm and garden store to buy seeds, and the hardware store to buy tools. There's also a local doctor who will help if you get attacked by a bear, and a cemetery to explore, though be sure to bring a flashlight if you go at night! Roadmap There's still much to be done before release and a detailed roadmap will be shared here soon.  Be sure to wishlist the game to follow along with development. In the meantime, here's a list of additional planned features: More wild animals Farm animals Pets Fishing Random Forageables Library in town Dynamic NPCs UI improvements Shrines / Religion System Expanded Forest Beach area Cave(s) More crops More buildings More crafting stations Extensive Steam Achievements & More!

title: Rift Wizard 3
shortDescription: Rift Wizard is a hardcore combat strategy roguelike and wizard simulator featuring an extremely deep build system. Customize your Wizard with more than 500 spells and magical artifacts. Blast, summon, or enchant your way through 20 levels of pure turn based chaos.
fullDescription: Rift Wizard 3 is a tough as nails traditional roguelike wizard simulator. You play as an immortal amnesiac wizard who must journey through the cosmos to defeat his nemesis. Each run, you'll build a new repertoire of spells and magical artifacts, discovering new and powerful synergies. Rift Wizard uses an open build system, and allows the player to buy any spell or spell upgrade at any time. This gives the player massive flexibility, allowing them to test out new ideas each run. Try blasting apart your foes with fire and/or lightning, summoning hordes of metallic constructs, or once you're bored of the simple stuff, delve deep into obscure arcane metamagical trickery. Rift Wizard's unique portal system means the player always has agency over what challenges they face. You choose which levels to visit, where to start, and how to spend your resources. There is no stealth or stair dancing in Rift Wizard: you must face each level head on and obliterate your foes with whatever tools you possess. Rift Wizard eschews randomness and complex combat formulas in favor of puzzle-like simplicity, where every game piece is easily understandable. Every victory is earned, every death deserved. New to Rift Wizard 3 is a deep and strategic crafting system. You will find a vast assortment of crafting components strewn across the ruins of the universe, which can be combined to form powerful magical artifacts giving passive buffs to the wizard. The player must make difficult choices about how to allocate their limited and diverse magical resources, with rare crafting ingredients even having unique impacts on the crafted item. The craftable equipment has a wide variety of effects, ranging from stat bonuses to event triggers. Most passive skills and equipment from the previous games have been brought back in some form as craftable equipment, and more than a hundred new items have been added to the game. Make lightning fly out of your arcane damage, commandeer enemy spawners, give your demon summons fire breath, the possibilities are endless! Rift Wizard 3 adds a slew of new enemies and bosses to the game, from the spry and pushy Leghead to the alien and terrifying Void Child, from old favorites like Slazephan the Serpent Philosopher to new legends like the vengeful nature god Gaia. The final boss encounters, including Mordred himself, have been greatly expanded and revised as well. The goal of Rift Wizard 3 is to continually place the player in high pressure tactical situations that challenge their creativity and analytic abilities, and to create a strategic sandbox that rewards brilliance, experimentation, and adaptation to constantly changing circumstances. With every installment in the series, we push farther towards this goal, and we are quite happy to share the depth we have created in Rift Wizard 3.

Enter a code to enjoy real-time battles together. Forget the “Meta”, Roguelite "Full Draft" System Roguelite Recruitment: Every match in Three Kingdoms:BOND begins with a fresh set of possibilities. Strategic Cost Management: Carry over resources for future rounds. Risk for Reward: Pick weaker units early to build late-game power. Unique Tactical Synergies: Build "miracle formations" that only work in the moment. No fixed strategies, no "Meta" sites. Every match sparks a completely new strategy. Ultimate Mind Games: Find the "Perfect Placement“ Victory is decided before the clash begins. Study your opponent’s formation in advance and place your generals on the grid-based battlefield to counter their strategy. Success depends on reading unit counters, skill ranges, and potential for ambushes.  Three Pillars Unit Counters Cavalry → Strong against Archers Archers → Strong against Spears  Spears → Strong against Cavalry "Hide Cavalry behind Spears for a surprise charge. Once deployment ends, the fight plays out entirely on the accuracy of your strategy and positioning - ultimately your decisions as battlefield commander. title: Out Past the Horizon
shortDescription: A farming life sim with realistic graphics. Carve a modern homestead out of the countryside — till, plant, water, harvest — then gather, craft, cook, and build it into a home. And when the day's work is done, head online for a farming mini-game with friends and Strangers.
fullDescription: ' Out Past the Horizon '  is a farming life sim built with realistic graphics and a hands-on, third-person feel. You arrive with almost nothing: a stretch of overgrown land, a few worn-out tools, and a long first day ahead of you. What happens next is up to you — and to how hard you're willing to work. 🌱 Work the Land Farming here is physical. Walk your field, till each row with your hoe, plant what you can afford, and keep it watered — crops respond to the care you actually give them, and every stage of growth shows on the plant. Time your harvest right and the market will reward you. Let things dry out and you'll be eating your mistakes. 🪓 Live Off the Land The land gives more than crops. Fell trees for timber, break rocks for stone and ore, and haul it all home to your workbench. Craft the tools and gear you need, cook real meals from what you grow and gather, and slowly turn "surviving" into "living well." 🔨 Build It Your Way Your farm is yours to shape. Place buildings, expand your storage, and grow a patch of dirt into a working homestead. Earn money at the shops in town, reinvest it in better tools and bigger plans, and dress your character the way you want — this is your life, live it in style. 🌇 A World That Keeps Its Own Time The day-night cycle isn't a backdrop — it's your schedule. Mornings are for the field, afternoons for town, and when the sun goes down the world doesn't stop: shops close, the light turns golden, the music changes, and the local nightclub opens its doors. Just don't dance too long. The crops don't care that you were out late. ⚡ Farm Rush — Competitive Online Farming Think you're fast with a watering can? Prove it. Farm Rush is the online competitive mode: a timed head-to-head where every player gets the same field, the same seeds, and the same clock. Till, plant, water, harvest, and sell in a race where greed is a strategy — hold your crops for a bigger payday, or sell early and often and watch your rivals overextend. Easy to learn, ruthless to master. ✨ Features [*] A full farming loop with visible, hands-on care — till, plant, water, and harvest crops that show their growth [*] Realistic 3D graphics and a grounded, modern-day setting [*] Gathering, crafting, and cooking — chop trees, mine rock, and turn raw materials into meals and gear [*] Building and progression — place structures, expand storage, and grow your homestead [*] Earn and spend — town shops, a real economy, and character clothing to make it yours [*] A living day-night cycle with dynamic music — and a nightclub for when the work is done [*] Farm Rush: fast, competitive online farming matches against other players [*] Play the main game entirely offline, at your own pace 🗺️ The Road Ahead [ Out Past the Horizon ] is in active development. The core farm, the town, and Farm Rush are playable today, and the world is growing with every update — more crops, more things to build, and more reasons to stay up past sundown. Co-op farming with friends is on the roadmap. Wishlist and follow to watch it grow.

title: Sky Homestead

fullDescription: Sky Homestead is a cozy farming and automation game set on a chain of floating islands. Three hundred years ago the Skychain shattered. The bridges fell, the beacons went dark, and the islands drifted apart. Someone has left you a letter, a rickety cottage on the last lit isle, and a very old to-do list. Farm the floating fields Till, plant, water, harvest. Fifteen crops, from honest pumpkins to crystalbuds that only grow where the Hum runs strong — the current of crystal energy that once held the Skychain together. Automate the cozy way Chop the wood yourself, or build a line that does it while you're somewhere else. Over 35 machines — furnaces, crafters, smelteries, mills — chain into production lines, fed by haulers and powered by the Hum. Start with one furnace. End with an island that runs itself. A crew with names Pip the Lumberjack. Tansy the Farmer. Hire helpers who arrive with their own tools, pay them in gold and hot meals, and watch them walk home to their cottages at dusk. They keep working whether you're watching or not. Rebuild the Skychain Multiple hand-built islands, each holding ruins that remember what they were. Fund the Restoration Board, watch bridges rebuild themselves plank by plank, and meet the villagers who come home when the lights come back on. Over 100 objectives across roughly 30 hours. Sail the sky Chart routes for cargo balloons hauling bulk freight between islands, and send nimble drones point-to-point. A frozen crest, a witchwood, a volcanic forge-isle — each with its own economy to wake up. Delve when you dare Beneath the oldest island lies the Deep Barrow: procedurally generated, unlit, and full of things that were left down there for a reason. Bring a sword, bring a lantern, come home with soul crystals. Or don't go at all — the farm doesn't mind. A note from the one-person crew Sky Homestead is made by a single developer. Everything you see here — screenshots, trailer, all of it — is the game as it stands today, and it will keep getting better right up to launch and beyond. The north pole of the planet Saturn has a hexagonal storm cloud pattern with 8,600 mile long sides, larger than the diameter of Earth. Though hexagon may appear to be a difficult word to rhyme, there are actually dozens of words that rhyme with it. fullDescription: Experience cinematic kung-fu battles in the fastest, most intense brawler the indie world has ever seen! With the unique 1:1 response system of One Finger Death Punch, players will feel the immediate feedback of every bone-crunching hit. Pay tribute to the masters using five classic kung-fu styles mixed with additional weapons. Combine face-to-face combat with throwing weapons to recreate complex fight choreographies or just send bad guys flying through glass windows. Explore a world map with over 250 stages, 13 modes, and 3 difficulty levels. Unlock 21 different skills that can be combined in thousands of ways to assist you in your journey. Put your kung-fu to the ultimate test in the survival mode. One Finger Death Punch is a game you can “feel”. The direct connection between your mouse and your character on the screen will be a new experience for many players. When you string together a long, complex string of kills, it feels like something “you” did rather than something the game let you do. When you play it you feel like you’re actually playing a Xiao Xiao stick animation video. We took inspiration from every kung-fu film we’ve seen. Every bit of effort was poured into delivering an easy to play game that was as addictive to play as Tetris. Every Press Matters! DO NOT BUTTON MASH! One of the biggest challenges we had while making the game is stopping the player from button mashing. When our friends play tested our game they’d instinctively button mash, they couldn’t help themselves. It must have been the many years of playing other brawlers that engraved it in their minds the notion of rapidly pressing buttons to kill your foes. The game’s designed in such a way that if you button mash, you die. Every press matters. Although playing the game should still be simple, you see a bad guy in front of you, you attack him, he dies. If you punch even once when there’s no enemy in front of you, you’re going to miss. If you miss, chances are you’re going to get hit. It’s a simple system but it’s ruthless to button mashers. We spent much time setting up visual and audio queues as well as many warnings trying to steer players away from their natural button mashing tendencies.

In each game mode, players control characters in a sea of identical NPCs. Players are given a task, but also the means to eliminate each other from the game. title: Planet Centauri
shortDescription: Dive into an epic adventure alone or with friends! Explore hidden dungeons, capture and tame fearsome monsters, build and defend your village. Craft powerful weapons, master magical spells, and transform an planet into the cradle of a new civilization!
fullDescription: Embark on your greatest adventure to Planet Centauri! Discover new biomes, explore hidden dungeons, capture and tame monsters, build and protect an NPC community, craft your own weapons, and create your own magic spells! Save and protect the native Chloridian species from the evil Night Walkers! Develop and raise the Planet Centauri to the heavens as the cradle of a new civilization! Catch them all! Capture and tame monsters! Your new companions will support you and will evolve to become stronger! Each captured creature keeps its unique features, will evolve as it gains experience fighting by your side, and will even be able to have children if you find him/her a partner! Transformations Captured monsters can be sealed and thus, allowing you to transform into almost any monster in the game. Some monsters have unique abilities that you can use to your advantage, like flying or digging through the ground. Breeding Captured monsters can be placed in tiny houses containing a pocket world that can be modified to the taste of its occupants. When the monsters are happy, they will gain experience and occasionally, if all conditions are met, lay an egg. Traits from the parents will be inherited, allowing you to breed the perfect monster. Suffixes, characteristics, and runes Use runes to enchant your equipment with various stats and effects! Level up your equipment by killing monsters or with magical crystals. Weapons and armors share 7 levels of rarity! Higher rarity always comes with stronger, and more unique effects and characteristics! Monsters also happen to have rarity levels, rarer monsters being much more powerful and dangerous than their common counterparts, with unique abilities and reinforced stats. Challenge the RNG by using currencies to get the perfect traits on your equipment. Skills A wide range of skills enables you to fight with great mobility. Some skills can be chained, making combos possible. Elemental swords have synergy with skills. You can unlock elemental skills for each type of element (fire, ice, stone, electric, shadow, light), offering a wide variety of combinations. Classes Equipping a full armor set unlock new skills and abilities, making each of them useful in it's own way. From the miner to the shadow hunter, discover all classes by crafting all armor pieces! Equipment can be leveled to be useful at any time of the game. No set will be left behind! Craft your own magic spells! From controlling the arc and pattern of your fireballs to simply enhancing your survival abilities, craft a plethora of magical effects to fit your desires. Each magical element have it's forces and weaknesses: Fire spells are destructive and can burn enemies or the environment Ice spells can freeze and pierce through multiple enemies Electric spells are very fast and can electrify Stone spells will project monsters or petrify them Light spells are good for healing Shadow spells can follow enemies and pass through them Multiple elements can be combined in the same spell and monsters may have weakness to some elements. Spells are combined through an event system in a live editor with a lot of options. They can also be shared to your friend through base64 text. It's as easy as copy and paste. Agriculture and Cooking Eat well to get stronger has never been a more truthful quote than in Planet Centauri. Eating various types of food will cause your character to grow stronger and develop his abilities. Alchemy Extract essences from any plant, flower, vegetable or monster part to combine them into power full potions. Each essences is related to specific effects and can be used to craft related potions: life, magic, energy, regeneration, vitality, resistance, power and haste. Build a village and assign roles and jobs to its inhabitants Save the native Chloridians, build and fortify their villages. Befriend them and grant them jobs as Cooks, Guards, wizards, researchers and much more! An industrial area begins Build windmills or enslave chickens to generate mechanical energy to power your machines and transmit it through cogs and belts. Recycle materials, craft unique resources and upgrade your high friction cogs from wood to steel. Build mechanical systems using: Generators (windmill blades, chicken wheels, hand-cranks) Various kind of cogs (one way, double cogs, switches) Belts to connect cogs, build gear trains to increase torque or speed Pipe conveyors to transport items Circular saws and tracks to place themto cut trees automatically Pressure plates and mechanized doors Various machines like milling or crusher machines, table saw, block maker... Create without limits with our unique circuit design system! Planet Centauri's magitech allows you to design various electronic systems, from humble automated house lighting to calculators or even CPUs! This is achieved through an unique 'pipe' system to transmit soul energy up to 9 bit information signal and a large number of components, including: Generators harvesting soul energy from the environment Crystalizers to condensate energy to generate even more energy Teleporters Battery systems to store energy Lights, pixels, displays, Sensors and different kind of inputs Logical operators (not, and, or...) Mathematical operators (full adder, modulo, div, comparators) ACD, DAC, encoders, decoders, mux... Memories (flipflop, latch, 8-bit registers, counters) ROMs, using blocks placed in the world as a memory storage Transistors Here is actually the classic Game of Life cellular automaton implemented in magitech. Progression In Planet Centauri you won't be bothered by mandatory tutorials, linear progression or any forced main quest. Explore anything in the order you want, as long as you are able to survive. Be guided by the completion tree or the tutorial pages to explore all possibilities offered to you. Special challenges and ruins The world is filled by ancient ruins. On most of them, special challenges await you. Dungeons Discover unexplored dungeons full of traps. Maybe something unique and incredible will be found there. Construction With over 500 different type of blocks and decorative items, let your imagination run wild to build detailed or imposing structures. Any block can be shaped into a multitude of different slopes, or colored using paint. When a block is shaped, It is possible to combine it with another one. By combining double blocks and paint, possibilities are endless. Creative mode In creative mode you have access to developer tools, commands, terraformation, infinite items... Planet Centauri has a complex event system allowing you to create traps, spawn enemies and create complex mini games without coding. Currently, more than 20 different type of events and triggers exists. Event are like functions and perform a specific action. Triggers can emit different type of signals, and be connected to any other Event/Trigger: Zone triggers: Coming / Leave / ViewEnter / ViewLeave / ComingZone / LeaveZone Combat triggers: Spawn / KillMonsters / PlayerGetDamages / Challenge / Open Misc triggers: Counter / Switch / Chrono / ChronoLocal / PreciseTimer / Dice / HourChanged Event dispatching triggers: Hub / HubFilter / Dispatch / TimedDispatch BlockPattern to detect shaped structures (useful to make puzzles) DropItemsSouls CreateBlocks / DestroyBlocks / CreateDecorations / DestroyDecorations / Indestructible SpawnRope / SpawnTree / SpawnBall / SpawnLava Unlock / GenerateItems / ObjectAttributes / TriggerAttribute / AddAttributes / DisableLight SetPortal / WorldLocation SpawnOverride to modify permanently (or not) the world spawn tables Modding Steam workshop is not supported, but the game can be extensively modified. Any item in the game can be edited through text based configuration files in the PlanetCentauri/assets/moddable folder. You can add blocks, decorations, or any visual element without knowing a programming language. For more complex systems, like monsters or entities, the Lua programming language is used (like in Factorio, Hades, Don't Starve, Roblox, and a lot of games). The current limitation is the lack of a mod manager. This leads to potential problems and collisions between entries, and you have to distribute your mods manually.

fullDescription: From the creator of Don't Escape: 4 Days to Survive comes the original games that started it all. Don't Escape Trilogy contains all three of scriptwelder's original point-and-click horror adventures, compiled and preserved for Steam. Each small game within the anthology is a unique, standalone adventure that puts clever twists on every setting and format. PLEASE NOTE: These games do not contain any new content from their original versions. In Don't Escape , players find themselves in a remote cabin overlooking a tiny village. Before night falls, you'll need to find a way to effectively secure yourself inside the cabin, using everything at your disposal, in order to protect the townsfolk from yourself. Because when the full moon rises, you're not your best self... In Don't Escape 2 , you and your friend have barely suvived the undead ravaging your town, and must find a way to fortify the place you've holed up in before nightfall. Only problem is, the clock is ticking as you scour the surrounding countryside for supplies, and your friend isn't looking so great... In Don't Escape 3 , you awaken onboard a silent spaceship that holds a gruesome discovery. Without your memories, you need to find a way back home while unraveling the mystery of what happened to you and the crew, but are you really as alone as you think you are? Offering the top-notch atmosphere scriptwelder has become known for and creative puzzles and situations for you to overcome using logical problem solving skills, often with different solutions, the Don't Escape Trilogy is the perfect way to spend an evening with the lights turned down and the volume turned up. About the Developer: Poland-based developer Scriptwelder is a well known creator of creepy web-based games, perhaps the most iconic of which is the Deep Sleep series, which has won multiple awards and been played by millions all around the world. The Don't Escape series began as a web game in 2013 that inverted the classic escape-the-room formula... rather than trying to find a way out, players were instead trying to find a way to secure themselves within, usually from some sort of threat or danger. He recently released Don't Escape: 4 Days to Survive, his first full length premium game.

title: The Procession to Calvary
shortDescription: Pilfer from pirates, conspire with cardinals and perform miracles with an incompetent magician. The Procession to Calvary is a Pythonesque adventure game made from Renaissance paintings, and a spiritual successor to the critically acclaimed Four Last Things.
fullDescription: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for [just one more murder…] -Ecclesiastes 3:8 Story Huzzah! The holy war is over! Your oppressors have been vanquished, the churches of the Old God lay in ruin and thousands of innocent people have been murdered! But it's not all good news; the tyrant Heavenly Peter has escaped your clutches, and you have been tasked with the mission of finding him... Your journey will take you through a richly detailed landscape built from hundreds of different Renaissance paintings. You will steal a ship, feed a donkey, compete in a talent contest, assist an inept street magician, sing, dance, play the (magic?) flute, poke a man's face, hunt for treasure and have a chat with Our Lord God Almighty... But will you find Heavenly Peter? And if you do, how will you take your revenge!? Features Pointing and Clicking – A traditional point and click interface, with a 'verb coin' interaction menu and a simple inventory from which you can drag and drop your preciously hoarded items. Renaissance Artwork – Paintings by Rembrandt, Botticelli, Michelangelo and many more are brought together into one consistent world, in a way that is also as sympathetic as possible to the original works. Classical Music – a soundtrack selected to fit with the style of the artwork. Music from classical composers such as Vivaldi, Bach and George Frideric Handel will accompany you on your journey. Standalone Story – The Procession to Calvary is set in the same world as Four Last Things, but its story can be played independently. Optional Murder – You will be equipped with a sword. This will become useful in a number of different situations, but you will be strongly discouraged from using it on people. Ignoring this advice – and murdering anyone who stands in your way – will serve as a useful method of skipping any puzzles you don't like. But be warned; your actions might come back to haunt you... Nonsense – A style of humour reminiscent of the surreal, anarchic comedy of Monty Python. Lofty subject matter is treated with refreshing flippancy. Gags about butts are taken very seriously. But rest assured, while some of the jokes may be ridiculous, the puzzles make perfect sense! (or at least adhere to a consistent internal logic) Moments of Surprising Profundity – Actually, no... Don't read too much into it. Special thanks to SUPERHOT PRESENTS, whose support made this project possible.
