title: Wayward Strand
shortDescription: Wayward Strand is a heartfelt story told in a curious way. Hop aboard an airborne hospital and meet its fully-voiced cast of eclectic characters. As time passes for everyone on board, explore the interwoven lives of the patients and staff; discover something new on each and every playthrough.
fullDescription: Welcome to the Hospital It's the summer of 1978, and Casey Beaumaris is trying to make the most of her holidays, when her mum asks her to spend a long weekend helping out at the airborne hospital where she works. Casey prefers the company of books to people, but she agrees, secretly planning to write an article about her visit for the school newspaper. With her trusty notebook at the ready, Casey arrives on board the airship. The staff are overworked as they prepare for the visit of an important official, while the patients react to grief, or deal with active trauma. In the midst of these and many other interlocking and overlapping stories, Casey spends time with the patients, learning about their lives, and, as the stories unfold, discovering what she can do to help. Explore A Living World Within the world of Wayward Strand, time passes for everyone - characters continue their lives without waiting for you to interact with them. In Wayward Strand’s unique narrative structure, the stories of over a dozen characters constantly unfold around you in real time, as you, as Casey, roam freely throughout each day. Choose which story to be a part of by following people, having conversations , and exploring the hospital. The hospital’s residents are an eclectic cast of characters – some charming, some eccentric, some rude – each with their own desires, goals and imaginations. Every character moves and acts of their own accord, at their own pace, on their own timeline - sharing news with each other, arguing, joking, gossiping - or having a chat with Casey when she comes by. Every playthrough gives you the opportunity to discover something you didn’t see previously - what you missed the first time, you might see the second, third, or fifth time around. Your Journey When you see someone, you can follow them, to see where they go and what they get up to. You can eavesdrop on peoples’ conversations, or come into the room and be a part of the discussion. Spending time with particular characters will lead you to new storylines, locations, revelations and resolutions. As the journalist for her school newspaper, Casey keeps track of events and information in her notebook . Players use Casey’s notebook to delve deeper into peoples’ stories, to make new discoveries, and to piece together mysteries. fullDescription: Marnie is a young goth girl with a less-than-cheery disposition. Her parents are going away for a week of sun and surf in Bordeaux, and Marnie has been palmed off in her grandmother’s care in the backwater English village Fenchapel. Marnie isn’t much looking forward to her week in the sticks. Fenchapel is a small village with a population below 500, without any shops or cinemas. Marnie’s sure she’ll be bored out of her skull – and then, there’s her grandmother’s continued ravings about fairies. “Don’t venture too far into the forest,” Grandma Iris warns. “There are strange creatures in there, and if they find you, they’ll never let you leave.” Of course, Marnie ignores her grandmother’s warnings. Fairies don’t exist, after all – and Fenchapel is so tiny, what can she do other than explore? And so, Marnie wanders into the forest… While exploring, Marnie happens upon a young female knight in a glade, clutching a sword. The knight has been sleeping for many centuries, but Marnie (inadvertently) awakes her. The young knight calls herself Leofe. She does not know why she went to sleep, but she knows that the forest itself is plagued by a horrible curse, and she is the only one who can lift it. Together, the two young girls go on an adventure. They learn of Fenchapel’s storied past, and with the passing days, their feelings towards one another grow. Fenchapel, as it transpires, is far more interesting than Marnie imagined. 85,000 words of text (approx 4-6 hours of reading) A kinetic story with no choices or branches Detailed character and event artwork An entirely original soundtrack A sweet yuri love story A cute female knight!

fullDescription: In Armoured Commander II, you play the role of a tank commander in World War II, leading your crew through a campaign in one of the major conflicts of the war. The game features over 50 campaigns set between 1939 and 1945, and over 1300 unit types. The terrain map for each combat day, the weather conditions, and the types of enemies you encounter are randomly and procedurally generated, which means that each playthrough of a campaign will bring new and unexpected challenges. Your commander and crew gain experience and can improve their stats and gain skills over time, but they are also vulnerable to injury and may be seriously wounded or killed during the course of a campaign. Gameplay ArmCom2 is a game of survival rather than destruction. You will frequently find yourself outnumbered and outgunned. Your success in a campaign will depend on your ability to deal with a variety of challenges, and to make best use of all the tactics and tools that you have at your disposal. Different tanks, historical eras, and regions of the world will produce a very different play experiences, from the initial armoured clashes in Asia and Poland in 1939, to the final drive on Berlin and the Pacific Islands of the Japanese Empire in 1945. The gameplay is turn-based, so you can pause and consider your options at any point in the game. You can choose to take on the role of your Commander, meaning that if your Commander is killed in the game your campaign ends (Permadeath), or you can continue playing through an entire campaign, replacing your tank and crew as needed. Once a campaign ends, you can choose to continue with your crew in a new campaign. Different campaigns are designed to include historically-based vehicles for you to command, friendly support units, enemy units, and different types of missions. Some campaigns will be easier than others, and historical battles such as Kursk or Operation Overlord are included. The weather, terrain, and length of combat day will vary based on your location in the world and the date in the calendar. Mods are supported: an extension for the Vortex mod manager is available, or mods can be manually installed by the player. No DRM is used in the game and it will run without Steam connectivity if required (although achievements will not be recorded). The source code (excluding assets such as portraits, campaign and unit definitions) is open source and included with the game. No generative AI was used in creating this game.

Made in the best Indie tradition! Our game opens with the 12 animals of the Chinese Zodiac gathering for their annual Lunar New Year’s Eve party. Rooster’s terrible behaviour is finally too much for the animals to bear – especially when he makes Rabbit cry! Fed up, Dragon conjures a potion and sends Rooster back in time to Ancient China to teach him some lessons. As Rooster, you’ll meet Little Dove, a human whose life milestones provide reasons to help and make up with your Zodiac animal friends, just in time for a clean start and a happy Lunar New Year. Make wise choices along the journey, or risk being stuck in the past forever! Rooster is made possible with the support of the Canada Media Fund and Ontario Creates. Features Stunning art style inspired by Chinese brush painting with hilarious animation Engaging, Emotional story Gorgeous Original Soundtrack Designed For Accessibility Huge variety of gameplay with hidden object levels, puzzles, a dating sim, cooking, logic, dialogue choices, paper crafting, garden design, tower defence and the ultimate boss level - how to give a proper apology! Complete 12 levels – one for each Chinese Zodiac animal Level 1 - Rat In this hidden object level, make an apology basket for Rat, who loves to eat and is the sign of wealth and surplus. Level 2 - Ox In this hidden object and puzzle assembly level, find objects and solve a mystery with Ox, a hardworking and dependable friend. Level 3 - Tiger In this dating sim level, help find a wife for Little Dove. As the guardian of children, Tiger is a creative thinker, confident, and a little unpredictable – like turning an Ancient Chinese matchmaking situation into a game show. Level 4 - Rabbit In this hidden object/cooking level, Rabbit is usually quiet, elegant, kind, and friendly. But Rabbit’s hilarious reactions to your ingredient choices may prove otherwise as you help find the perfect ingredient for a special soup. Level 5 - Dragon In this cooking level, Dragon is a useful force in the kitchen, with magically-powered fiery and icy breath. As the symbol for luck and success, Dragon’s naturally-ingrained leadership will help get the job done … to a point. Then it’s on you. Level 6 - Snake Snake is usually able to calmly think of solutions amidst chaos … but not when it comes to babysitting. Help Snake choose a body shape to keep Baby safe in a gorgeous marketplace FULL of hazards. Level 7 - Horse In this transmutation level, energetic and carefree Horse needs help creating items for the human family that will create joy. Level 8 - Goat As the symbol of filial piety, purity, and kindness, Goat is on a poignant mission and needs help identifying hidden objects based on clues. Level 9 -Monkey Confident and careful, industriously crafty Monkey needs help with some paper crafts during a somber time. Level 10 - Dog Honest and smart, loyal Dog needs help cleaning up a decrepit garden and bringing it back to its sparkling glory. For now, in this Wordle-like game, solve the enigma by finding the correct sequence of 1 Arena and 4 feelings. The secret sequence is one specific out of 500,000 possible combinations! By thinking like a codebreaker, you can use your logical skills to narrow down the possibilities and find it. As in real life, luck can be useful, but the more you improve your strategy, the less you depend on it. At the end of your turn, you are invited to record your thoughts in your journal. From the solution choose one of the feelings, put it in the Arena, and write how you feel about it. Your personal journey will be available for you to view at any time! The cards include: - The 36 monsters from the Little Inner Monsters card game, representing the feelings and emotions we deal with in our daily lives; - The 6 Arenas representing different environments we can be. The enigma contains: an Arena, a Feeling that belongs to that arena, plus 3 other Feelings. Ths solution follows these rules: - The first position is an Arena; - The first feeling is related to that Arena; - There is no more than one feeling from the same Arena. Start from scratch and make your hypothesis. After entering a sequence, the feedback will show your correct and incorrect attempts: - Green: The feeling is in the correct position; - Yellow: the Feeling is in the solution, but the position is wrong; - Blue: the Feeling isn't present in the solution, but its Arena is in the correct position; - Red: the Feeling isn't present in the solution, and its Arena is not in that position. You have up to 8 attempts to find the solution (6 in the most challenging mode)! - When an enigma is solved, you can register your reflections about the Arena and one of the monsters, creating your personal gallery. - Calming background music related to the chosen arena. - The game is FREE and COMPLETE . Voices of those still trapped between life and death, waiting for someone to pick up the phone again. Words left unsaid, feelings never realized, and the people they wished they could see one last time. As Mary notes down these lingering regrets, chapter by chapter, she walks alongside the voices on the other end—and perhaps, you begin to see what truly matters as well. Metal Gear 2: Solid Snake 
This is the second title in the METAL GEAR series that establishes the basic mechanics of the series, such as crouching to avoid detection, intentionally attracting enemies by banging on walls, enemies reacting to Snake's footsteps, a radar to detect enemy locations, actions and movements.

title: Otome * Domain
shortDescription: An inconveniently orphaned young man must attend an all-girls school just to survive in this comedy visual novel. His housemates took him in when he was in trouble, but now he doesn't know who's taking care of who...!
fullDescription: When a guy loses his family, how’s he going to live...? He’ll have to go to an all-girls school just to survive in this wacky comedy visual novel! FEATURES 20+ hours of story Two branching heroine routes Japanese voice acting SUMMARY The protagonist is left alone in the world after his grandmother passes away. He is found by a young lady of his age who runs a school for promising gentlewomen, and with nowhere else to go, he ends up in an otherwise all-female dormitory. However, his new housefellows are all absolutely eccentric. Weren’t they the ones who rescued him ? Now he doesn’t know who’s taking care of who...! CHARACTERS The daughter of wealthy business tycoons, she was actually raised by Minato’s late grandmother, who was her maid at the time. Out of love and a sense of filial obligation, she assumes responsibility for Minato’s living expenses after hearing about his plight. Thanks to her rich parents owning the entire campus, she happens to be the board chair of the same school she attends as a student—Whitebell Girls’ Academy—and so conveniently enrolls Minato there, too. Despite her attempts to come off as a refined, elegant young lady, in many ways she’s surprisingly clumsy and below average. As her roommate, Minato soon discovers that she’s not only slow and socially awkward, but gets lost easily and needs her hand held for the simplest of tasks... Minato and Kazari’s classmate and dormmate, and the head of the school’s newspaper club. Another daughter of a prominent family, but unlike Kazari, she’s genuinely charming, friendly, and almost too accommodating to Minato... That might make it sound like she’s the ultimate Japanese tradwife, but when it comes to domestic chores, she’s beyond salvation. She’s also a terminally curious and surprisingly stubborn tomboy who tends not to sweat the small stuff—to the point where her dorm room is a constant pigsty. And as if that weren’t enough, she’s actually confident(!) about her terrible cooking... How can a girl so good at everything else be this catastrophic when it comes to household affairs?! Minato’s junior dormmate and a member of the library committee. Her family struck it big only recently and now controls an up-and-coming business enterprise. Despite being a “nouveau riche,” she has none of the usual smugness that comes with it. In fact, she’s too caught up in being a huge fantasy nerd and edgelord to really care about things like family standing or “having a decent personality” anyway... Speaking of edgy, she insists on calling herself “Zarathustra, General of the East.” Indeed, as one of the Demon Generals of the Four Heavenly Kings, she apparently already rules the world as we know it. Her story often changes, though, so sometimes she’s “about to invade” us in the near future, instead of already being in control. For all her constant cringiness, however, she’s actually not so bad underneath. Heck, she’ll even apologize if you tell her off hard enough, waterworks and all. The protagonist of this game! Left without anyone to rely on after the passing of his grandmother, he was taken in by Kazari and offered a roof over his head, as well as enrollment at her family’s all-girls school. Despite very much being a boy, when dolled up in a skirt he can easily pass for the fairer sex—even without the extra padding. While this god-given talent might help him move through his new school life undetected, he’s still loathe to accept how good a girl he makes... His hobbies and talents include cooking, cleaning, laundry, and other household chores. In fact, upon moving into the girls’ dorms, he assumed all domestic chore duties himself because he couldn’t bear to see the mess his housemother-less dormmates had made. For his troubles he was later voted “no. 1 ideal housewife” in a campus newspaper club poll. Sits next to Minato in class. Always cheerful and approachable, even towards people she’s only just met. She’s also thoughtful and considerate, easily getting along with most of her classmates. Close friends with Yuzu, who has also invited her to join the same newspaper club. Despite attending an expensive all-girls school, her family is not that well off and is struggling to pay her tuition. The plan was apparently to ensure that she’s raised with a little more class than they have been able to provide thus far... Unfortunately, though, her grades are at the bottom of the class, much to her parents’ dismay. Miyu, however, doesn’t seem too worried about it. Minato’s homeroom teacher and math instructor at Whitebell Girls’ Academy. Gets salty if you make jokes about her full name or age. Seems to have landed the unfortunate extra role of looking after Kazari. She’s even the overseer of Dorm II—Minato’s new home. It’s not like she wanted the extra responsibilities, however. She just found herself unable to leave the seemingly helpless board chair to her own devices... She has two go-to maxims: “I don’t wanna do work” and “Why do today what you can leave for tomorrow?” As a chronic slacker, she leaves all the housework chores, including looking after Kazari, to Minato once he moves in.

The Kami inhabit a surreal castle located between the human and spirit worlds. After each victory, Rei comes closer to the realm of spirits, starting to encounter peculiar characters from Japanese mythology. title: Dungeonpreneur
shortDescription: Live the life of a daring Dungeonpreneur and build your ultimate guild in this blend of dungeon crawling and business! Explore dungeons for rare loot and ingredients, and profit by running an item shop and tavern. Befriend locals, expand your guild, and uncover the secrets of this new fantasy world!
fullDescription: You find yourself in a strange new world on an island called Clover Island. Here you meet a small community of Elves, Goblins, Dwarves, and other humans going through everyday life together. In this new world, dungeons are a vital source of income, and Dungeonpreneurs are the daring adventurers who explore the ever-changing dungeons for their vast resources! As a Dungeonpreneur you live your everyday life by exploring dangerous dungeons to gather rare loot and exotic ingredients and use your findings to stock up your item shop and sell delicious meals in your tavern. Learn why you were brought to this world, fall in love with the kind townsfolk, save them from a terrible danger threatening their way of life, and grow your guild to reach the top of the guild rankings! Manage Your Guild Run a thriving item shop. Profit from your dungeon expeditions by selling loot items in your very own shop. Use your haggling skills to get the best deals! Cook delicious dishes to sell in your tavern. Serve the hungry patrons of Clover Island. Set the menu for the day by taking into account factors like which patrons will be visiting for the day. Complete dangerous and profitable contracts. Any half decent Dungeonpreneur knows the way to maximising profits: take well paying contracts to ensure your dungeon expeditions do not just rely on what you can loot. Help townsfolk to find rare items, clear out monsters, and anything else they can think of - for a price of course. Convince local townsfolk to join your very own guild. Each character living in Clover Island has their own specialities, and some might be swayed into joining your ambitious new guild. Use their skills to your advantage to grow your guild into a money-making powerhouse! Rise in the Guild Rankings. Each season the Guild Rankings take place. Your guild will be judged on your profit making abilities and achievements, so defeat your rivals and become the greatest guild of all time! Explore the World Explore this fantastical strange world. Get to know Clover Island, which desperately needs a successful Dungeonpreneur. The magically infused world you find yourself in has strange plants, fantastical beasts, many secrets and even more dangers. Conquer dangerous dungeons. Explore the four dungeons situated around Clover Island, each with its own monsters and loot. Each monster will require its own strategy to beat. Do not underestimate them: monsters are dangerous and have their own tactics to defeat unsuspecting adventurers. Magical shifting dungeons. No dungeon is ever the same! Their layouts constantly shift due to their magical properties. Can you keep your wits about you and get out safely with your loot? Make the tough calls on your expeditions: do you go forward for that one more floor and risk it all. Or do you return to town with what you got so far? Get to Know the Townsfolk Take a break from your adventures and get to know the Townsfolk. Meet dwarves, elves, goblins, fae, and humans in this strange fantastical world. They all play their own part for the town: running shops and guilds, guarding the island from monsters, fishing, farming, etc. Compete with rivals. Not everyone will embrace you and your guild with open arms. Compete with rival Dungeonpreneurs who will try to make their own profits at your expense. Contracts and dungeons are not a monopoly, so you will have to be quicker and smarter to beat the competition! Make friends and find love. Become friends with the locals, and perhaps even profess your love if you find that special someone. Note : This game is currently in early development. fullDescription: DEVIL BLADE REBOOT ●Overview Devil Blade, a 1996 indie shmup released only in Japan, has received a full remake almost a quarter century later by the original creator, taking advantage of the latest technology. Devil Blade Reboot strictly follows a strict design concept that pursues catharsis of shmups to the extreme. But, as they say... no pain, no gain! With the Berserk System, dangerous play is the way to climb the ladder, as high risk brings high reward. ●Features 【2D pixel art graphics with an obsessive level of detail.】 Rendered in the original native 320x240 resolution of the classics, but with visuals that defy the limits of pixel art! Dramatically increase the score... and the difficulty, by destroying enemies in close range! The difficulty level changes drastically depending on the way you play the game. fullDescription: Story  In a quiet English town, Ms. Meadows runs a cozy tea boutique. Once an accomplished journalist, she used her modest savings to open the shop. With no family and a few customers, Ms. Meadows fills her days listening to the stories of those willing to share. Each night, inspired by her encounters at the tea shop, Ms. Meadows writes her latest poem, after the nurse arrives to administer her medication. Sips and Sonnets lets you: Be a nice old lady. The "nice" part is not optional. Make a variety of teas. Learn more about each kind of tea as you play! Chat up customers from all walks of life. Draw inspiration from your daily interactions with your clientele to write your latest poem! Your choices matter! Choose wisely and see all multiple endings!  What to Expect: Fully voiced acted with talents from Baldur's Gate 3 ( Bethan Dixon Bate ) and Disco Elysium ( Lenval Brown ).  About 2-4 hours of gameplay.  Multiple endings. Several minigames.  Original soundtrack.  Inspired by our personal experiences with local tea shops across the United Kingdom, as well as countless wholesome interactions with kind and wise role models in our lives, this heartfelt visual novel tells a side less told, of a life well lived, and a youth come and gone. Sips and Sonnets is brought to you by Blue Tango Street, the same team that gave you the brief and humble experience of Backspace Backspace Backspace. This visual novel was made possible thanks to collaborating with a group of talented artists!

title: Burger Bois
shortDescription: Become Patty, the accidental owner of a failing food business. Craft tasty (or nasty) burgers, discover new ingredients, and work hard(ish) to redeem your reputation on the way to the best parking spot of all time. Play with your food in this cozy food truck simulator!
fullDescription: Life got you in a pickle? Are you always hanging on ’til fry-day? Got beef? Burger Bois is a food truck simulator game about flavor, not labor. Play as Patty, the accidental owner of a failing bespoke burger business, and take your business from gutter-to-butter!  Get the vibe for each customer, and design unique sandwiches from start to finish, crafting your customers’ most vague requests into culinary masterpieces. “Can I get that burger uhhhhhhh boneless? ” Customers of questionable taste will tell you the flavors, properties, and restrictions that you have to work with. It’s your job to create a bespoke burger that speaks to their stomach and soul. Discover unique real-world burger ingredients, and mix & match them to build the burger of your customers’ dreams (or nightmares). Plus, keep an eye out for collectible #FoodPic burgers! Experiment with ingredient combinations to unlock hidden artworks by beloved indie artists such as @sharkeesart, @nautilics and Lucy Mutimer. With your trusty grillmaster and de facto best friend Fry, you’ll manage your time across all your usual business activities. (Don’t worry! No real-world timers are involved.) Serve customers, shop around, clap back at reviews, post food crimes online, and best of all - slack off! Form relationships with regular customers and follow their stories as you plate up burgers that make or break their days. Serve up bangin’ burgs to get the good word a-spreadin’. Your reputation on the popular restaurant review website “Welp!” will change as you serve customers — and not always for the better.  Alongside growing your reputation, you’ll play BURGO to catch the attention of the Local Business Association and earn the right to bigger and better parking spots. With BURGO, reputation isn’t everything. You’ll get to choose your path to victory, be that by collecting ingredients, forging relationships with special customers, or committing culinary war crimes.  Your ultimate goal is simple: Take your back-alley burger business from the Truck Stop to the prime parking spot outside the Big Game.  -------------------------------------------------------- Burger Bois is a love letter to food and hospitality, with nods to many of our favorite media. We wanted to combine the food service of Good Pizza, Great Pizza , with the creative challenge of Sticky Business , and the quirky, comedic characters of 90s cartoons like Spongebob Squarepants and Ed, Edd & Eddy .   -------------------------------------------------------- Key features: Food prep is out. Flavor design is in.  Consider the real-world properties and flavors of ingredients to design uniquely satisfying burgers. A city of events! There’s always something going on - take advantage of events at each location to boost your business, or create events of your own by posting on social media. Let’s get experimental. Play with your food to collect over 20 elusive #FoodPic illustrations, lovingly crafted by indie artists like @sharkeesart, @nautilics and Lucy Mutimer.  We’re all weird here. Get to know a cast of relatably weird friends, enemies, and customers (who are sometimes also enemies). Lightheartedly cutthroat competition. Manage your truck and boost your reputation to score the hottest parking spots in town and show your rival who's boss! Flavor made real. Share your creations with friends—and even export the recipes so you can taste-test for yourself.

title: Bee Space
shortDescription: Plant flowers and deploy tech from orbit in this roguelike deckbuilder! Terraform tiny hex grid islands as advanced space Bees. Contend with fickle weather, strange creatures, mysterious artifacts and meddling bosses as you reclaim Earth for all Bee-Kind!
fullDescription: Bee Space is a cozy, roguelike, strategic terraforming deck builder, following the adventures of a handful of bees as they embark on reclaiming the Earth for all Bee-kind. Their honey bee ancestors were sent to space in the 80s as a science project. After a while, contact with the humans was lost, but the bees kept evolving and thriving. Now, countless generations later, the bees are returning to reclaim the little blue planet and find out what happened to its old inhabitants. Build out your unique deck each run. Buy cards and exotic charms from the commissary shop to create amazing combos and synergies that help you throughout your expedition to reclaim Earth. Enjoy a unique and relaxing mix of solitaire-like puzzle mechanics and strategy by playing cards from your hand to place plants and structures from orbit on a hex-grid island in order to terraform it. Plan your moves carefully to take advantage of fickle weather, deal with strange creatures, and recover mysterious human artifacts that affect the rules. Each expedition is unique, with a campaign map traveling across three different regions. Every island you visit is different from the last, constructed from hex tiles of various types and heights that affect cards in different ways. Some islands you terraform, while others contain mysteries or inhabitants that will affect your chances of success. Explore Earth and the bizarre human culture through the lens of whimsical sentient space bees. Discover new cards, artifacts, charms, characters and abilities to assist you on your expedition. Reclaim Earth one island at a time for the all Bee-Kind! What you can expect: 100+ unique cards with plants, tech and actions. 30+ charms to discover 30+ mysterious human artifacts 30+ encounters with meaningful choices for good or worse. 18 encounters with meddling managers and bosses 5 unique bee companions with different specializations and abilities 3 different regions with unique biomes Endless variety of beautiful 3D islands to play on Relaxing music by Andervel Deep strategy Funny dialog

title: Kitaria Fables 2
shortDescription: Team up with new heroes Alice and Dusty as they embark on an epic adventure across the mysterious Arkadera Peninsula. Develop unique combat skills, gather precious materials, forge powerful items, and tend to your growing farm, either alone or with a friend!
fullDescription: Prepare for another epic adventure in the magical world of Kitaria in this fun action RPG complete with farming and crafting! Across the great expanse of the Endless Ocean lies the Arkadera Peninsula, a distant region that once marked the western edge of the Empire. As the years passed and the Empire’s presence began to fade, the outposts that once protected Arkadera’s citizens were gradually reclaimed by nature, leaving behind a small community to take refuge in the walled haven of Whitewall Town. Eager to prove their skills in the field, ambitious Royal Army ‘Pathfinder’ Alice Skylar and plucky local guide Dusty Tuftkin join up with the Royal Academy Expedition Team on its mission to reopen Whitewall Town’s fabled errand house, explore the wide peninsula, and restore the long-forgotten outposts. But as the expedition journeys farther into the north, rumours of a mysterious figure deep within the wilderness slowly begin to surface… Explore the uncharted Arkadera wilderness and repair the outposts scattered across its deep forests, boggy marshes, rugged highlands and snow-capped mountains. Play as Royal Army ‘Pathfinder’ Alice Skylar, and enthusiastic local guide Dusty Tuftkin, each with their own playstyle to enjoy, skill tree to develop, and story to share. Assist the Royal Academy Expedition Team while getting to know your neighbours. Complete fun side quests and seek out remote settlements to earn rare rewards. Collect and spend skill points to unlock powerful special attacks and elemental spells. Unleash Alice’s and Dusty’s full potential with devastating ultimate abilities! Gather valuable materials in the wilds, and visit Whitewall Town’s skilled artisans to craft and upgrade new equipment, blend potions, or rustle up delicious treats. Help Aunt Kiki restore her dishevelled farmstead to its former glory. Search for rare plant seeds and cultivate nutritious crops before expanding your facilities to turn a profit. Recruit a friend in local or online co-op, and play through the entire story with both heroes at the same time. Work together with your partner to overcome the toughest challenges!

title: Chef of Sherwood
shortDescription: “It’s like Cooking-Mama meets the Monty Pythons in a Visual Novel!” Cook for your life as the new royal chef of Prince John Lackland and his unhinged family. Befriend Robin Hood and his rebels to get ingredients, prepare amazing meals and manage the pantry in this narrative-driven cooking game.
fullDescription: England, 1193. The kingdom is in disarray as Prince John Lackland and his high-maintenance, mood-swinging family rule the land. As the new royal cook , your goal is to keep Prince John's family happy and well-fed. You literally cook for your life : lose their respect, you’ll be hanged, serve them on a bad day, you’ll be hanged. Your only hope lies in the return of King Richard and Robin Hood and his Merry Folk seem to believe YOU might be the key to putting him back on England’s throne. Will you steal from the rich to give to the poor… or take from the poor to feed the rich? Cut, pour, whisk, mix, tease the fire. Precision and focus are your allies to create mouth-watering recipes through fun mini-games.  Cook a different exquisite meal every day , the royals do deserve the best after all... Meet the new royal family, the ones who decide if you live or die . Whether it’s fair or not is irrelevant, they will ask for your head on a pike if they are in a bad mood or if you lose their respect. Encounter the figures from the Robin Hood legend, learn their stories, and choose whether, or not, to support the Merry Folks' rebellion against the 1%. As a newcomer, people don’t know you well, but they need your help to tend to their business. Be careful who you give a hand to, the new royals taking over the throne did not over well with everyone. Time is a finite resource. Collect the ingredients you need take time out of your day, so be careful where you spend it! Ensure the castle pantry stays stocked with fresh and delicious products. You may lack a key ingredient for dinner if you don’t.

title: Fantasy Burger
shortDescription: 🧙‍♂️✨🍔 A chill fantasy cooking game! Serve meals to knights, mages, and mythical creatures. Play solo or with up to 7 friends!
fullDescription: COOK LEGENDARY MEALS Step into your medieval kitchen. Prepare everything from enchanted burgers to bubbling soups and hearty plates of steaming food. Use ingredients to restore mana, stamina, or health: your customers are battle-worn heroes! Play solo or with your party Run your tavern alone or team up in co-op mode for 2-8 players. More than just burgers Yes, there are burgers, but also soups and hearty full-course meals. You'll pour drinks like magic elixirs and iced brews made from enchanted berries. It brings the same cozy chaos to a brand-new fantasy world. While developing it, we drew inspiration from the fantasy games and stories we grew up with. title: Turnbound
shortDescription: Turnbound is an auto battler, where you manage a hero's inventory to escape a haunted boardgame. Each run is different from the last, with unique upgrades, combos and synergies. Async PvP lets you battle the ghosts of other players at your own pace in this unique new inventory battler.
fullDescription: Turnbound is a strategic autobattler focused on experimentation, theorycrafting, and mastery of the odds. You are trying to outsmart your way to freedom from a haunted board game where each session pits you against the trapped souls of other players. You battle against the builds left behind by other real players in asynchronous PvP battles. It’s a game of competitive inventory management, where every tile you place in your grid has a strategic cause-and-effect loop that impacts the tiles around it. It is a game that rewards foresight, creativity and luck. Will your design outlive your ghostly opponents… or join them? During the Shop Phase you pick, place or upgrade weapons, items, armour, consumables and accessories in the most optimal way. Trinkets let you unlock combos and winning battles let you upgrade your Hero through a branching set of abilities. Each round will have you making strategic decisions to execute synergies that give you an edge against your opponents! Take all the time you want to plan your build and manage your board. Whenever you start a battle you will go against a build from the same chamber, with the same number of shop rounds as you. Whenever you exit a battle, your build is added to the matchmaking database and someone else can face it. Whether you win the whole run or not has no influence on which builds are added to the matchmaking database. The builds you face as opponents may have lost the run or still be in the middle of it. You can face the build of someone who has played seconds before. Every detail counts and analyzing them is the key to understanding how to make the most of the tiles you have been given. The board won't always give you what you want, you will need to adapt your strategies, try new things and rely on a little bit of luck. Combat plays out from left to right, top to down - as each asynchronous multiplayer autobattle completes, use the helpful playback tools to better understand how your choices played out so you can improve your grid. If you keep playing your tiles right, you might just keep your soul intact - and make it to the top of the highest competitive chambers. Once you have a winning build on your hands, you can compete directly instead of battling spirits asynchronously. Duels let you challenge a specific build by entering a simple code. Share your own builds with a unique code, test yourself against a friend’s strategy or go up against selected Feature Builds from our community! It’s fast, chaotic, strategic and the perfect way to prove once and for all whose tile brain actually reigns supreme. Key features 4 Heroes Dozens of trinkets and abilities Hundreds of items 6 Chambers of progress and Final Chamber Leaderboard Board, profile, rug and tile customization Code & build sharing  Still not sure? Some of our players have described it as “Backpack Battles crossed with Hearthstone Battlegrounds,” and said that it's like “if The Bazaar met Backpack Battles” or “if Inventory Tetris and Hearthstone Battlegrounds had a cursed baby”. So if any of those games interest you, you may have fun with this one too! NO GEN AI No Generative AI, was used to create any of the in-game art or assets. Not even the battles are AI, all of them come from saved/winning builds created by other players. Even the tutorial where you play against “the cat", or occasional "bot builds" were crafted by our game designers.

But you have no time for grand adventures right now — you have your own tavern. By day, explore Mystmoor, help its residents, and gather ingredients. By evening, return home: cook meals, unlock new recipes, and serve the most unusual guests in the land. And if anyone decides to cause trouble... Well, you are a werewolf after all. RUN YOUR TAVERN Your day starts with something other than a mug of ale behind the bar. Explore the outskirts of Mystmoor, gather ingredients, and help its residents - then return home in the evening. Your guests are already waiting. Cook meals, unlock new recipes, serve visitors, and make sure the tavern is still standing after a particularly lively night. Sometimes you’ll have to calm down the rowdier customers, then repair everything they broke. And everything you broke yourself. MEET THE RESIDENTS OF MYSTMOOR Across the river live the mushroom folk. In the waters, you may meet mermaids. And deep in the woods hide creatures that any proper knight would gladly defeat for experience, gold, and a heroic story to tell at the local inn. Except this inn is yours. Meet the unusual residents of Mystmoor, learn their stories, help solve their problems, and protect those whom heroes are used to calling monsters. And when another knight in shining armor declares that he has come to save the world, maybe ask first whether anyone actually requested saving. EXPLORE, GATHER, AND COOK A good tavern needs good ingredients. Catch fish, chop wood, mill grain, and gather supplies for new dishes as you explore the outskirts of Mystmoor and gradually unlock new opportunities. Many everyday tasks are turned into short mini-games, making resource gathering feel less like a chore and more like part of the adventure. Take your time: explore the world at your own pace, stock up your pantry, and prepare for the next evening at the tavern. Though sometimes you will have to hurry. Especially when the guests break something again. HELP THOSE HEROES USUALLY DEFEAT You are not the great hero destined to save the world. If anything, you are one of those the world is usually being saved from. And your friends are monsters, mermaids, mushroom folk, and other creatures heroes are used to writing down as quest objectives. Help them, take part in their stories, resolve conflicts, and try to make your tavern a place where very different creatures can sit peacefully at the same table. Or at least not fight until closing time. WEAR THE WOLF'S SKIN Oh, right - you are also a werewolf. Your wolf nature is part of your life and your story. Explore Mystmoor, help its residents, and remember: some problems are much easier to solve when you have claws, fangs, and a very convincing growl. Running a tavern, helping your neighbors, and remaining a civilized creature at the same time is harder than it sounds. But who said a good innkeeper has to be human?

Completing a set of tasks will ensure your game’s progression.  You wake up in a strange world where there’s nothing but an abyss of sky and a floating island. You are greeted by a friendly fairy named Trixie, who needs help turning this empty world into a beautiful place. By agreeing to help her, you are required to gather the few resources from the island and give them to her, and in return, she can create something larger for you that can help with your progress. Together, you both will be able to turn the sky world into a place you’ll never forget! Crafting is a crucial aspect of your progress. Finding any resources in your world can be used to make something greater! Collecting XP will allow you to level up and grow your island larger while also unlocking many new features along the way! Growing plants and farming crops is important to your progression, as well as tending to animals and studying nature! Combat enemies to defend yourself while also using them to farm special resources! Constructing machines can help you automate your tasks. There are all four seasons of the year, which will change the world and events around you. You can even start the game in whatever season you wish, which will require different strategies to progress! There's lots more special features to look forward to within the game! There are 4 different types of classes to choose from! Each one will start the game differently, changing your strategy through each playthrough while also doubling XP for that specific class, depending on what task you complete.   The Naturalist class is the study of nature and all its surroundings. From planting and growing trees to studying wildlife such as birds, frogs, and other related creatures. The Farmer class is, of course, all about farming. From growing crops to raising animals, you’ll be able to do just about everything a farmer does. The Warrior class is all about combat. You will be able to create a monster farm to gather special resources and forge several different weapons. The Engineer class dives heavily into the construction of machines and energy management. By mastering this class, you can have many types of machines that automate your work for you.   All class types can still be unlocked and played in your world, no matter which one you choose to start with. Creative mode is a perfect way for players to try out different features in the game right from the start! With infinite amounts of resources at your disposal, you can create any type of world you desire! The character pack feature allows you to customize the character models by going into the game files and changing the original design to any design you wish! You can also customize some of the music within the game! Sky World 64 is a real passion project of mine and is the game I dreamed of making for years. I’m so excited to finally share it with the world, and I hope you enjoy it as much as I enjoy working on it!

You have only one reason to keep going: survive long enough to find your wife, Valeria. But in the cold and darkness of this unforgiving night, will you ever make it back to her?  In the hellish streets of this Eastern Bloc town, every bullet matters. There are ways to fight back, but survival demands more than firepower. Use the weapons at your disposal to clear a path, scavenge tools to overcome the obstacles ahead, and avoid unnecessary confrontations whenever you can. Iron Blight aims to deliver an immersive gameplay experience built around atmosphere, vulnerability, and the crushing weight of isolation. Every bullet matters, and the sound of gunfire may draw even more horrors to your position. Even something as simple as opening a locked door demands thought. You must manage your food and medical supplies, move cautiously through the streets, and always consider what might be waiting around the next corner. True Survival Horror Gameplay:  Navigate desolate streets and claustrophobic interiors, where danger lurks around every corner. Solve puzzles and face the terrors that will force a choice: fight, flee, or die. Resource Scarcity and Tension:  Resources are scarce. Do you risk using your last bullet to take down a monster, or do you save it for a more critical moment and hope to slip past unnoticed? Diegetic Grid-Based Inventory:  Every single item matters, and space is a luxury you can't afford. Carefully manage your limited inventory grid, making agonizing choices about what to carry and what to leave behind. No HUD, No Distractions:  No health bars, no ammo counters, no intrusive menus. Every piece of information is conveyed through your character and the world around you. Your only interface is your own perception. A Unique Weapon System:  Check your magazines manually, round by precious round, and reload with deliberate, step-by-step actions. Every firefight becomes a tense test of your nerves and skill. A Bleak and Oppressive Atmosphere:  Rain-slick cobblestones and flickering fluorescent lights lead you deeper into a town that feels cold, hostile, and suffocating. The distant cries of things that should not exist echo through its desolate streets. A Return to Forgotten Horror Traditions:  Fear comes from the atmosphere, the gnawing uncertainty, and the constant presence of death. The story is told through the environment itself, and combat is a slow, methodical dance where every shot matters.

fullDescription: Food for Frog is a cozy cooking puzzle game about figuring out how to combine and process ingredients to create the dishes requested by a cast of froggy characters. Get to know your customers by chatting with them, learn new recipes from all sorts of real-life cuisines and enjoy the cute hand-drawn character and environment art. Take things at your own pace and don't be afraid to experiment. Cook dishes from across the globe! All recipes in the game are based on existing, real-life cuisines. You'll probably recognize some classics, or you might learn of some meals you've never heard of before. If you're a pro in the kitchen you might be able to apply some of your real-world cooking knowledge to help you in the game, but if you're a novice, don't be afraid: your frog patrons can help you out. Talk to a wide cast of fleshed-out characters You recently became the owner of The Stork: the only restaurant in the swamp. The frogs in the local community who visit your restaurant all have their own lives and opinions that you can choose to find out if you chat with them - or not. If all you want to do is chill and cook in the kitchen, you can do that too. Combine, process and experiment! To cook the dishes requested of you, you have an unlimited amount of ingredients at your disposal. You can experiment with different combinations and processes as much as you want. However, if you ever get stuck, you can always ask for hints from your customers. Enjoy the cute & cozy vibes of Food for Frog's artwork All of Food for Frog's stylized graphics are hand-made and created to serve the chill and cozy atmosphere of the game.

title: Isle of Food
shortDescription: Can you cook when nothing is given to you? Hunt, fish, gather, and farm your way to running a stylish island restaurant in this open-world cozy VR cooking game!
fullDescription: Can you cook when nothing is given to you? Isle of Food  is an open-world cozy VR cooking game where cooking begins outside the kitchen. There are no ready-made ingredients or shortcuts. To cook, you must explore the island to hunt, fish, gather, and farm everything yourself. Only what you bring back can be cooked. Each dish is prepared by hand using natural VR interactions, and your progress depends on how well you manage your stylish island restaurant. The world shapes your menu, and your choices shape the experience. CORE MECHANICS ✔ VR cooking with natural hand interactions ✔ 100+ real and fantasy recipes ✔ Multiple cooking methods: baking, boiling, frying, grilling ✔ Open-world island exploration ✔ Hunting, Fishing, Gathering, Farming ✔ Day–night cycle and dynamic weather ✔ Restaurant management, upgrades, decorations and progression MAIN FEATURES Isle of Food delivers a full hands-on VR cooking experience with simulation-level detail . You slice, fry, boil, bake and plate dishes using precise physical movements, crafting meals from 100+ recipes ranging from real-world classics to fantasy dishes made from rare island ingredients. Every recipe begins with open-world island exploration. Ingredients must be found through activity: hunt wildlife, track birds, fish along the coast, gather fruits and herbs, or grow your own crops near the restaurant. A day–night cycle and shifting weather affect what appears and when, forming a core part of your cooking progression. A NEW COOKING EXPERIENCE Guests set the pace of your restaurant management experience. Each day brings visitors with different tastes — from simple starter requests to complex dishes that require rare ingredients gathered across the island. Service hours create a natural gameplay rhythm. Peak times reward fast, accurate cooking, while quieter moments let you restock, explore the island or prepare ahead. As your rating increases, guests become more varied and demanding, turning each service into meaningful progress in your VR cooking career. YOUR PATH AS A CHEF You begin with a small seaside kitchen and a short menu. Serving guests earns money and experience that unlock new tools, expand your recipes, improve the restaurant interior and refine your overall management strategy. Reaching the 7-star level is the ultimate milestone. Higher ratings bring tougher orders, stricter ingredient requirements and greater rewards, attracting premium guests who seek the rarest dishes the island can offer. From your first simple meals to a fully developed 7-star restaurant, Isle of Food builds a complete VR cooking adventure you can progress through at your own pace. Coming in   2026 — ADD TO WISHLIST and don’t miss the launch.

title: Dear Journey...
shortDescription: Run a cosy little travel agency, one letter at a time. Travellers write in and tell you what they are hoping for. Plan the journey that gives it to them, card by card, and watch it unfold. Satisfy them, and they may write back...
fullDescription: Dear Journey... I hope this finds you well. It’s been quiet here lately, and I’ve been dreaming of somewhere new... The travel agency is in your hands now Director Diana and Derek have gone travelling, and they are in no hurry to come back. Every morning the post lands on your desk: travellers writing in with their moods, their hopes, and a clear idea of what would make their perfect journey. Read their letters, learn what they need, then build them the journey of a lifetime. Diana still writes, of course. Mostly advice, occasionally a postcard, always from somewhere with better weather. Plan trips with cards Each day you draw activities, destinations and helpful extras, then pair them into travel plans: a beach bonfire for the lonely elder who misses company, a floating market at dawn for the photographer chasing better light. Every journey has a number to clear, and the needs they wrote to you about are how you clear it. A card that answers one counts double, and the right destination multiplies it again. Answer them all and the trip is perfect. Draw a hand you cannot work with? Ask for fresh cards and think nothing of it. And nothing is hidden: when the journey plays out across the map, every match, bonus and multiplier is shown in the order it happened, so you always know why a trip landed the way it did. Grow a little agency with a big heart Travellers and milestones leave you keepsakes, and where you meld one changes what it does: a lucky coin on an activity finds a need the card was missing, the same coin on a destination makes its multiplier land whatever the region. Pin agency upgrades to the board, keep your best cards pocketed so they are never left to the daily draw, and tidy the rest away. Your reputation grows, new regions unlock, and your humble desk slowly becomes the kind of agency people write to twice. Because they do come back... Grant what they hoped for and travellers become regulars, signing their letters by name, each with a turn of phrase that is theirs alone, and sometimes arriving with a gift you are perfectly free to hand back. Cosy on purpose There are no timers, no disasters and no fail states. A trip that falls short costs you the day and a little of the reward; the traveller’s request stays on your desk and you can try again tomorrow. The morning post is yours to choose from, and a journey you have taken on but cannot finish can be called off with an apology, which no regular will ever hold against you. You can step away whenever life needs you and the ledger keeps itself, remembering the exact moment you left, mid-letter if need be. A warm desk, a lo-fi soundtrack, a fresh pile of post, and someone out there who has told you exactly what they need and trusts you to arrange it. Key Features Fifteen kinds of traveller, fourteen moods, and letters that say plainly what they are hoping for Wishes worth granting: a place they have always wanted to see, an ending in the right region, a journey that never leaves one valley. Grant one and they may come back for good Seven hand-drawn regions, from polar research stations to floating markets and highland monasteries Eight starting profiles across three difficulty seasons Learn the game through thoughtful letters Grow from junior clerk to the name on the door, and see the agency through to a warm farewell

During a wave, enemies move toward the Bump Guardian while you play cards in real time to damage threats, heal the guardian, and stabilize your defenses. Your hand size is limited, requiring careful timing and prioritization. If enemies reach the ring, they deal damage directly to it. The fetus remains protected as long as the ring holds — when it fails, the journey restarts. The pacing emphasizes thoughtful decisions over fast reactions, keeping the experience approachable and calm. Deckbuilding Before each wave, you build and adjust your deck from the cards you have unlocked. Cards are designed to complement different strategies, such as focusing on offense, healing, or control. Once a wave begins, your deck is locked in — making preparation just as important as execution. Progression Progress through pregnancy-inspired stages that reflect the passage of time and development. As you advance, new cards unlock, enemy get increasingly stronger, and strategic complexity increases. Your journey is structured to mirror growth and care, with each stage introducing fresh challenges while maintaining a gentle, supportive tone. Features Real-time deck-building defense gameplay Wave-based real-time card play Build and customize your deck between waves Progression with unlockable cards Pregnancy-themed stages and cute visuals A note from the developer   Bump Guardian is a solo project hand-crafted between nap times and late nights. As a full-time mum to twin babies, building this game has been my way of exploring themes of protection and growth.

title: 光与影之恋 Chiaroscuro Lovers
shortDescription: A domineering CEO-like older sister who’s gentle only to her sister, a childhood friend who became her doctor, and a cheerful girl only she can see… Who was Chu Hebai before losing her memories, and how did she become entangled with them? A melancholic yuri AVG about regret and unspoken love.
fullDescription: Chiaroscuro Lovers is a story about memory, trauma, and love. You will step into the world through the eyes of Chu Hebai, entering a reality that is slowly falling apart. Caught between memory and reality, you will search for what has already been lost— and what has yet to be lost. And in the end, you may come to realize: “This world… is a little kinder than you imagined.” Story “I”—Chu Hebai—lost my memory eleven years ago. In that time, the world has changed beyond recognition. A global catastrophe known as the “Great Collapse” has left everything on the brink of ruin. My family’s corporation thrived in the chaos, gaining immense wealth— and attracting endless conflict in return. And yet, I alone remained abroad, living a quiet, peaceful life for eleven years. But that peace could never last. The news of my grandfather’s death calls me back to my homeland. What awaits me there is not only loss— but long-buried memories, and a farewell that was never completed. “Everyone knows Chu Hebai…except me.” About the “Great Collapse” A global geological disaster caused by increasingly intense tectonic activity. Its effects continue to spread, with no sign of stopping. About the “Chu Group” A powerful corporate conglomerate specializing in extreme-environment protection technologies and biomedical science. While it has profited greatly from the Great Collapse, it has also become the target of both internal and external threats. In recent years, new challenges continue to emerge. About the “Lamplighter,” the “Psychologist,” and the “Consultation Room” Figures and places that have lived within Chu Hebai’s mind for eleven years. Each with their own intentions— yet when danger comes, they will not hesitate to light a guiding flame for her. Features Emotion-driven narrative experience Multiple endings Beautiful CG artwork Characters Chu Hebai CV: Linghun Monü Age: 22 “You are the mirror of this world to me.” The second daughter of the Chu family, once known as a prodigy. Now suffering from psychogenic blindness, she frequently experiences hallucinations — both auditory and visual. Chu Heyu CV: Yu Wei Age: 23 “If you must hate someone… hate me.” The eldest daughter of the Chu family and its current head. A brilliant strategist, almost flawless in control. She governs everything with precision— except for certain things she chooses not to confront. She is gentle toward Hebai. Perhaps… too gentle. Yu Lin CV: Qian Mingling Age: 22 “You always say the strangest things…” The current director of Chu Medical. A rare medical genius, disciplined and deeply rational. She believes in science, logic, and observable truth— yet Hebai represents something she cannot fully explain. And that uncertainty begins to change her. The Lamplighter CV: Yu Wei Age: ?? “Hmm? You don’t like this story?” A presence only Hebai can perceive. Carefree, talkative, and endlessly amused. She helps “illuminate” memories, fills in the gaps, and explains what doesn’t make sense. She always seems to know more than she says. And she never answers questions directly. Some lights will be lit. And some darkness, should not be forced into the light.

title: Feather Rogue
shortDescription: A tactical card roguelike where each turn is a full combo, not one move. Spend your energy chaining cards across a grid, then trigger reactions that cascade across the whole board. You're a crow. You're a chemist. Set the trap, pull one thread, watch everything fall.
fullDescription: YOU ARE A SMART CROW. Small, unassuming, and absolutely DEVASTATING In a world of vibrant colors and cozy vibes, you'll build a deck of elemental cards, position yourself on a tactical grid, and trigger explosive chain reactions that clear the entire battlefield in a single turn. ♟ NOT YOUR USUAL TURN-BASED GAME Most tactics games give you one move per turn. Click a unit, it acts, the turn passes. Back and forth, one action at a time. Feather Rogue doesn't work like that. Each turn you get a hand of cards and a pool of energy and you spend it building one combo. Move, position, apply Wet, set up Grounded, then detonate the whole thing with a single trigger. The real puzzle is squeezing the most out of every point of energy: which cards, in which order, for the biggest chain. Your turn isn't one action, it's a whole sequence you compose before the enemy gets to breathe. Then, and only then, the turn passes. The enemy reacts to the board you built. It's the difference between making one chess move and conducting an entire symphony in a single beat. 🔥 ELEMENTAL CHEMISTRY — 16 Reactions, Endless Cascades Elements aren't damage types. They're ingredients. Wet, Burn, Freeze, Poison, Lightning, Wind, Grounded, each is a layer you stack onto an enemy. Stack the right combination and the board erupts. 10 two-element reactions: ⚡ Conductive (Wet + Lightning) -> ×2 damage, and the bolt jumps to every adjacent wet enemy. 💨 Steam (Burn + Wet) -> a scalding cloud that stuns everything around it. ❄ Shatter (Freeze + a hit) -> frozen enemies crack open: ×1.5 damage and they start bleeding. ☠ Toxic Flame (Poison + Burn) -> poison damage doubles. Watch their health melt. 🩸 Frozen Blood (Bleed + Freeze) -> rooted in place and punished for every step they take. 🌩 Thunderstorm (Wind + Lightning) -> a lightning burst with a chance to shock-stun. 🔥 Wildfire (Wind + Burn) -> flames leap to every adjacent enemy. ☁ Miasma (Wind + Poison) -> a lingering poison cloud that chokes the zone for turns. 🌊 Tempest (Wet + Wind) -> knockback, slow, and collision damage as they slam into things. 🌍 Earthstrike (Grounded + Lightning) -> a heavy shockwave that roots and rips through tiles. 6 three-element reactions — the advanced layer: Get three elements onto a target at once and you unlock the big ones: 🌀 Superstorm (Wet + Lightning + Wind) -> hits every enemy on the board and stuns them all. 🦠 Plague Wind (Burn + Poison + Wind) -> doubled toxic damage spreads to every enemy. 💥 Plasma Burst (Wet + Burn + Lightning) ->200 flat damage that ignores defense entirely. 🧊 Absolute Zero (Freeze + Wind + Wet) -> freezes the whole board; anything already frozen auto-shatters. 🔥 Firestorm (Burn + Lightning + Wind) -> a wide AoE blast that stacks heavy burn. ⚡ Cryoshock (Poison + Freeze + Lightning) -> roots, silences, and deals massive damage. And it cascades. Reactions trigger other reactions with no depth limit. Conductive spreads to a wet enemy, that sets off Steam, which feeds a Shatter... one well-placed card can chain through the entire grid in a single turn. You're not dealing damage. You're a mad chemist who knows exactly what happens when reagents touch. 🛡 PARRY — Defense Is a Puzzle, Not a Reflex Enemies telegraph their attacks before they strike. On your turn, you read those intents and assign defense cards to counter them, match the right card to the right threat and you don't just survive, you turn their aggression into your opening. 🎴 DECK = WEAPON Build a deck where every card feeds the next. A move card that leaves a Wet trail. An attack that applies Grounded. Cards aren't isolated, they're combo pieces. The deck is the engine that drives your reactions. 🗺 GRID TACTICS — Position Is Everything Every card is a movement. Every attack has an AoE shape (Cross, Diamond, Cone, Ring, Line). Obstacles block, conduct, or explode. Your crow never stands still, it dances across the battlefield, setting up the next chain. 🌲 SKILL TREE — 101 Nodes, Five Paths, One Build Every level up, you pick a node from a sprawling 101 node tree spanning five thematic zones: Combat, Agility, Survival, Elemental, and Chaos. Stack stat boosts, unlock run-defining passives, and chase Legendary capstones. Lean hard into one path or weave several together, every run, your crow becomes a different machine. 🎮 RUN STRUCTURE Moment to moment: Play cards, manage energy, position on grid → enemy attacks → parry → repeat Short term (10-15 min): One stage with multiple encounters → rewards → skill tree node Full run (45-60 min): Choose your path on a branching map (combat, elite, event, shop, forge, rest) → defeat 3 chapters and their bosses → die or conquer Long term: Collect boss trophies permanently. Master parry timing. Discover every elemental reaction. Set the trap. Pull one thread. Watch everything fall.

shortDescription: An incremental roguelike fishing game. Start with one tool, end with five. Draft, upgrade and stack them, then hunt 70 species across eight oceans until the whole sea is biting at once. Rivals steal your cards. Something in the dark already knows your name. One more round. fullDescription: Cast your line. Stack your tools. Get hooked, one round at a time. This is what you're working towards. Five tools in the water, the meter fills, Fever hits and the ocean loses its mind. Fish everywhere, catches every half second, gold piling up faster than you can read the numbers. It's the best ten seconds in the game. You don't start there. You start with one tool and twenty seconds a round. One fish, a few coins, go again. Fishing Fever is built on short runs that escalate fast. Round 4 is calm. Round 20 is busy. Round 40 is the thing in the first GIF. So draft, upgrade, break. Every round hands you a new tool. Rods, nets, harpoons, drones, traps, 45 of them. Upgrade them, stack them, and chase that one combo that makes the whole run click. What does stacking three Lucky Nets actually do? Find out. Then leave the coast. Eight oceans and every one of them fishes differently. Warm reefs. Arctic ice. A drowned city. Seventy species, a Fishdex to fill and an aquarium to keep them in. And every so often a Big One turns up and the whole round is about landing it. You're not alone out there. Golden fish surface for a few seconds and vanish. From round fifty a rival boat pulls up beside you. Win the best of three or watch them sail off with one of your cards. They might even have your friend's name. Then spend the haul. Shop upgrades that stay forever. Treasures that rewrite a run. A crew to hire. A talent tree that keeps unfolding. Every run leaves you stronger than the last. And somewhere out there, something is waiting. Bottles wash up with pages from a captain's log. Read them in order. Around page seven you'll want to stop. You won't. It's a fishing game. It's an incremental. It's stupidly addictive. 45 tools. 70 fish. 8 oceans. And it goes deeper than you think. "One more round. Just one more." You've been saying that for three hours.

By My Side is an open-world survival-craft game about raw survival, a home you build with your own hands, and the bond that grows between you and your dog. Your Dog, Your Story: Find a stray and raise it from a pup. Each run it's a different breed with its own look and talent. Build & Power a Home: From a first campfire to a walled homestead with a glass greenhouse and an upper floor. Place every foundation, wall, stair and roof freely, then bring it to life with your own power-and-water grid: solar, batteries, pumps, heaters, sprinklers, smelters and smart-relay automation that keeps the base running while you're away. Craft Everything: Over 90 recipes across workbench, furnace, campfire and powered machines. Gather raw materials and refine them through real crafting trees (ore into iron into steel, fibre into cloth into cable) into tools, gear and the machines that run your home. Survive the Seasons: Stay warm, fed and dry as spring, summer and autumn give way to a winter that wants you dead. Food spoils, so salt it, preserve it, stock the larder before the cold. Live Off the Land: Till fields and grow crops, keep them alive year-round in a heated greenhouse, raise animals, trade with a wandering merchant, and automate the grind so your homestead works for you. Defend What's Yours: The wild fights back, and it escalates the longer you last. Harsher winters and pack sieges strike from the first night. Read the danger, fortify your home, and hold the line beside your dog. Climb the homestead ranks toward an endgame worth chasing. Two Ways to Play: Survival (hardcore, one life, permadeath) or Story (your home and world endure when you fall). Arrive with nothing. Leave a legacy, with your dog by your side. Arrive with nothing. Leave a legacy — with your dog by your side.

title: Bearicade
shortDescription: A toy-scale tower defense roguelite. Mount dart blasters, cap guns and spud cannons on a toy train, draft new towers between waves, crack open toy chests, and hold the line as wave after wave of plastic soldiers marches across the bedroom floor to take down your teddy bear!
fullDescription: The bedroom is under siege Every night, when the lights go out, the plastic army wakes up — and it marches on your teddy bear. The only thing standing between Teddy and the invasion is a wind-up train, a loop of track around him, and every weapon in the toybox. A bear. A barricade.  Bearicade . Your fortress rides the rails Towers in Bearicade don't stand on the map — they ride it. Bolt toy weapons onto the train's wagons and your whole defense circles Teddy like a rolling wall, gunning soldiers down on the move while the locomotive rams anything that strays onto the track. And each of the 12 wagon colors bends the rules for whatever rides on it — extra gold, faster leveling, bonuses that grow the longer a tower stays put — so WHERE you place a tower matters as much as what it is. Draft, unbox, evolve Between waves the shop deals you three cards. Take what fits your build or pay to reroll — prices inflate and legendary odds climb the deeper you go. Feeling lucky? Five kinds of toy chests (Toy Box, Gold Chest, Gadget Chest, Upgrade Chest, Trinket Chest) each show three prizes: pick the one you want, gamble on a mystery from the chest's whole pool, or skip and pocket a refund. Towers level up for free just by fighting, and at level 5 every one of them reaches a fork: two evolutions, one choice, no going back. A humble Cap Gun becomes a rapid-fire Twin Cap or a slow, devastating Magnum — 13 towers become 39 very different weapons. Toy sets are stronger together Every weapon belongs to synergy families — Sharpshooters, Demolition, Trickshot, Budget Brigade and more, eleven in all. Field matching towers and the whole set unlocks bonuses; spread wide instead and diversity pays its own dividend. Then round out the build with trinkets (feeling brave? the Gamble Kit gives a tower +10 levels... or deletes it) and battle gadgets you trigger mid-wave — freeze the whole floor, drop a sticker bomb, raise a bubble around Teddy. Survive 30 waves. Then see how far the train goes Marchers, sprinters, bazooka men, armored bricks, battlefield medics, armed jeeps — the army learns new tricks as the nights roll on, a boss arrives every fifth wave, and wave 30 belongs to the General himself. Beat him and endless mode opens: ever-scaling waves, a Steam leaderboard, and one question — how long can the train keep rolling? Features A tower defense roguelite where your towers ride a toy train Draft shop between waves: three cards, rerolls, inflation, rising legendary odds Five toy chests, each a pick / mystery / skip decision 13 towers that fork into 39 evolutions — free XP leveling, free repositioning 11 synergy families, 11 trinkets, 7 battle gadgets, 12 rule-bending wagon colors Run-start charms, boss waves, endless mode past wave 30, Steam leaderboards

title: Milk Can Clicker

fullDescription: FROM A SMALL FARM TO A DAIRY BUSINESS Milk Can Clicker is a relaxing idle, clicker and incremental game about milk production, automation and long-term progression. Start with a few cows, milk your first raw milk and earn your first money through manual sales. Reinvest your income into upgrades, automate repetitive work and gradually build larger production and sales chains. What begins with a few cows develops into an interconnected regional dairy business. PRODUCE, PROCESS AND AUTOMATE Milk your cows yourself – or increasingly let your systems do the work for you. Process raw milk into more valuable products such as: Processed Milk Butter Cheese Yogurt Cream Optimize production, processing, storage and sales. Storage reserves allow you to keep products for further processing or other systems instead of automatically selling everything. The further you progress, the more closely the different systems interact. EXPAND FROM THE FARM TO THE CITY Your progression does not stop at the farm. Unlock the Dairy , the Village Market and eventually the City , where a total of 14 unlockable city buildings provide new ways to expand your economy. These include five different market stalls, Marketing, a Café, Restaurant, Hotel and extensive market and delivery orders. New areas do more than simply increase the numbers: they introduce additional production, sales and optimization opportunities. QUESTS, PRESTIGE AND LONG-TERM PROGRESSION 26 quests guide you through the game's different systems and provide clear goals without explaining every individual step. Eventually, starting over becomes part of moving forward. Use Prestige to reset part of your current progress in exchange for permanent advantages in future runs. The Prestige Shop is structured around the game's different systems and allows for long-term specialization and increasingly efficient runs. There are also 75 Steam Achievements and 11 Steam Stats for players looking for additional long-term goals. THE MILK FESTIVAL IS THE GOAL – NOT THE END Your long-term journey leads to the Milk Festival . Master the event at Bronze, Silver and Gold and put your growing dairy business to the test. Reaching Gold does not end your save. Continue playing in Endless Mode , increase your production further and keep pushing your progression. PLAY ACTIVELY OR LET YOUR SYSTEMS WORK Milk Can Clicker lets you decide how actively you want to play. Click cows, manage upgrades and optimize production yourself – or invest increasingly in automation and let your systems handle repetitive tasks. Milk Can Clicker combines short active sessions with long-term idle and incremental progression. ONE GAME. ONE PURCHASE. No advertisements. No subscriptions. No battle pass. No premium currency. No in-game purchases. Buy it once and play at your own pace. Visual assets in Milk Can Clicker were created with the assistance of generative AI and were subsequently selected, edited, and integrated into the game by the developer.

title: Beneath the Rolling Hills
shortDescription: A cozy open-world hiking adventure where preparation is just as important as exploration. Cook meals, pack your backpack, explore the countryside, uncover forgotten history, buy and decorate your dream cottage, and discover hidden secrets.
fullDescription: Fell From the Sky. Landed in Lynbury. The sky cracked open just as the midday sun hit its highest point, right as the Snailfolk were preparing for their yearly food festival. Oliver Oddshell swears he saw it first, watching something fall out of the sky and land in the dirt. They had prayed for good food this year. What they got was you, torn straight out of a school science experiment gone wrong and dropped somewhere far from home. The Snailfolk welcomed you like they'd been expecting you all along, and even gave you a room of your own. Soon enough you're cooking food, wandering hills, delivering meals, and exploring the mysterious world of Lynbury, slowly but surely feeling right at home. A successful hike is won before the first step is taken. Prepare carefully by planning your route, checking the weather, choosing suitable clothing, and packing everything you'll need for the day. The hills reward those who come prepared, but even the smallest oversight can turn a peaceful hike into a challenging journey home. Every step costs something. Stamina drains as you walk, faster still if you're hungry, thirsty, or tired. Dress for the weather, choose your path, and pace yourself. Every decision shapes the journey ahead. Before long, it's just you, a pack on your back, and the hike ahead. Every hill hides something worth finding. A forgotten picnic spot, an old shepherd's hut, a chest tucked beneath the roots of an ancient oak, or a winding path you've never noticed before. Curiosity is always rewarded, and there's always another reason to see what's beyond the next hill There's nothing quite like coming home. Light the fire, cook dinner, tidy the cottage, water the garden, care for your pets, wash the day's muddy clothes, or lose yourself in a good book. However you choose to spend your evenings, home is yours to make your own. A good meal can go a long way. Follow step-by-step recipes as you prepare hearty countryside dishes using fresh ingredients gathered along your journey. Cook to keep yourself well-fed on long hikes, enjoy a comforting meal back at your cottage, or lend a hand to the Snailfolk, whose delightfully odd requests often reward both a full purse and a grateful smile. At the Heart of the Hills lies Lynbury. Everything you'd hope to find in a charming little village is here: cozy shops, a welcoming pub, a beautiful river, centuries old stone buildings, and a magnificent church overlooking the village. The only unusual part is the residents happen to be talking snails. Then again, the whole world is like that, and before long, you'll wonder why you ever thought it was unusual.. So get used to it!
