fullDescription: Windborne is a live weather wallpaper that quietly lives on your desktop — and a gentle, unobtrusive collection game. It paints the world's real weather as a hand-drawn map behind your windows: wind streams, rain falls, cyclones turn slowly. And when the right weather arrives, small visitors drift in on the wind — waiting to be noticed, and collected. It never fights for your attention. No forced interaction, no punishment, no timers. Keep working, browsing, watching — the weather and its visitors simply drift by in the background. Glance over now and then, and you might find a rare guest who only came today. A living weather map Real-time global weather, rendered by the wallpaper itself — a soft cartoon palette with ink coastlines only, no borders, no clutter Live wind-flow particle animation; switch between wind / rain / temperature color layers Live tropical cyclone tracking: past and forecast tracks, a category-colored spinning icon, particles swirling around active storms City labels in 中文 or English, switchable in one click Worldwide presets: global overview, continents, ocean basins, East Asia detail — or custom coordinates Guests on the wind Different weather brings different visitors. Clear skies, sudden rain, high winds, the edge of a rain band — each condition invites its own little creatures, each with its own rarity, coming and going with the weather. There's nothing to grind: leave it on your desktop, and the codex fills in on its own, day by day. Tend a small desktop ecosystem, too, and watch it grow with the weather and the hours. Restraint by design Low-contrast, slow, and never in the way — it's wallpaper, not a pop-up Zero forced interaction, zero punishment: miss a moment and it's fine — the weather comes again tomorrow Light on your system: only the particle layer animates; weather refreshes every 30 minutes by default (adjustable) Multi-monitor support, with per-display region and layer settings Data & disclaimer Weather snapshots come from Windy-Data-API (built on Open-Meteo AWS open data / NOAA GFS); cyclone data is parsed from GDACS; map outlines are from Natural Earth. An internet connection is required for live data; when offline, the map and cities still render and cached data is shown. This is an ambient visualization and casual game. Weather and storm information is simplified and stylized, and may be delayed, cached, interpolated, or unavailable. Do not use it for emergency, navigation, aviation, maritime, or any safety-critical decisions. Not affiliated with , Open-Meteo, GDACS, NOAA, or Natural Earth.

fullDescription: Two games, one idea. Matchinko is a match-3 puzzle that feeds a physics-driven pachinko payout, wrapped in a roguelite of tiles, ball loadouts, and a fate-navigated map. First you build  the board by matching. Then you break  it — raining your loadout of balls through the pegs you just made for a score that snowballs out of control. You are the lamp keeper, travelling town to town. Charge the crystals, string the lights across the houses, and dispel the darkness that caps each town. Clear it, and the town shines. [h2]Build, then break[/h2] A single persistent board  carries through your whole run — you compound it, you never restart it. Spend your moves matching 3+ crystals: merged crystals rise a level  and score exponentially more. Then drop your ball loadout. Every peg and tile it touches pays out. A smart merge now is a jackpot later. [h2]No two runs play alike[/h2] Buy from the townsfolk between matches and your whole playstyle changes: 30 fairies  — 15 common, 10 rare, and 5 event-only legendaries — that orbit your board and bend the rules: magnets, midas coins, phoenix revivals, chain-lightning, and more. 36 tiles  — special pegs from splash detonations to greed engines, including 5 legendary "grow cards" that start small and snowball the longer you keep them. 30 balls  — a loadout deck across common, rare, and legendary tiers, plus 3 editions  (Gilded, Radiant, Prismatic) that add a shine on top of the ball's own trick. 11 events  — risk/reward encounters on the map: wishing wells, enchanters, cursed bargains, ember altars. Push your luck or play it safe. A climb to the boss Every run is a 12-level branching climb. Each level is its own procedural winter town; a boss  caps every third one. Bosses are known in advance, so your shopping has direction — buy to beat the rule you can see coming. Light all four towns and topple the final boss to win the run. One miss away Miss a level's target and the run ends immediately  — back to a fresh board. Roguelite stakes, not casual comfort. Every ball counts. Cozy on the outside Hand-drawn snow-capped villages, chimney smoke, a lamplighter tending the post, drifting snow, and a garland of lights that fills in as you clear each town. The reward isn't just a coin count — it's a dark town coming to light. Full keyboard and gamepad  support with on-screen button prompts, plus rumble. Built to run great on  Steam Deck  and desktop.

title: INKTRICK
shortDescription: INKTRICK is a handcrafted, cozy roguelike card game made of cards, ink and stamps. Win tricks, turn a weak 8 into a trump and unlock new possibilities hand after hand, such as stamp upgrades and mystery packs. Fibus deals, cheers you on and plays against you.
fullDescription: A weak 8 beats an ace — you just have to stamp it first. INKTRICK is a roguelike card game made of cards, ink and stamps. Grab the cards, the ink pad and a glass of ink: the table is set! You play trick after trick against Fibus, the cheeky hand at the other end of the table. She deals, she shows you everything, she cheers you on at the top of her voice … and then she snatches the last trick right out from under your nose. You learn the rules in a minute: follow suit, take the trick, collect ink. But the cards are only the beginning. One imprint, and the weakest card at the table beats the strongest. Stamp it, don't hope Many kinds of stamp, three tiers each, and every one of them turns a different screw. One makes your 8 the trump suit. One crowns the trick that really counts. One tips the whole rank order over until the aces across the table are worth nothing at all. Best of all: they stack. Three imprints on one card, and the hand you almost threw away becomes the strongest fist at the table — if you think two moves ahead. Beat a boss, change the rules Every boss you beat lets you pick a TWIST: a new rule that stays on the table for the rest of the run. Sometimes a gift, sometimes an outrage. "When you swap, draw two cards and keep one." – "Each card can carry only one stamp." One twist reaches into everything else. Two of them tangle. After four bosses you are playing a game with nothing in common with yesterday's. And between games your hand grows: upgrade your stamps, tear open a pack, see three cards, keep one — maybe THE NIGHT-BLUE ACE, which is always trump. Your collection grows with every run. Five stages. No way back. Twelve games to the summit of a stage, and the difficulty tightens with every win. Five stages are waiting; each one opens only once you have cleared the one before. One defeat ends the run. Immediately. And the next one starts just as fast: different cards, different stamps, a different plan. Four of those twelve games are boss fights. Every boss brings its own special rule to the table — and plays by it while taking the trick off you. What's inside A hand of 32 cards from 7 to ace, 4 suits, a changing trump Many kinds of stamp in three tiers each, freely combined Special editions from the packs — THE NIGHT-BLUE ACE is always trump Five stages with bosses of their own and rising difficulty Twists you choose that turn the rest of the run upside down A collection that grows with every run One game is four hands — short enough for "just one more" A friendly colour palette, a cozy table, everything cut from paper Cozy music and punchy sounds you will recognise anywhere English and German, mouse, keyboard and controller

title: RabbitDice
shortDescription: Build a rabbit civilization from a single campfire. Give rabbits jobs, discover unexpected card combinations, and set the whole camp in motion with one roll of the dice. Help them build a spaceship and return to the Moon!
fullDescription: A Few Dice, a Few Cards, and a Rabbit Civilization That Gets Completely Out of Hand RabbitDice starts simple. You begin with a few coins, some resource cards, an unemployed rabbit, and only one roll at a time. Tear open different card packs and keep the cards you want. Stick a tool onto the rabbit, connect it to a resource card, and then roll! The rabbit chops wood -> The campfire burns it -> Coins pop out. Nothing too complicated — at first. Before long, the whole table starts moving on its own. Every card on the table can become part of your production network. Working rabbits gather resources. Haystacks and firewood stacks save them for larger payouts. Carrot soup sends tired rabbits back to work. Hot springs keep the colony happy. Stone wind chimes carry triggers from one card to another—and that’s only the beginning. Early on, a roll might trigger a single rabbit. With the right setup, that same number can set half the table in motion. You decide which cards share a number, where each signal should travel, which resources to cash in immediately, and which ones to save for a much bigger reward. Stickers Aren’t Just Decorations Stickers can completely change how a card works. Stick them on, peel them off, move them around, and use them again. Tool stickers give unemployed rabbits a job. Switch tools to change a rabbit’s profession. Apply the same tool again, and the rabbit may evolve into a stronger version of that profession. Trait stickers grant stackable abilities such as strength, focus, and luck. Number stickers change which numbers can trigger a card. That clueless little rabbit from the beginning doesn’t have to stay clueless forever. BTW, rabbits aren’t the only cards that can wear stickers. Luck Is Only the Beginning. Your Build Is What Matters. RabbitDice uses fully physics-driven dice, but you’re not completely at the mercy of luck. Keep rebuilding your table so more results can hit, fewer turns go to waste, and every successful trigger causes more actions to follow. As your civilization grows, you’ll eventually roll up to six dice at once. Multiple dice can form pairs, straights, matching sets, and other combinations that multiply the output of your entire production network. Some tasks also reward powerful one-roll Buffs that can send the whole table into overdrive. Choose What to Solve Next RabbitDice is packed with task cards. Each task pack offers new goals, but you decide which ones are worth keeping. Some tasks are simple: gather wood, earn coins, or merge two cards. Others ask you to truly understand the machine you’ve built: successfully trigger every number from one to six, cause six actions from a single roll, pass a signal through several stone wind chimes, or make the camp perform eight successful actions in one turn. Complete tasks to earn Gold, free card packs, or powerful Buffs that change your next roll. Of course, you’re always free to find your own 'strange' solution. Merge, Specialize, and Make Your Table Smarter Matching resource cards can be merged into larger sources with more capacity. Two function cards of the same type and tier can also be merged. Upgraded function cards can process more resources, produce larger rewards, and support more connections—turning a few scattered production chains into a full industrial network. Growth shouldn’t only mean making numbers bigger. Your network gradually becomes smarter. Connections and function cards take over work you’ve already learned, while your decisions grow from “What should I gather this turn?” into “How do I make the whole system explode on the next roll?” RabbitDice has the constant growth and explosive payoffs of an incremental game, but it isn’t an idle game. There are no offline rewards and no timers producing resources while you wait. You plan, open packs, make choices, apply stickers, connect cards, and rebuild your network—then roll the dice to resolve the entire turn. From a Campfire to the Stars RabbitDice offers a complete journey through six Ages. Each Age adds a major new mechanic to the same core game, bringing a new change—and a new moment of chaos—to your rabbit civilization. Old cards don’t automatically become useless when new technology arrives. They may keep doing their original jobs, find completely new uses, or combine with cards from much later Ages in unexpected ways. Complete the goals of your current Age, then decide for yourself when it’s time to evolve. You can also use a Rebirth Card whenever the time feels right. Convert the Gold earned during your current run into Embers, spend them on permanent upgrades, and begin a new camp with those upgrades intact. The game never forces you to reset on a timer. Whether you continue building or choose to begin again is always up to you. Finish the main journey to unlock Endless Mode and let your imagination run wild! 「RabbitDice is about building a chain-reaction system with your own hands, learning how it works, reshaping it, and finally watching it become far smarter than you ever expected.」

title: Hanafuda

fullDescription: 🎴 MATCH THE FLOWERS. BUILD YOUR YAKU. KNOW WHEN TO STOP. Hanafuda brings Koi-Koi🐟 , the classic two-player Japanese card game to an elegant, tactile 3D tabletop. Take your time against the computer or test your skills and luck against another player online. A traditional Hanafuda deck contains 48 cards, representing the twelve months of the year through flowers 🌸, animals 🦌, ribbons 🎀, and seasonal scenes🌕 . Play a card from your hand to match a month on the table, capture the pair, then reveal a card from the deck and watch the possibilities change again. Collect Brights , Animals , Ribbons , and Chaff to form Yaku : scoring combinations ranging from dependable foundations to celebrated hands such as Boar-Deer-Butterflies and the Five Brights. 🎴 THE DECISION AT THE HEART OF KOI-KOI Completing a Yaku presents you with a choice. Stop and secure your score, or call “ Koi-Koi ”🐟 and continue playing in pursuit of a greater reward by multiplying your score. Every captured card changes what remains possible, making timing, observation, probability, and nerve just as important as the cards you draw. 🎴 A CLASSIC GAME, CLEARLY PRESENTED • Follow the state of every round through at-a-glance card information, organized capture areas, and clear Yaku and scoring feedback. • Enjoy all 48 seasonal cards as tactile 3D pieces, brought to life with smooth dealing, matching, and capture animations. • Play solo against the computer or compete in online head-to-head matches. • Choose a 3-round short game, 6-round half year, or 12-round full year match. • Learn through a presentation designed to make months, card categories, matching opportunities, and potential Yaku easy to understand. 🎴 BEAUTIFUL, CALM, AND QUIETLY COMPETITIVE Hanafuda may appear serene, but every round becomes a contest of calculated risk. Build combinations, read your opponent’s captures, and decide whether one more turn is worth everything already gained. Will you take your points, or call Koi-Koi🐟 ?

title: High Stakes
shortDescription: High Stakes is a strategic roguelike card game where every prediction matters. Build powerful combinations of Stakes, earn Chips and Trump Cards, manipulate your deck, and master endless challenges with card series.
fullDescription: High Stakes is a strategic roguelike card game about risk, combinations, and the question: How many cards in a row can you predict? Combine multiple predictions for the same card to increase your odds. But your predictions are limited. Manipulate your deck, collect powerful stakes, use chips at the perfect moment, and develop new strategies with every run. Strategy Over Luck Will the next card be higher or lower? Red or black? Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, or Spades? You decide not only what you predict, but also how much you risk . Combine multiple predictions if you absolutely have to be right - or bet on just one possibility and save your remaining predictions for later. Chips If you discover a holographic card and then make the correct prediction, you’ll receive a Chip . Use chips exactly when you need them most to gain an advantage at the decisive moment. Trumps Every correct prediction earns you points and increases your multiplier. Reach score milestones and choose from several Trumps that boost your run with powerful rewards and special effects. The Shop After completing each stage, you’ll earn Tokens . Buy chips, add new cards to your deck, or discover powerful stakes and prepare for the challenges ahead. Boss Stages Every fourth stage features a Boss . Each Boss changes the rules of the game in its own way, forcing you to adapt your strategy on the fly. title: DaiDee 大弟
shortDescription: DaiDee 大弟 turns Hong Kong Big Two into a solo run for survival. Split 13 cards into unbeatable combos, chain plays to stoke the Flow, and unleash bombs that seize the table. Between rounds, stack Style cards that rewrite the rules. Miss the target and the run is over. Play it smart, play it loud.
fullDescription: DaiDee 大弟 is a single-player roguelike built on Hong Kong Big Two combo grammar. No opponents, no passing, no AI opponents. The puzzle is you versus your own hand and the round's score target. How it plays Each round you draw 16 cards, keep 13, and split them into legal Big Two combos: singles, pairs, triples, straights, flushes, full houses, bombs all within a strict play budget. Play order matters. Climbing Ladders and seizing the table with bombs builds Flow, the multiplier on your score. Round score = Power × Flow, minus penalties for unplayed cards. 2s are your finishers. Play a group of 2s right after another combo to Link (+Flow), or close the round on a 2 Finisher for a bonus and the 2♠, the single highest card in the deck, is always waiting for the right moment. Progression and difficulty Between rounds, spend money on Style cards that rewrite how your hand can be split: turn a triple plus a stray card into a Cracked Bomb, substitute a rank in a straight, or fold two pairs into one four-card play. Bosses impose constraints, reversed ladders, a Tax Collector, a seat reserved for your highest card. Miss the target and the run ends. Features True Hong Kong Big Two grammar: straights, flushes, full houses, bombs, 2 Links, finishers Runs built on partitioning and ordering, no opponents, no dead draws Style cards across grammar, scoring, sequencing, economy, and manipulation Escalating targets and boss constraints

title: Potion Drifter
shortDescription: A cozy first-person alchemy game with hands-on physics. Cast out of the city of alchemists, travel from village to village with a fold-out cart. Throw herbs into your cauldron, pour water, and grind ingredients to brew potions for people you meet. Discover recipes, explore, and grow as an alchemist.
fullDescription: You're an alchemist. And you were lucky. You were born in the place everyone dreams about: the city of the great alchemists. Stone into gold, herbs into medicine, all of it. Sounds great, right? It would be. If only you could stop messing with things. But you couldn't. You kept experimenting. And one day you experimented a little too much, so they threw you out. They gave you an old cart, a cracked cauldron, and a mortar, and said: come back when you're a real alchemist. Not before. So now you're on the road. Villages, mountains, open meadows. Out here nobody wants gold, and nobody needs a potion for eternal life. Old Yaryna's back hurts. The farmer's cow won't give milk. The orchard's soil is dead. Simple problems. Simple people. And the best part? This is where you finally get to do the thing they threw you out for. Experiment as much as you want. Brew right on the road Your cart opens into a full alchemy table - cauldron, mortar, all of it. Add some wood, pour the water, throw in your ingredients, and take out a finished potion. You don't need a lab. Your lab travels with you. Experiment (and fail) Get the recipe right, and you get the potion you wanted. Miss one ingredient, and the cauldron tells you how close you were. And sometimes you make something strange that even you can't explain. But that's often how you find something new. Collect recipes in the world Someone left an old scroll near the ruins. A villager will share one if you help them. And some you find yourself, by dropping the right herbs in the pot. Your recipe book grows with you. Explore and gather Meadows, woods, paths between the mountains. Herbs don't grow everywhere, so some you have to look for. And while you search, you find traces of people who walked these roads before you. Help people (and animals) Someone's back hurts. Someone's cow won't give milk. Someone's orchard is dying. You're not saving the world from a dragon. You just make someone's day a little better. And that feels good. Upgrade your cauldron, not your muscles A better cauldron makes harder potions. A bigger bag takes you further. You grow as an alchemist, not a fighter. No combat, no survival, no death. Just you, the road, and the pot. Oh, and the cauldron? It has an opinion about everything you brew. And it will tell you.

title: Wager of Banners
shortDescription: Your village is one of several on a small island, and none of the others intend to stay small. Build it out of what it already makes, sharpen a deck that reshuffles every night, and pick your fights carefully. Beaten villagers here are not killed. They are taken, and they do not come back.
fullDescription: Your village is one of several on a small island. None of the others intend to stay small. You inherit a tavern and nothing else. Everything after it has to be paid for out of what the village already makes, so you start with ale and you trade upward from there. Every morning your deck deals you a hand and you work out which card belongs at which door. The same card is worth different things in different villages: a flat two coins in a thin town, six in a thick one where you have built its neighbours or filled the place with tradesmen it likes. Your villagers turn up with names of their own, a trade they lean toward, and a quirk that pays out in some situations and never in others. Fenn of the Long Table is worth two extra ale a night behind the bar and will not survive a serious argument. Raise your war banner and the whole island knows where to point. A raid comes down to a duel: two champions, best of three rounds, both swinging at the same time. The defender has the ground and knows it, and whoever you send works no post that night, so a raid costs you a day before anyone throws a punch. Nobody dies here. Beaten fighters are taken, and they do not come back — they work for whoever took them, permanently. Empty a village of its people and the place is yours: the treasury, the stores, and your pick of the cards it spent a season assembling. Nights resolve on their own, so a season runs at whatever pace the table keeps. Play one alone against the AI villages, or share the island with other stewards. In short Six establishments, each paid for in the goods you already make A deck that deals and reshuffles every single day, and cards that read the board around them Villagers with their own names, perks, trades and rarity, from labourers to legends Asynchronous raids, armed in daylight and fought at midnight whether you are watching or not Best-of-three duels with home ground, parries and knockouts Permanent capture instead of death, and conquest of whoever runs out of people first

title: ManiWheel
shortDescription: A mani wheel is a Tibetan Buddhist prayer wheel said to grant the same virtue as reciting scripture when spun. Arrange letters, spin the wheel, accumulate Virtue and Mercy, and reincarnate again and again. Discover powerful interactions and find your own path to enlightenment.
fullDescription: Spin. Build. Reincarnate. ManiWheel is an idle incremental game about combining letters and accumulating Virtue and Mercy. A mani wheel is a sacred object used in Tibetan Buddhism. Spinning it is said to grant the same virtue as reciting scripture. In this game, you will place various letters on your mani wheel and link together the effects they activate as it spins, gradually building your own engine for generating Virtue. Combine Letters and Build Your Own Mani Wheel Letters have a wide variety of effects. Some generate Virtue, some accelerate the wheel, some strengthen adjacent letters, and others generate new letters. Even a small effect can produce dramatically different results depending on its position, activation order, and connections with the letters above, below, left, and right. Acquire new letters, experiment with their placement, and discover increasingly powerful interactions. Gather Souls and Combine Front and Back Effects As you progress, you will unlock Souls that drift around the mani wheel, as well as Letter Fusion, which allows a single letter to carry two separate effects. Souls produce nothing on their own, but when combined with the right letters, they can generate Virtue, Mercy, or even new letters. Fuse high-rarity letters to create more complex, dual-sided letters whose front and back effects activate in sequence. Spend Mercy and Open the Path to Reincarnation Once you have accumulated Mercy, open the Reincarnation Map. Gradually unlock adjacent spaces to permanently strengthen your mani wheel or preserve letters to carry into your next reincarnation. Each reincarnation expands your options, allowing you to experiment with new combinations and entirely different paths of progression. Key Features An incremental game supporting both manual control and automatic spinning A wide variety of letter combinations whose effects change based on placement and activation order Six rarity tiers and a letter collection catalog Mid- and late-game systems featuring Souls, Letter Fusion, and dual-sided letters A Reincarnation Map with permanent upgrades unlocked using Mercy A one-lap log that lets you inspect exactly how your setup works Offline progression Available in Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, and German Spin the mani wheel, discover the interactions between its letters, and reincarnate again and again as you find your own path to enlightenment.

title: Skewered Up!
shortDescription: Stack absurd combos onto a single skewer. Every ingredient reacts to its neighbours, so the order you place them in is the whole game. Grill, cash out, upgrade your skewer, and serve customers with impossible demands in this fast, physical roguelike deckbuilder. Easy to learn. Brutal to master.
fullDescription: ONE SKEWER. INFINITE BAD DECISIONS. Skewered Up! is a roguelike deckbuilder where you try to stack ingredients in the right order and then cook to satisfy the target points of your customers. Every few seconds the machine hands you three ingredients. You get to keep one. You slide it onto the skewer. Pepper that scores off its neighbours. Butter that drips onto whatever sits below it. An Onion that only pays out per every vegetable on the skewer. Every Ingredient has a unique skill that interacts with other ingredients or conditions. Then you hit the grill, and your ordering either sings or falls apart trying to reach the target point. POSITION IS THE WHOLE GAME Ingredients are cooked from left to right, from the closed end of the skewer to the open one. That single rule is where all the depth lives. Adjacency, order, and distance all matter. "Before", "after", "first", "last", "between", "every third" — the effect text is simple, the arrangement problem is not. Every ingredient is one sentence long. The complexity is never in the ingredient itself. It is in the relationships with other ingredients. Positioning is a physical act. You grab the ingredient, squeeze it in from the tip of the skewer. THE SKEWER FIGHTS BACK This is not a tidy grid of cards. It is a metal rod with limited space and food that has opinions. Squeeze. Out of room? Grab one end and press. You will make space temporarily. Ingredients will scale back to their original sizes unless there is another skill that changes everything. Venus Flytrap moves along the skewer eats up all the other meats, gains extra point per every ingredient it ate. Dragon Fruit  gains extra points per every unique ingredient on the scewer. Relishes do not take a slot at all — they ride on top of whatever you put them over. CUSTOMERS WHO WANT TOO MUCH Each customer sets a target score for that round, plus two higher thresholds that pay extra if you get greedy and clear them. They also bring rules and effects. Meat scores at half value today. The skewer is shorter today. You only get two choices instead of three, and the ingredients are all oversized. And they make requests. End the kebab on something spicy. Use no more than three distinct ingredients. Drop one on the floor on purpose. Meet them and the money comes in — which is the only reason you get a better deck. BUILD A DECK THAT SHOULDN'T WORK Between customers you visit the shop, and the shop is where runs are decided. Crack open crates — Vegetable, Meat, Spicy, Seafood — and fold new ingredients into your deck. Buy charms with run-wide effects. Start and end on a vegetable for a multiplier on everything. Keep it to three distinct ingredients and get paid for your restraint. You only get so many slots, so every new one costs you an old favourite. Enhance what you already own using Stamps. Make an ingredient trigger twice. Bolt an extra tag onto it. Shrink it so it takes less room. Thin the deck by permanently destroying the ingredients that stopped pulling their weight. Lengthen your skewer. Then buy a second one. Then a third. Each one scores separately and all of them add up. LEARN IT IN A MINUTE. CHASE IT FOR MONTHS. No reflex checks. Success comes from what you built and where you put it, not from twitch execution. Real time pressure. Ingredients keep coming. Deliberating is itself a cost. Randomness that opens doors rather than closing them. A bad draw is a different plan, not a dead run. Multiple viable strategies every single run — and rare ingredients strong enough to make you rebuild your whole deck around them. COME BACK BETTER Every run ends with a full breakdown — how long you lasted, your most-used ingredient, your single biggest round. Then you unlock things. New ingredients enter the pool. New power-ups. New starter decks with completely different opening identities. New difficulties that raise the score requirements, stack harsher customer conditions, and add more customers to survive. The first run teaches you the rules. The fortieth teaches you what they're actually for. WHAT'S IN THE BOX Run-based roguelike deckbuilding with a physical, hands-on twist Dozens of ingredients across Meat, Vegetable, Sauce, Cheese, Spice and Relish types Order-dependent effects that chain into exponential scoring Squeeze, wiggle, pierce and drop mechanics that keep every skewer tense A deep between-round shop: crates, power-ups, enhancements, deck thinning, skewer upgrades Up to three skewers scoring in parallel Customers with modifiers and bonus requests that reshape each round Warm, chaotic kebab-shop presentation rooted in Turkish street food culture Add Skewered Up! to your wishlist to be notified the moment the grill is lit.

fullDescription: Thanks to the cooperation with FlixBus , the Fernbus Coach Simulator lets you experience the world of driving a large coach on Germany's Autobahn and motorways in great detail. Driving a large and modern MAN Lion’s Coach bus, you will experience the everyday life of a coach bus driver. Navigate a complex network of motorways and roads to bus stations in more than 40 German cities and stay in constant contact with the control centre. Drive your bus carefully on the highways by day and night, in all seasons and in all weathers. Approximately 20.000 km of the German FlixBus route network have been recreated. As in real life, passengers who already have a valid ticket can board the bus immediately at the bus stops while the other passengers have to buy a new ticket from the driver. Both licenced MAN coaches are equipped with original cockpits including all functions. fullDescription: Navigate miles and miles of tyre changing, fuel burning, carburettor busting, mud clattering terrain, through night and day, rain and shine. Adapt to whatever the procedurally generated world of Jalopy can throw at you. Upgrade, maintain and care for your Laika 601 Deluxe motor vehicle. Keep close attention to everything from the state of your tyres, the condition of your engine and even the space in your trunk. Repair each aspect of your scrappy little car and install unique upgrades to deal with the changing world. Everything from cargo weight to the condition of your carburettor will determine how your car performs on the open road. The rise of capitalism brings an economical conundrum. Scavenge for scraps to make a small return of investment, or become a baron of the open road and smuggle contraband under the eyes of border patrols to make a sizable profit. Developer Greg Pryjmachuk worked on the Formula 1 franchise from 2009 through to 2014. In late 2014, Greg began work on this new driving simulation featuring the fictional Laika 601 Deluxe car; reminiscent of the East German “Trabbie”, it will need much love and care to keep it going on this memorable road trip!

fullDescription: City Car Driving is a realistic driving simulator that will help you to master the basic skills of car driving in different road conditions, immersing in an environment as close as possible to real . "Smart" traffic that accurately simulates traffic in the current, unpredictable pedestrians and sudden dangerous situations will not let you relax and will maintain the atmosphere of a real traffic situation. Also full range of weather conditions and times of a day from rain and morning fog to night ice and snow will help to prepare for driving under the most unfavorable conditions. Using the traffic rules compliance monitoring system and the instructor hints you will fix the knowledge of traffic laws in different countries of the world. The list of these countries will expand in updates. On special autodromes you will be able to work out different types of exercises, both basic, for instruction in driving, and special, for working out the elements of ex treme driving and counter accident training. Realistic traffic behavior which can violate traffic rules, park or leave parking lots. Trams as full-fledged participant of traffic. The updated progression system and the comprehensive management element, including route planning, the purchase and sale of buses, staff planning and numerous statistics will guarantee long-term game motivation. Smart traffic AI and a range of challenging traffic situations await you (bus station, night driving, construction sites, diversions, long-distance journeys, potholes, traffic jams, accidents and speed bumps, etc.). For a complete gaming experience, a variety of incidents in the bus, e.g. interior soiling and debris, special passenger requests, fare dodgers, loud music and cars parked in designated bus bays. title: Redout: Enhanced Edition
shortDescription: Redout is a tribute to the old racing monsters such as F-Zero, WipeOut, Rollcage, and POD. It is designed to be an uncompromising, fast, tough and satisfying driving experience, soaked in that vertigo that stands at the core of the arcade racing genre.
fullDescription: NEXT GENERATION AG RACING IS HERE! Redout is a tribute to the old racing monsters such as F-Zero, WipeOut, Rollcage, and POD. It is designed to be an uncompromising, fast, tough and satisfying driving experience, soaked in that vertigo that stands at the core of the arcade racing genre. The floating system and driving models are based on physics: each turn, slope, hard braking, acceleration, each turn and twist of the track will apply a unique force to the ship. A sharp low-polygon style blends meshes and terrains with the latest state-of-the-art shading and lighting effects provided by the Unreal Engine 4 , creating beautiful and instantly recognisable aesthetics. Breezy coastlines, eerie frozen landscapes, vast desert plains: the melancholic, dystopian atmosphere of a semi abandoned Earth is the background for the most high-speed, tense and beautiful futuristic racing clashes. Features Online multiplayer - match against 12 players around the world for a real challenge Optional VR Support - Oculus Rift, HTC Vive or OSVR. With a new shiny cockpit view! Career mode - 100+ events to race, experience, level up and upgrade your ship A Diverse World - 25 tracks scattered around 5 locations on a post-apocalyptic Earth, plus boss circuits Never bored - 11 event types, from classic Race to innovative Arena Race and Score-Based Endurance Create your story - 6 racing teams, each requiring a different driving approach, and 4 increasingly fast racing classes Powerup - 10+ racing-focused, upgradable powerups: additional turbo, shields, self-repair drone, advanced grip system, slipstream enhancers, and more Music for your ears - full 5.1 support and a dynamic soundtrack that will drop sicker and sicker beats the faster you go! Speed Redout is the fastest game ever made. If you can handle it. It's not about the numbers you see on screen, it's about the vibrations, the landscape and buildings flying by, the high-speed collisions, the effects, the sounds, the immersion: everything is meant to feel like you're going FAST. Online Multiplayer Challenge up to 12 players from all over the world and find out who's the best Redout pilot in history! Do you think you have got what it takes? Prove it. True glory is a flame lighted at the skies. Dynamic Soundtrack Prepare your ears for one of the most intense dynamic soundtracks you have ever heard. Redout enhances your experience and transcends visuals, immersing yourself in a mixture of sounds and music that adapts to your playstyle and your performance on the track. Immersive VR We have been working hard to give you the best VR game yet. Get inside your HMD to experience 3D and distances like never before, you'll know exactly where the apex is and feel a whole new level of control. VR support is optional . Handling Control is the most important feeling when you are racing at 800km/h. Redout features believable physics derived from quad-copters controllers and real magnetic forces. We came up with the next generation in AG handling. There's always a way to face a corner without braking, but you have to prepare for it and use everything you've got. Steer, strafe and turbo out of a corner are the basics: upgrades and powerups will grant you even more control on your ship's behaviour. You'll need to dominate your ship before you face the advanced tracks. Thriving Discord Community Whatever you are in for a casual multiplayer match or just for some chitchatting during a break, the official Discord server is there for you! Join our community and get to know some of the people who helped shaping Redout's lore and ecosystem, on top of getting exclusive information about development and previews on what's happening inside the Redout Universe. A Rich Context AD 2560. Earth stripped of its natural resources. Global warming caused the melting of the northern polar ice cap, tropical storms ravage all areas that didn’t suffer from desertification. Pockets of humans are crawling their lives away in a few slums, descendants of those who were left behind or refused to leave. Others created huge conurbations, based upon some of the most populous cities once on Earth. Most of humanity, though, has moved on the Moon, Mars, Titan, and other Jupiter’s moons. Earth is often used as a location for entertainment events like hi-speed races, futuristic amusement parks and zoo parks, which allows local communities to work and profit in a harsh environment. One of the most popular sports is the SRRL, or Solar Redout Racing League: the fastest racing league ever created, where humanity's best pilots drive high speed anti-gravity ships on magnetic tracks, risking their lives at each and every corner, in exchange for neverending glory.

Take your time to build your ancient city, step into our ancestors footsteps and get immersed in the ancient times. In Ancient Cities you can play at any time and place of the European Stone Age . From the warm Mediterranean to cold Scandinavia and from the end of the Ice Age to the end of the Neolithic. In each time and place you will have historically accurate forests, animals, buildings, tools, resources and knowledge of each culture that you will have to manage to survive in the harsh ancient times. Ancient Cities reduces micromanagement through intelligent automation.  Organise and build while your citizens perform the tasks that best suit their specific skills and knowledge. In the regional game layer, you will be able to trade or attack neighbouring tribes or perhaps decide to migrate elsewhere if resources become scarce. This is only the beginning, Ancient Cities has been designed as an ever-improving platform that supports the continuous introduction of new compatible content to explore new cultures and places throughout history. title: Total War: THREE KINGDOMS
shortDescription: Unite Ancient China under your rule through a thrilling blend of turn-based empire building and real-time battles. Use the Guanxi System and diplomacy to forge alliances, and build powerful armies with hundreds of unique infantry, cavalry and war machine units.
fullDescription: Total War: THREE KINGDOMS is the first in the multi award-winning strategy series to recreate epic conflict across ancient China. Combining a gripping turn-based campaign game of empire-building, statecraft and conquest with stunning real-time battles, Total War: THREE KINGDOMS redefines the series in an age of heroes and legends. China in 190CE Welcome to a new era of legendary conquest. This beautiful but fractured land calls out for a new emperor and a new way of life. Unite China under your rule, forge the next great dynasty, and build a legacy that will last through the ages. Choose from a cast of 12 legendary Warlords and conquer the realm. Recruit heroic characters to aide your cause and dominate your enemies on military, technological, political, and economic fronts. Will you build powerful friendships, form brotherly alliances, and earn the respect of your many foes? Or would you rather commit acts of treachery, inflict heart-wrenching betrayals, and become a master of grand political intrigue? Your legend is yet to be written, but one thing is certain: glorious conquest awaits. ANCIENT CHINA RECREATED Discover Three Kingdoms China, a land of breath-taking natural beauty. Battle across lush subtropics, arid deserts and snow-capped mountains. Marvel at legendary landmarks like the Great Wall of China and the Yangtze River. Explore the length and breadth of ancient China as you restore harmony to its embattled landscape. CHINA’S GREATEST LEGENDS Forge a new empire as one of 12 legendary Warlords drawn from China’s celebrated historical epic, the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Peerless commanders, powerful warriors and eminent statesmen, these characters each have a unique playstyle and objectives. Recruit an epic supporting cast of heroes to command your armies, govern your provinces and strengthen your growing empire. Characters are the beating heart of the game, and China’s very future will be shaped by its champions. GUANXI SYSTEM Modelled on Guanxi, the Chinese concept of dynamic inter-relationships, Total War: THREE KINGDOMS takes a paradigm-shifting approach to character agency, with iconic, larger-than-life heroes and their relationships defining the future of ancient China. Each of these characters is brought to life with their own unique personality, motivations, and likes/dislikes. They also form their own deep relationships with each other, both positive and negative, that shape how your story plays out. ARTISTIC PURITY With stunning visuals and flamboyant Wushu combat, THREE KINGDOMS is the art of war. With beautiful UI, vibrant vistas and authentic Chinese-inspired artwork, this reimagining of ancient China is a visual feast. REAL-TIME & TURN-BASED HARMONY The turn-based campaign and real-time battles of Total War: THREE KINGDOMS are more interconnected than ever before. Actions in battle now have much greater consequences, affecting your Heroes’ relationship towards you, as well as the friendships and rivalries they develop with other characters. In a world where powerful allies are one of the keys to success, this adds a brand-new element to how victory is achieved.

title: Swords 'n Magic and Stuff
shortDescription: Grab your friends and set out for adventure in this cozy, multiplayer, open world RPG! Explore, quest and craft your way through a densely packed open world. Level up 6 different classes and buy land to build and decorate your home to settle down in this medieval fantasy world.
fullDescription: Swords 'n Magic and Stuff is a cozy, cooperative, open world RPG centered around the joy of discovery.  Start your journey as a hopeful hero on their way to Tirawyn, a land of adventure. But along the way your ship is boarded by an orc warband and you're thrown into a dungeon with your childhood friend. Escape your captors and head out into a large open world to write your own story. Swords 'n Magic and Stuff is all about exploration and adventure. Explore a densely packed, hand-crafted, open world and reignite your sense of discovery as you uncover new secrets around every corner. Go it alone or bring along all of your friends in a cooperative online multiplayer experience featuring a simple multiplayer lobby system or host your own dedicated server. With locally saved characters, you carry your progress to your friends' servers so you never have to start over. Who says cozy RPG's can't have depth? Swords 'n Magic's combat system is fluid, fun and action focused. Strafe, dodge, parry and attack without ever being rooted in place. Combat is based around 6 different classes you can level up independently by simply using the different weapons tied to them. Dual wield any weapons you like and mix and match your gear to fine tune your playstyle. Become a splash potion-slinging rogue, a necromancer warrior, or even a bardic healer. The limit is your own creativity. Swords 'n Magic and Stuff offers over 1500 unique items to discover and collect as you adventure through the world. Dig through piles of dirt to discover bait for fishing, seeds for planting or magic cubes for donating to evil cults. Discover new chests each day with a randomized, respawning chest system that ensures you've always got new loot to plunder as you explore. And the best part? All the loot is local to you, so you never have to fight over it with your friends. Swords 'n Magic has hundreds of quests. Some quests are fetch quests, some are kill quests and some require you to lure hundreds of angry bees into the arms of a bee fanatic for a big, cozy bee hug. Discover loads of secret quests by reading stashed away books, stumbling through hidden doors or paying close attention to the hundreds of NPC's all with unique dialog. Questing in Swords 'n Magic is as much of an adventure as anything else and it's not always laid out directly in front of you. No RPG would be complete without the ability to craft. Swords 'n Magic and Stuff offers several crafting skills to level up, including blacksmithing, carpentry, tailoring, cooking, farming and alchemy. Discover new recipes by leveling up your craft, visiting different shops, looting chests or completing quests. Harvest resources with tools, pick plants and herbs, start a farming empire or enjoy the simple life fishing on the local pond. Discover plots of land for sale scattered all around Tirawyn. Buy one (or all of them) and stake your claim to your own little safe haven. Use blueprints for buildable structures to construct your first home, or design it from the ground up. With a grid-free decoration system, you can freely decorate your plots however you see fit with hundreds of unique collectible furniture items. Want to cover your entire house in gems? Build a museum to show off rare items? Design a tavern for you and your friends to come back to after an adventure? Go for it. Swords 'n Magic and Stuff was designed from the ground up with a more casual experience in mind. As a husband and wife dev team, we have very different tastes in games at times. Swords 'n Magic is a love letter to the gamer couples out there who are looking for a cozy life sim game with a heaping helping of exploration and action combat. As avid MMO players, we know what the grind to get the most desirable gear can be like, and Swords 'n Magic promises to make that grind far more casual, being friendly to busy schedules and short attention spans. Funded and driven by our community Swords 'n Magic and Stuff was a successfully funded Kickstarter game that owes its existence to our incredible community! We work hard to listen to the feedback of our players and implement it into the continuous development of this game.

title: Quiet as a Stone
shortDescription: Quiet as a Stone is a meditative digital toy and landscape creator. Slash grass to reveal artifacts, mine stones for gems, craft & photograph atmospheric vignettes in a realm defined by solitude, impermanence, and the quiet beauty of decay. Step into an autumnal world of dormant nature in minature.
fullDescription: Moments of Calm in a Crumbling World Drift into a world that has already ended, and find the beauty that remains. Quiet as a Stone is a slow-paced, atmospheric toy designed for those who wish to curate moments of stillness. Set against a backdrop of autumnal twilight and ancient history, you will explore small, procedural dioramas. From the moss on a fallen pillar to the crackle of a campfire, every element is yours to manipulate, photograph, and contemplate. Accept transience and imperfection. Observe: Watch the day turn to night, the weather shift from a crisp morning to rolling fog, the light casts across weathered stone, rain falls and the petrichor rises. Interact: Click to slash through overgrowth, mine ancient stones for magic gems, and discover hidden artifacts. There is no rush. The stones have waited centuries; they can wait for you. Create: Use your gathered gems to place trees, ruins, and foliage. Transform a barren rock into a shrine. Create, Photograph then let go. Key Features A Digital Canvas: A hybrid of landscape gardening and 3D diorama building. No grids, no strict rules—just organic placement of rocks, ruins, and trees. Generative Atmosphere: A dynamic, realistic audioscape that reacts to your scene, perfect for relaxation or focus. The Photographer’s Eye: A robust Photo Mode with controls for aperture, exposure, color grading, and filters. Capture your vignette before it fades forever. The Cycle of Impermanence: There is no management or pressure. You visit a location, capture its beauty, and move on to the next discovery. Subdued Aesthetics: A visual palette of ochre, olive, orange and slate. The ambience of autumn. Is Quiet as a Stone for you? Play this if: You love taking screenshots in games, you enjoy the sound of rain against a window, or you are looking for a low-stress "second monitor" experience to help you unwind. Look elsewhere if: You are seeking a complex city-builder, strategy, action, or a traditional "Clicker" with exponential math progression. All that is good must pass away

fullDescription: Do you like puzzles? Do you like base building games? Look no further! Space is tight on the tiny islands, and roads may not cross - lest the stubborn haulers run into each other! title: Rogue Command
shortDescription: True RTS gameplay reinforced with roguelite build crafting. Control units with bullet-time precision. Call down bases and raise armies. Drafted from a different arsenal every run. Weave builds that break the game. Or the game breaks you.
fullDescription: THE RTS… Rogue Command is a single-player RTS that plays like the classics  that defined the genre.   Control your units, build your base, harvest resources, explore the map, defend positions and come up with a plan of attack . But now with every run the rules of the battlefield change and each battle is an opportunity to discover new ways to play.  And when the action gets overwhelming, you can slow down time to 10% at any moment, allowing you to give orders with bullet-time precision . …ROGUELITE After each battle you choose new tools for the fights ahead. Reinforcing existing strengths or pushing your build into new directions:  Blueprints add a new building to your Engineer's construction database:  Unit factories , defensive turrets , healing spires or super weapons , the nuts and bolts of your army. Upgrades modify your blueprints. Make units stronger. Or add new traits to make them part of an emerging synergy. Like adding burn damage to their attacks or letting them burst into skittering exploding spawnlings when they die.  Hacks  are powerful tech-relics that modify the rules of the game. Adding a new facet to a status effect, making burning enemies flee or adding a healing effect to teleports. Win or lose, each run you unlock new building blocks for your arsenal. Adding entries to the mysterious database of the gleefully malfunctioning Engineers across the galaxy. With hundreds of units, hacks and upgrades waiting to be built and tested in battle.  GET SMARTER & GROW STRONGER Earn  archive tokens to unlock permanent improvements  in the vast skill tree of the Battle Archive . Push hard into a specific trait or spread your points wide to accumulate many smaller bonuses. Or unlock ways to control the randomness. Experiment and find what suits your playstyle best.  FIGHT THE WAY YOU WANT Before each run you choose your: Engineer : Your presence on the map. Can call down buildings and control armies. Lose your Engineer, lose the run. Economy : Refinery and Harvester models determine the shape of your economy. Specialist : The foundation of your build and formidable presence in combat. Each modifies the rules of the battlefield. With unique Specialist Hacks pushing their traits into odds-bending extremes. Castle  provides incredible defense and global artillery strikes. Incinerator covers the battlefield in smart fire, burning enemies and aiding allies.  Recycler  summons hordes of Robo Zombos from the remnants of your fallen units making death a resource. Support Tank  applies lifesaving buffs to your squads. Swarm Walker  infects your enemies with Spider Spawn Eggs. Mantis feeds on its allies to gain unfathomable strength. Rush Beacons  quickly establish map presence and mobility. Phase Walker  teleports itself and its squad granting buffs and causing havoc. NUMEROUS ENEMIES & ENDLESS BATTLEFIELDS  The planet-devouring PCX  (Planetary Core Extraction Corporation) - has spread across the galaxy. Only the occasional Engineer with a crystalline consciousness infection standing in their way. Dozens of enemy variants fielding armies with more than 150 units and buildings of their own will keep you sweating over every decision and force you to adapt. No battlefield will be the same. And conditions can suddenly shift:   Sunstorms disable all shields on friend or foe. Thunderstorms extinguish fires. Sandstorms diminish the range of attacks. A blessing or a curse? Depends on your build and your enemy.  "JUST ONE MORE RUN..." - AGAIN AND AGAIN A first win is only the start:   15 Ascensions with unique bosses  provide escalating challenges for dozens or even hundreds of hours . Your command of the battlefield grows. Your Battle Archive fills out. You  discover new combinations to obliterate enemies that crushed you before. Until you are ready to face the final challenge. And if that is not enough, you can fight your way through infinitely scaling Heat Levels until you break the game or the game breaks you.

title: WRC 10 FIA World Rally Championship
shortDescription: Hailed by reviewers and professional drivers, the standard-setting off-road racing simulation has been reinvented! Reach the 2021 season podium, and to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the competition, relive the highlights at the wheel of legendary cars.
fullDescription:
To celebrate the 50th anniversary of the championship, WRC 10 is offering a brand-new Anniversary edition, packed with new content and sensations. Relive the most intense moments from 1973 to today! WRC 10 History Mode puts your driving talents to the test through 19 historical events that require you to adapt to racing conditions of each time period. 
 
Never-before-seen content for WRC: 
- The 4 new 2021 rallies: Estonia, Croatia, Belgium and Spain 
- 6 historic rallies including Acropolis, San Remo, Germany and Argentina 
- 120 special stages 
- 52 official teams from the 2021 season (WRC, WRC2, WRC3, Junior WRC), 
- 20 legendary cars from Alpine, Audi, Lancia, Subaru, Ford, Mitsubishi, Toyota, and more... 
 
Career Mode, unanimously hailed as one of the best-developed and most complete in a racing game, has also been comprehensively upgraded and now includes a livery editor, so you can create your own team and add your colours to contemporary cars! 
 
With a hyper-realistic and ultra-precise physics engine, WRC 10 has made the feeling of driving even better, with better aerodynamic force, turbo and braking management, on all surfaces. The sound design has also been revamped to reinforce the immersion. 
 
A particularly competitive eSport, with daily and weekly challenges, and clubs so you can create your own competitions, drivers can measure themselves against the community at their own levels.

title: 鬼谷八荒 Tale of Immortal
shortDescription: Tale of Immortal is an open-world sandbox based on Chinese mythology and cultivation. You will grow to become immortal, conquer the beasts from the Classic of Mountains and Season, make your choices carefully and grasp your own destiny.
fullDescription: Tale of Immortal is an open-world sandbox game based on Chinese mythology and cultivation. You will grow to become immortal, conquer the beasts from the Classic of Mountains and Season, make your choices carefully and grasp your own destiny. Step into the enchanting world of the Tale of Immortal, where cultivation is an art that requires more than just financial means and help from fellow cultivators. To truly master it, one must possess a deep understanding of the craft and have access to the right cultivation venues. But that's not all—the journey is fraught with danger, as you'll face unpredictable monsters, crisis-ridden mystic realms, insurmountable barriers, and brilliant treasures waiting to be discovered. As a novice cultivator in the Qi Refining stage, you'll set out from Yukong Village to cultivate your inner strength, defy the odds, and overcome adversity. With each breakthrough, you'll be able to rewrite your destiny and cleave through the thorns on your journey. Cross continents, witness the wonders of the world, and then ascend to Tian Yuan Mountain, where the ultimate enlightenment of the Way awaits. Embrace a fully-realized NPC world, where each character is a unique entity with their own friends, family, and life trajectory— completely independent of your progress. However, if you choose to meddle, you certainly can! The game is yours to shape as you wish. Collaborate with your beloved to save the day, seek revenge alone, or even become the enemy of all. The choice is yours to make. Master martial arts, teach NPCs the Taoist Mind, learn from seasoned gurus, and accept eager disciples. You can also take on the NPCs in the auction house and follow it up by drawing your sword or claiming your hard-earned spoils. As part of a group of immortal cultivators, you can either shine bright or cultivate in secrecy. It's all up to you and the path you choose to take. Are you ready to embark on a thrilling adventure? One where you might become the hero who saves the day and wins the heart of the love of your life? Or maybe you're looking to stir up some jealousy in your crush and have them fight for your affection? How about fulfilling a fifty-year-old promise or getting caught up in the struggle of a mysterious organization? Perhaps you'll uncover a long-forgotten treasure, only to have it snatched away by a cunning adversary? The possibilities are endless! But that's just the beginning! As you journey through this immersive world, apart from interacting with a rich cast of NPCs, you'll encounter a plethora of random events and side tasks that will keep you on your toes. Some might leave you feeling frustrated or hurt, while others could be just the thing to save you or make you stronger after facing danger head-on. Every decision you make will shape the narrative, leading to a unique and unforgettable story that's yours alone. Do you want to take your sect to new heights of power and glory? We've got the ultimate sect management gameplay that lets you experience the full range of sect life: from humble disciple to mighty sect master. Join a massive sect and work your way up from the bottom, or take on the challenge of leading a fallen sect back to prominence. As a Disciple, you'll complete sect missions, compete in sect tournaments, and fight for glory and resources for your sect. As an Elder, you'll be responsible for teaching and guiding your disciples, assigning tasks, and accelerating the sect's growth. The real power and responsibility, however, lie with the Sect Leader. You'll need to keep order in the sect, plan strategic attacks and defenses, and fight for precious resources like Spirit Mines. If you're ambitious enough, you can even conquer other sects and seize their exclusive "Rewrite Destiny" and manuals. Achieve your wildest ambitions and unify the world, as long as you have the strength and the drive to make it happen. To embark on an epic adventure, you need to hone your skills and become a true warrior. Start by building a solid foundation of cultivation. Your mind skills are crucial to success, so focus on cultivating a powerful mindset. From there, you can delve into martial and spiritual skills to take your abilities to the next level. As you explore, keep an eye out for opportunities to create edges with your motion and special skills. And don't forget to tap into your ultimate skills to save the day when necessary. There are a dozen of manuals to choose from, each with its own unique characteristics. Will you specialize in one of the twelve Spiritual Roots, or master them all? What school of martial arts will you establish? The choice is yours. There are treasures to be found in every corner of this world. From the Manual Pavilion to the mystic realms and beyond, you never know what you might discover. And with hundreds of rare and exotic monsters, fellow cultivators, ghosts, demons, and immortals to test your strength against, you'll never be bored. If you're up for a challenge, why not try your luck at the Immortal Tournament or the Master Rankings? Can you break through the barriers of the Nether Mountains? Will your school rise to the occasion and prove its worth? As you journey through this perilous world, your school will be put to the test. Sharpen your skills and harness the power of tools! At the start, you get to choose from three formidable weapons, each offering a distinct cultivation system. The Bagua Jade grants you the ability to revive yourself and your chosen ally, the Eye of Providence allows you to steal Beast Skills and gain unparalleled insights into the world, and the Mythical Gourd empowers you to capture a Boss and enlist it as your loyal sidekick: command it to fight by your side or to search for treasure on your behalf. And that's not all. Refine your own Artifacts and summon Artifact Spirits to fight by your side. These Spirits not only offer you companionship but also trigger exclusive adventures and provide invaluable assistance. Moreover, hone your skills in practicing Alchemy and Talismans, mastering the art of Geomancy and Feng Shui, and crafting a plethora of items to assist you in your explorations. Confuse your enemies, slay your foes, and emerge victorious every time! Our studio hopes that in this game, players will express the theme of "Always stick to your heart, dare to fight against difficulties; make choices carefully and grasp your own destiny."

Strategize Gather intel from your vehicles’ radars, pick your tools of the trade, and launch your attacks where the enemy presence is thinner. fullDescription: From Jeppe Carlsen, the lead gameplay designer of LIMBO and INSIDE — COCOON takes you on an adventure across worlds within worlds. Worlds within Worlds COCOON is a unique take on the puzzle adventure genre, where each world exists within an orb that you can carry on your back. Wrap your head around the core mechanic of leaping between worlds—and combine, manipulate, and rearrange them to solve intricate puzzles. title: Tank Squad
shortDescription: Tank Squad is a tactical-combat action game. Take part in big tank battles during World War II. Play single-player or coop (4 players). Repair your tanks, replenish supplies, manage the crew and get back to the action!
fullDescription: Tank Squad is a tactical-combat action game, where you take command of your tank squad and lead it during tank battles of World War II. Take part in historical battles, set in linear campaigns, alone or with up to three friends. Each player can control his own tank or be a part of your tank crew. Each battle is a separate mission in the campaign, with separate objectives that you need to achieve to win the battle. Plan ahead of your strategy and tactics, use infantry, artillery and air support when it is available. Minimize your losses, to be prepared properly for the final battle of the campaign. While playing the campaign missions, tanks can be damaged or lost during the battles. Try to pull as many tanks as possible back to the repair station, whether they are your own or your enemies. While the tanks are being repaired, work together to get them back into action faster. Repair damages taken during battle Replenish tank ammo (main gun and machine guns) Refuel vehicles Manage your squads. Replace the deceased or destroyed units in squads. Create new squads and assign any units from the pool automatically or manually. Play skirmish or procedural missions with up to 3 friends, use tank radio to communicate and give out orders to coordinate your squad. Play in either total control mode or multi-crew mode. Other players can join your tank and you play as a crew member rather than controlling the entire tank yourself. To be successful in battle, this mode requires good communication and coordination as a crew. Our vehicles are based on construction documents, expert opinions and insights from documentations. NEW CONTENT RACING YOUR WAY The action never slows down thanks to fresh seasonal content always around the corner. title: Herder
shortDescription: Defend your flock of sheep and goats as you traverse colorful procedural alpine meadows in the sky.
fullDescription: Herder is a third-person action-tower-defense-herding-sim. Defend your flock of sheep and goats from wild animals using a variety of items and weapons. Migrate through beautiful procedurally generated pastures, selling livestock, milk, and wool to passing trade caravans. Keep your flock happy and healthy to continue breeding, milking, and shearing. Cash out at any time and take home your earnings, or continue the nomadic lifestyle until you're so far into the wild that your flock succumbs to predators, starvation, or disease. Keep in mind this is a simple game by a tiny studio. You can expect a fun engaging experience that you can play for a couple of hours each session, or simply pick up and play casually. This game offers: Beautiful procedural alpine landscapes, the sounds of sheep on pasture, and wind in the meadows. Action packed gameplay, or the alternative relaxing casual mode. A unique mix of resource management strategy and third-person action-tower-defense. A friendly herding dog companion. Starting out: You begin the game with enough cash to start a small flock. Your sheep and goats will happily graze on grass and wildflowers until they've eaten everything in the area, at which point you'll need to move to the next pasture. At the start of each new pasture, you'll have time to set up your map with defensive items before you open the gate and let your livestock out. Each successive pasture moves further into the wild, increasing your encounters with wild animals, and decreasing the frequency at which trade caravans arrive. Caravans are your place to sell the wool, milk, or livestock you've grown over the seasons, as well as buy new items or animals to continue your herding adventure. You'll see your flock grow as the seasons change, watching for bears in the autumn, taking care to feed your flock hay in the winter, and birthing new lambs in the springtime. When you sell off your whole flock, or if your flock is wiped out by wild animals or disease, your final cash is saved as your high score. At this point you can start again in a fresh new meadow with a new flock and a new strategy. Alternatively, play the relaxing casual mode where your flock can graze peacefully, and you can sit back and just enjoy the serenity of taking your sheep out to pasture.

title: Dune: Spice Wars
shortDescription: A 4X real-time strategy game from the developers of the critically acclaimed Northgard. Set in Frank Herbert’s groundbreaking Dune universe, you must lead your faction and battle for control and dominance over the harsh desert planet of Arrakis.
fullDescription: This is your desert, your Dune. Lead your faction and battle for control and dominance over the harsh desert planet of Arrakis. Spice is the most valuable resource in the universe. The spice extends life, expands consciousness, and makes interstellar travel possible. Found only on Arrakis, it is sought by the most influential forces in the Imperium… Scan the landscape for wormsign or risk losing your troops and spice harvesters to colossal sandworms who will burst through the dunes to devour them whole. Crush your opponents in combat, best them through political intrigue, and undermine them with your network of illusive spies. Experience the unique Dune universe, one of the most influential sci-fi settings ever created. Lead your faction to victory with iconic characters, such as Duke Leto Atreides, the Baron Vladimir Harkonnen, the Padishah Emperor Shaddam IV, Esmar Tuek, and Liet Kynes. Stay alert as opposing factions seek to gain the upper hand and the planet itself threatens with vast deserts, huge storms, and the dreaded sandworms. 4X in real time. title: Ambulance Life: A Paramedic Simulator
shortDescription: Dedicate your life to saving others. As soon as you receive the emergency call, speed off to the site of the accident in your ambulance, sirens wailing. Apply first aid and transport the seriously injured to hospital. Every second counts!
fullDescription: Developed by the creators of the groundbreaking Police Simulator: Patrol Officers , Ambulance Life: A Paramedic Simulator is the first simulation game in which you experience every aspect of a paramedic’s life. Your objective? Quickly reach the accident site at the wheel of your ambulance. Your mission? Take care of the injured and apply first aid. Each accident is different. It's up to you to adapt and make the right choices while being fast and efficient. You have devoted yourself to saving the lives of the people on the West Coast of the United States. The city is comprised of 3 diverse Districts containing a variety of environments, including historic quarters, the business districts and industrial zones. Each neighborhood is different and can be the site of everyday accidents or major events. The citizens of San Pelícano have daily habits and activities, any of which can lead to new types of incidents. As soon as dispatch calls the alarm, you must race to your ambulance, turn on your siren, and race to the site of the accident as quickly as possible. It will take all your driving skills to navigate the crowded streets and find the best route. Time is of the essence! Once you reach the site of the accident, you must carefully analyze the situation to precisely determine the right treatment for each patient. Speak with them to learn about the circumstances of the accident and perform various necessary checks using the many instruments you have available and determine your initial diagnosis. Patients may react poorly to your methods if they have allergies, and some pre-existing conditions may complicate the treatment of otherwise simple issues. Most severe cases will then need to be moved into the ambulance and transported to the nearest hospital as quickly as possible. As you build your reputation, you will be assigned to new districts which have thrilling new situations and unlock new tools will be available in your ambulance. Catastrophic events may occur during your shifts and you must rise to the occasion. During these extraordinary situations, the number of victims increase exponentially. Methodically examine your patients and triage their care according to the severity of their injuries. title: Tornado: Research and Rescue
shortDescription: Chase violent tornadoes across 1990s Tornado Alley. Read the forecast, deploy scientific probes, warn towns and upgrade your equipment as every procedurally generated storm pushes you closer to disaster.
fullDescription: Tornado: Research and Rescue is a storm-chasing game set during the golden age of 1990s tornado research. Read the forecast, track violent storms across Tornado Alley, deploy scientific probes and warn communities before it is too late. Every chase is different. Forecasts, road networks, towns, tornadoes and destruction are procedurally generated, forcing you to make decisions with limited time and incomplete information. Choose your route, position your equipment and decide how close you are willing to get as the storm evolves around you. CHASE THE STORM Use Doppler radar and visual clues to locate developing tornadoes, then navigate rural roads to intercept them. Tornadoes can change direction, grow rapidly and become wrapped in heavy precipitation. What begins as a distant funnel can become a violent, debris-filled wedge cutting off your escape route. Getting close produces better research opportunities - but one wrong turn can place you directly in the path! DEPLOY SCIENTIFIC PROBES Place portable probes ahead of the tornado and attempt to capture measurements from inside the circulation. Collect data including: Wind speed Pressure Temperature Dew point Stronger tornadoes can produce more valuable readings, but reaching their path and escaping safely becomes increasingly difficult. A perfectly positioned probe could fund your next set of upgrades. WARN TOWNS Research is only part of the job. When a tornado threatens a community, issue warnings and give residents time to reach shelter. Your decisions have consequences. A successful chase is not measured only by the data you collect, but by how many people survive the storm. MANIPULATE THE TORNADO Experimental atmospheric chemicals allow you to influence a tornado's behaviour. Release different chemical types to alter properties such as intensity, width and movement. Each tornado responds differently, so every experiment requires observation, repeated sampling and a willingness to take risks. You may weaken a dangerous storm - or accidentally create something far worse: tornadoes beyond an F5 rating are possible in this game! UPGRADE YOUR EQUIPMENT Sell research data and earn rewards from successful rescues to prepare for increasingly dangerous chases. Improve your: Storm-chasing vehicle Doppler radar Research probe Better equipment allows you to detect storms earlier, collect more valuable data and survive conditions that would have ended previous chases. BUILD YOUR STORM-CHASING CAREER Begin with limited equipment and work your way towards the most extreme tornadoes the atmosphere can produce. Each forecast presents a new combination of risk and opportunity. A quiet-looking day may struggle to produce a tornado, while an exceptional environment could create a violent outbreak capable of overwhelming entire communities. Spend your earnings carefully, improve your research capabilities and decide whether the next chase is worth the danger. CREATE YOUR OWN CHASES Alongside the career experience, Sandbox mode allows you to configure custom storm-chasing scenarios. Experiment with different environments, tornadoes and equipment without putting your career progression at risk, or create the most destructive storm you can survive. You can also recreate historic tornadoes and experience them yourself in-game: the Bridge Creek/Moore 1999 tornado and the Jarrell 1997 tornadoes are included. Forecast the storm. Deploy the probe. Warn the towns. Survive the chase.

title: Drop Duchy

fullDescription: Drop Duchy takes on the iconic geometric puzzle gameplay we all know and love with a fresh perspective: instead of simply clearing lines, you'll be thoughtfully building a realm using pieces of various shapes and types to overcome enemy challenges. Optimization is key to collecting precious resources, protecting your castle, and building your army. Defeat is not the end, though: use the experience gained in previous runs to unlock even more content! In each round of your run, Drop Duchy offers you a fresh and unique landscape to work with. Place tile pieces as you would in a typical block-dropping game but with a strategic twist : you need to align them to maximize their activation rules, producing maximum resources and units. Selecting the optimal structures to place next to blocks of lush forests, wild rivers or grassy plains is crucial for maximizing your materials use and nurturing a bustling realm. Forming lines grants bonuses, yet the ultimate goal is to pack up the most resources gradually. These resources will be crucial to build up your army bit by bit, ensuring your kingdom is well-protected against the enemy threats. Select your path, gather your troops to outnumber your enemies, and reclaim the regions under their control. But be careful: letting your castle take too much damage can lead to defeat. Successful battles lead your forces down branching, decision-filled paths in a march to storm the enemy fortress. If your army falls before capturing the bastion, you can quickly jump back in and try a new strategy, thanks to a cleverly designed gameplay loop. Adapt, conquer, and keep the action moving! fullDescription: Step into the world of Cozy Room Decorator where you’re the chief curator of cozy and it’s up to you to define what cozy means.
