Equipped with your very own room, this whimsical isometric room design game invites you to unleash your inner interior decorator. What Is It? Cozy Room Decorator is a casual room decorating game that offers players an opportunity to unleash their creativity. Gameplay is as simple as drag and drop what you want into the space. Players are given a room template that has a fixed isometric view, so two walls and a floor are the “shell” of the room. At game start up, players are given a catalog full of items to use in their rooms. There will be a variety of items to choose from so the player can decide what style of room they want. Some examples of items are bedroom furniture, kitchen appliances, and bathroom items. We’ve also done away with item collision restrictions, so players can merge items together to create “new items”. There is no overarching plot to the game, nor are there any side quests or prerequisites that may hinder one from decorating within gameplay. There is no in-game currency system that forces a player to “buy” furniture for their rooms. The objective of Cozy Room Decorator is simply to decorate. This game is especially for those that want to put together an aesthetic room, but perhaps don’t want to deal with the hassle and headache of learning a 3D modeling program. Cozy Features: Decorate your room to show your unique style. Choose from thousands of items! Decorate Inside and Outside. Change the walls, floors or background of your room. Select from different lighting options, time of day or weather patterns. Pick different art options for different photo frames that you decorate with. Change the ambient noise sound effects to set the mood of your environment. Change the location of your room for a change of scenery! Collision is disabled to allow merging items so players can be very creative! A sandbox game. There is no story. Just decorating at your own pace. title: Astrosphere
shortDescription: Build your space station, design your own ships, and explore relaxed sci-fi sectors in Astrosphere. Gather resources, research new technologies, and shape your journey through the cosmos at your own pace.
fullDescription: Your journey through the cosmos begins at your own pace. Astrosphere is a relaxed sci-fi strategy game about exploration, station building, and slowly expanding your presence in space. You are not commanding a frantic war fleet. Instead, you develop your own space station step by step, design custom ships, and set out on expeditions into unknown star systems. Explore distant sectors, gather valuable resources, discover anomalies, and bring your findings safely back to your station. Every journey expands your options: new technologies, improved systems, stronger ships, and more control over your path through the galaxy. Main Features: Build and expand your space station Add new modules, improve your systems, and turn your station into your personal home among the stars. Your station is not just a menu screen — it is the center of your progress between expeditions. Design your own spaceships Create and improve ships that match your playstyle. Customize systems, equipment, and functions so your ships better support your goals: exploring, gathering, surviving, and reaching deeper into space. Explore procedural star systems Travel to unknown sectors, scan objects, find resources, and uncover what lies hidden in deep space. Astrosphere focuses on the feeling that there is always one more place to discover. Gather resources and research new technologies Use your expeditions to collect metals, crystals, and other valuable materials. Invest them into research, upgrades, and new possibilities for your station and ships. Play at your own pace Astrosphere is designed around a calmer flow. You can plan, build, upgrade, and explore without constant pressure. Dangers exist, but the heart of the game lies in discovery, optimization, and steady progress. An atmospheric sci-fi experience Enjoy the quiet vastness of space, futuristic stations, distant systems, and a presentation that draws you into a calm, mysterious sci-fi world. A short message from the developer Hello, I'm Mario, the solo developer behind Astrosphere. My path into game development is a little unusual. Before I began programming my own universes, I worked in international fine dining, in five-star hotels, and most recently as a head pastry chef. Patisserie is about absolute precision, the perfect interplay of hundreds of tiny components, and complex handcrafted structures that ultimately come together as a flawless whole. I now bring that same uncompromising attention to detail to game development, directly from my desk here in Tyrol. My greatest inspiration for Astrosphere is the classic, utopian science-fiction television of the 1980s and 1990s . I have always been fascinated by how logically and thoroughly technology was conceived in some TV universes—from the warp core and life support to the very last power conduit, everything works together. My goal is to establish exactly this technical depth and interconnectedness of systems in my game. I know that many of these minute details are extremely demanding to develop and may not deliver the typical, fast-paced "arcade fun." But this authenticity matters enormously to me. I am building Astrosphere for players who, like me, appreciate knowing that a genuinely well-considered, logical technical architecture is working behind the user interface. As a solo developer, I do not have the budget of a huge studio, but I do have the complete freedom to create exactly this uncompromising niche experience. If you love deep systems and would like to accompany an indie dream on its journey through Early Access: Welcome aboard. Let's build something great together!

title: Cubetory
shortDescription: Build a huge factory on a tiny island! Resources are scarce and unique - tweak and optimize everything for peak efficiency. Start with simple painted cubes, unlock tons of upgrades, and scale up to complex production chains. No enemies, just satisfying spaghetti.
fullDescription: Cubetory is a factory-building game with a pure automation focus. Place mining drills, conveyor belts, launchers, stampers, power stations, and tons of other machines as you build your factory. Space is limited , and resource patches are unique . Each new paint/ore patch you encounter will have to be used efficiently to meet the production requirements to unlock the next upgrades. As you progress, you'll grow your island, unlock new technologies, and uncover new resources. With no enemies or time limits , you'll have all the time you need to figure it out. Challenging Progression System Progression is tied to your rate of production. Combined with limited resources and not much space, it means that you'll have to figure out dense, efficient factory layouts to produce enough cubes to hit your production targets. Each production target you achieve will be part of future targets as well, meaning that your factory will have to become more and more efficient as you progress. Paint-Based Manufacturing with the PIT Everything you produce in Cubetory is a cube, and all cubes end up in the PIT . Early game, that means mining cubes and painting them a specific pattern. Complexity quickly ramps up from there with assembly chains, byproducts, non-deterministic processes, and more.

fullDescription: EARLY ACCESS 0.9 Assetto Corsa EVO 0.9 focuses on competition. Special Events introduce worldwide online leaderboards across hotlap and hotstint formats, mandatory pitstop requirements restore tactical depth to online racing, and a new tyre model for racing slicks raises handling fidelity across GT racing cars from Mazda MX5 Cup to Ferrari F40. Alongside these, 0.9 delivers a broad force feedback reliability pass, continued renderer optimisation, and three new cars. This release provides many reasons to come back in game after summer time: a global leaderboard to climb, a race strategy to plan, and a car that behaves more faithfully underneath you. SPECIAL EVENTS — WORLDWIDE ONLINE LEADERBOARDS – Special Events are pre-determined scenarios — fixed car, track, conditions and time of day — that every player attempts under identical terms, ranked on a worldwide leaderboard. Two event types are available: Hotlap, for a single definitive lap, and Hotstint, which tracks total gaps to nearby drivers at every sector line across a sustained run. Both support an optional Limited Attempts setting, reintroducing the pressure of a session that counts. MANDATORY PITSTOPS — STRATEGY ENTERS THE RACE – Mandatory pitstop requirements are now available in timed online races above twenty minutes, with a configurable pit window set by the server administrator. Drivers plan their strategy through the MFD: stop lap, tyre choice, pressures, and fuel load. NEW RACING SLICK TYRE MODEL – An updated tyre model for racing slicks is deployed across GT racing cars from Mazda MX5 Cup to Ferrari F40, raising the consistency and fidelity of the platform's core handling across the competition roster. FORCE FEEDBACK AND INPUT – Force feedback devices now recover automatically after a disconnection or alt-tab across DirectInput, Fanatec, Logitech and Thrustmaster hardware. FFB output shaping is now available via a linearisation LUT. Haptic audio has been reworked, with FullForce DSP operating on the filtered signal and Logitech TrueForce gaining a 350 Hz low-pass filter and DSP reinitialisation on wheel handle change. About Assetto Corsa EVO Assetto Corsa EVO raises the bar of realism that has made the franchise one of the most popular driving simulations of the last decade even higher. As with its predecessor, Assetto Corsa EVO will include cars from different classes spanning across years of motoring history. From road cars, classics, hypercars, and race cars. The most iconic representation of the automotive and motorsport world. Each vehicle is reproduced through Kunos in-house physics and graphic engine simulating mechanical, electronic, and aerodynamic performance, combined with the fidelity of the circuits created using Laserscan technology. Throughout Early Access, you will experience a continuously expanding range of vehicles, tracks, and game modes, evolving towards our full 1.0 launch. title: Bad Credit? No Problem!

fullDescription: Welcome to "Bad Credit? No Problem!" Step into the high-stakes world of title loans with "Bad Credit? No Problem!", a unique narrative-driven simulation game that puts you in the shoes of an employee at Title 4 Cash, LLC. In this pixel art adventure, you'll navigate the ethical and moral dilemmas of the title loan industry while trying to make ends meet. Are you ready to experience the dark humor and tough choices of this financial frontier? Gameplay Overview In "Bad Credit? No Problem!", you start as a part-time employee at Title 4 Cash, LLC, a title loan agency set in the year 2016. Your goal is to pass a 14-day probation period to secure a full-time position. The game offers two modes: - Story Mode : Survive the 14-day probation period, making decisions that affect your career and the lives of your clients. - Full-Time (Survival) Mode : After passing probation, continue working for as long as possible in an endless mode where each decision could be your last. Key Features Deep Narrative : Experience a rich story with branching dialogues and multiple outcomes based on your decisions. Immersive Pixel Art : Enjoy charming pixel art graphics that bring the office and characters to life. Realistic Sounds : Feel the ambiance of a busy office with immersive sound effects. Ethical Dilemmas : Balance the pressure of approving loans and the moral implications of your decisions. Unique Characters : Interact with a diverse cast of clients, each with their own backstory and unique needs. Achievements & Leaderboards : Track your progress and compete with others. Unlimited Gameplay : Endless mode offers infinite replayability. Mini-Games & Collectables : Engage in mini-games and collect unique items throughout your journey. Character Creation : Customize your character to make the experience your own. Meet the Cast From quirky clients to your overbearing boss, the characters in "Bad Credit? No Problem!" are designed to bring humor and depth to your daily tasks. Whether you're dealing with a comedian commenting on the state of mobile games or a struggling mother desperate for a loan, each interaction is packed with personality and wit. Ethical and Moral Challenges Every decision you make affects your career and the lives of your clients. Will you approve a loan for someone in desperate need, even if it might hurt the company's bottom line? Or will you prioritize profit over people? Your choices will lead to different outcomes, making each playthrough unique. Immersive Office Environment With detailed pixel art and realistic sound design, "Bad Credit? No Problem!" immerses you in the world of title loans. The office comes alive with the hustle and bustle of daily operations, creating an engaging backdrop for your ethical dilemmas. Get Ready to Make Tough Choices "Bad Credit? No Problem!" is more than just a job simulator—it's a window into the often murky world of title loans. With dark humor and a critical look at the industry, this game challenges you to think about the real-life implications of your decisions. Can you balance integrity and profit? Find out in "Bad Credit? No Problem!". Embark on this unique journey and see if you have what it takes to thrive at Title 4 Cash, LLC. Remember, in this world, bad credit is no problem—but your decisions will have consequences. Is your moral compass ready for the challenge? Download "Bad Credit? No Problem!" now and find out!

title: Backrooms Lost Runners
shortDescription: Backrooms Lost Runners is a co-op survival horror with team play, voice-reactive AI, and immersive puzzles. This isn’t a “walking simulator”: explore liminal spaces, outsmart entities, and remember—even a whisper can give you away.
fullDescription: Backrooms Lost Runners is a cooperative survival-horror experience where teamwork is your only real weapon  and even your voice can put you in danger. Trapped inside the endless corridors of the Backrooms, you and your friends must explore abandoned camps, solve environmental puzzles, manage scarce resources, and survive encounters with entities that react to sound, light, and movement. Every dark hallway hides a threat. Every whisper can give you away. Every wrong decision can separate the group forever. Key Features Immersive Horror Atmosphere Venture through dimly lit corridors, abandoned shelters, and unstable spaces filled with oppressive silence, dynamic lighting, and realistic sound design. In the Backrooms, every footstep matters  and every moment of silence feels wrong. Cooperative Survival Survival depends on communication, trust, and coordination. Share resources, split responsibilities, solve puzzles together, and make difficult choices as a team. Staying together is safer  but sometimes the best loot is found far from the group. True Cooperative Gameplay Collaboration is crucial for survival. Manage your resources, coordinate tactics via voice chat, and make collective choices. Voice-Reactive Threats Face entities with different behaviors and weaknesses. Some react to sound. Some hunt through darkness. Some appear when your mind starts to break. Learn how they behave, stay quiet when needed, and use your environment to survive. Sanity System  Darkness, fear, isolation, and supernatural events affect your mental state. Stay near light, heat sources, and safe areas to slow sanity loss. If your mind collapses, the Backrooms will begin to change around you. Tesseract Afterlife Death is not the end. When you die, you are pulled into a surreal Tesseract realm where you must find a way back to life. But returning may cost you time, resources, and the safety of your team. Storyline & Quest System Discover journals, audio recordings, floppy disks, and unsettling traces of survivors. Piece together the timeline of the catastrophe, uncover the fates of those who were here before you, and find out what is really happening inside the Backrooms. Resource Management & Character Progression Scavenge for food, clothing, and tools to maintain health, stamina, and sanity. Will you risk venturing alone for high-value loot, or stick close to your squad? Find valuable items and resources by exploring camps, lockers, and shelters. Reality-Bending Anomalies Zero-gravity zones, sudden teleportation gates, shifting walls, broken physics, and impossible spaces will force you to question what is real. In the Backrooms, the environment itself can become the enemy. YOUR ADVENTURE IS JUST BEGINNING.

shortDescription: Pluralys is an RPG focused on exploration, comedy and intrigue. You play Elie, a young person living a peaceful life, until unexpected visitors arrive and change everything. What seems like a quiet, cozy story hides a deeper mystery and many other adventures to discover.
fullDescription: You play Elie who's 16 years old. A teenager with no story, curious, a bit of a dreamer, a fan of video games. He/She (your choice!) loves spending his afternoons role-playing with his two best friends, Gab and Medie . Elie lives in Sector G with his mother and little sister, who can be a bit of a handful (but at this age, that's only to be expected). The world around Elie seems ordinary. People go to work, deal with their daily worries... In short, everything is normal (well, the Zeings aren't but that's another matter). One day, your life changes as  someone contacts you  on Messenger Plus!. A strange person suddenly tells you the one thing every potential hero has always heard before: “ you're the only one who can change the course of things ” . But why you ? And above all... are you ready to trust them? This game is brought to you by a team of dedicated developers from Canada. 2 years of hard work, no AI whatsoever, all original content created by a group of RPG loving game developers :-). We hope you'll enjoy! Pluralys is a world that is both familiar and profoundly strange. There, you will encounter beings from elsewhere , living among humans. What do we still have to find out about them? Do they intend to settle on your planet forever? Can some of them be your friend? All of them? That may be up to you! The mysterious person who contacted you has entrusted you with a strange device: the Pager . This unique tool is capable of freezing time and revealing details no one else can see. With it, you can analyze people, move objects far too heavy for a teenager, hack into security systems, and much more… Of course, not every situation requires a pager (tell that to people in the 90s). Pluralys is a living world, full of challenges big and small, as well as several mini-games scattered throughout your journey: choose wisely, solve puzzles, confront enigmas… this game is full of interactions that will let you explore the world in new and surprising ways. Your journey will sometimes be peaceful, sometimes filled with obstacles, but it will always take you through varied, warm, and unexpected environments : quiet residential areas, lively bazaars, vast deserts, mysterious laboratories… Each location has its own story and each one brings you a little closer to the truth. Narrative is at the heart of Pluralys Throughout your adventure, you will encounter short cinematic scenes sometimes touching, sometimes funny, sometimes mysterious that deepen the relationship between characters and reveal more about the world’s hidden stakes. There's no combat in this game, only choices that matter.

title: Find This Pixel Anomaly
shortDescription: Monitor surveillance camera footage to spot anomalies in this cozy-horror game. Toggle night vision to uncover anomalies that would otherwise remain hidden and file a report to fix them. But be quick - too many anomalies will end the game.
fullDescription: In Find This Pixel Anomaly  your task involves monitoring real-time surveillance camera feeds. Identify any irregularities within the monitored areas. These anomalies can vary from missing furniture to cute visitors. Found an anomaly? File a report and hope it will get fixed in time. Otherwise you will get in trouble, because too many anomalies will end the game. Activate Night Vision to reveal only the most elusive anomalies lurking in the shadows. But don’t get too comfortable — this mode limits what you can see, making every mistake potentially fatal. Focus on the hidden details and spot the threats before they end your game. EXTRA OBJECT Wait, was this chair here before? Who put it there? Well, it doesn't matter because you should hurry up and file a report. These added items can blend in surprisingly well, so stay sharp. INTRUDER They may look cute, but these creatures are up to no good. They are masters of disguise so keep an eye on them. IMAGE A picture is worth a thousand words. But 1000 words won't save you either. Pay close attention to paintings, signs, and posters for any unsettling changes that could signal an anomaly. MISSING OBJECT Is something missing or are you just paranoid? Whenever an object is swallowed by the ground, file a report. THERE ARE MORE TYPES OF ANOMALIES But nothing beats a little secret. Can you find all of them? With nearly 100 anomalies to find across four maps, each location brings its own set of unique challenges and mysteries: Museum Mall Hospital Prison Each map includes up to 20 unique anomalies and 3 recurring ones. Every playthrough is unique because the anomalies are randomly placed. Are you ready to spot every anomaly? With its blend of cozy visuals and subtle suspense, Find This Pixel Anomaly is a game that will test your attention to detail in the most unexpected ways. Each playthrough is a fresh challenge. Can you make it through the night without missing a thing?

title: The Fool's Apprentice
shortDescription: A wizard academy management sim where you—an obviously benevolent professor—must manage & cast spells on your many apprentices so that they might study the right spells… and perhaps even survive the researching process. Some may die, but oh well, can’t save them all!
fullDescription: The Fool's Apprentice  is a magic school simulator that puts you in the position of Arcanist Tharn, a mage from a prestigious family by the same name. As this accomplished wizard, you will shepherd your many woefully unskilled apprentices towards a modicum of knowledge... by ensuring they cannot possibly step outside the bounds of proper curriculum. Levitate them, toss them around, control their minds or wipe them, and even throw them into portals to other worlds!  The good apprentices will survive, surely. As for the bad, what can a professor do? Plot the future of magic at the helm of your Conservatory, through the following tools: Enroll new apprentices under your tutelage, managing their skills , directing their studies with spells , and steering them away from an accidental demise ! Build Research , and use it to upgrade magical workstations or unlock new sciences! Respond to Dilemmas , as the choices you make for your Arcane Conservatory shape the future of mankind in this new age of magic & science! Kidnap citizens for experimentation . Earn the love of the public for the wonderous scientific advancements brought to the sun-kissed canal city of Golryon! But be careful, withholding every bit of magic from the public might lead them to riot ! A new age dawns! Arcanoscience , and its related fields of mago-mechanical study, has been discovered, and as engineering marvels both profound in their spellcraft and ingenious in their design are constructed... it has come time for the next generation of apprentices. One wizened Arcanist shall teach them... You! Strategize  and construct the ideal Conservatory, choosing fields of magical study to focus upon, arcane workstations of varying risk, effect, and difficulty, and decorations both cosmetic and of eldritch power! Manage   & Cast Spells On  each and every apprentice, directing them away from such foolish things as "ambition", and "artistic passion," towards the most socially acceptable magicks... or defy the Arcane Conservatory itself and spread magic among the people! Decorate and customize your own Arcane Conservatory in this wizard academy Simulator! Engage in the Narrative-driven ebb and flow of the demands of the magocratic city of Golryon. One day the Conservatory might request increased production of elemental cannons; and on the next the Duke might demand that you teach magic to a distant cousin! Try not to be imprisoned for criminal arcane malpractice. The Fool's Apprentice returns to The Planar Danse once again, the connected universe of Apollyon, Skulltide, and Spirit's Almanac, the previous games and novel set within the same world. It is endlessly replayable, but all unlocks can be unlocked in ~8 hours of play. Build the future of magic, today!

title: ENDLESS Legend™ 2
shortDescription: Lead your people to victory on an ever-evolving world in this strategy game featuring asymmetric factions led by powerful heroes. Build your empire, wield political influence, and raise grand armies to wage war in a race to uncover dark secrets buried within the planet.
fullDescription: ENDLESS Legend™ 2 is a fantasy strategy game where you lead wildly varied factions as they build grand empires and wage planet-spanning wars on an ever-evolving ocean world at the brink of extinction. Cataclysmic events have wrought havoc on the natural order, and the very world will change as time goes on revealing new opportunities for exploration and conquest to the bold and daring. Establish expansive cities to spread your influence and strengthen your economy, raise armies and command troops in turn-based tactical battles to overcome your enemies by force, and push forth into the unknown to uncover the dark secrets that lie at the planet’s core. Whether you command righteous warriors descended from the stars, cursed knights seeking reprieve from their misfortune, or hive-minded beasts that know only how to fight, feed, and propagate, ENDLESS Legend™ 2 features vastly different factions each driven by their own philosophies, histories, capabilities, and narratives. Each of the factions have unique traits that set them apart from one another whether on the battlefield, in matters of commerce, with regards to empire-building, or in diplomatic affairs – it is up to you to adapt to their strengths and weaknesses and build strategies and distinct playstyles. The choice of faction will influence every aspect of the game. Will you prefer to benefit from a constant state of fighting, untethered by the need to justify your wars, spawning additional warriors with each victorious battle to grow endlessly in strength? Will you choose to benefit from cohabitation and cooperation, spreading tendrils of influence throughout the world to build a network of allies, leveraging relationships with the minor factions of the planet to further enrich your empire? Or will you lead a people who feed upon their own kind for sustenance, taking advantage of a unique economy free from the needs of mere mortals? Learn what makes each faction distinct and use it to your advantage whether you’re leading them, or looking to destroy them. Military doctrine varies greatly between the factions, providing unique opportunities for a capable commander to gain an advantage over their foe, even when out of combat. Build massive fortifications to defend cities and establish connections to powerful weapon and support systems waiting in orbit as the martial Kin of Sheredyn. Invest in the spread of coral so the spiritualist Aspects are able to support themselves outside of friendly territory. Dot the land with nests and burrows to quickly traverse vast distances and ambush enemies from beneath as the Necrophage hive. Either auto-resolve combat or take direct control of individual units within your armies when battle begins, using the surrounding terrain to your advantage as you seek out chokepoints, cover, and the high ground. Apart from having faction-specific units, traits, weapons, and attributes, each faction also features special battlefield abilities that can turn the tide of battle if properly utilized. Where one faction might work best with a patient commander, able to meticulously maneuver troops to secure powerful adjacency bonuses, another might rely on force of numbers and overwhelming strength. Recruit heroes and watch them grow over time as they gain new traits to bolster their abilities, build relationships that provide them with various boons, and acquire equipment useful both in and out of battle. Powerful commanders, properly trained and armed, can turn the tide of entire wars when wisely utilized. Empires will rise and fall based on their ability to adapt to a changing world. Starting from a single humble city, expand according to your faction's unique strengths and limitations while adapting to the periodic monsoons and tidefalls. Build districts around your cities’ central structures, exploit strategic and luxury resources littered around the world, and develop your technological capabilities and industrial might. Cataclysmic tidefalls will expose new opportunities and threats as the oceans recede to unveil new land ripe for expansion. While your existing territory will remain unscathed, the newly revealed terrain from the retreating oceans will open up new avenues of approach for you and your enemies, alongside new resources to exploit and new anomalies to explore. While this can fundamentally change the strategic value of various locations as time goes on, a wise leader will plan for the inevitable – will you prepare to expand into new lands as soon as a tidefall occurs, or focus on shoring up your defenses where you anticipate new landbridges to appear? Plan the development of your cities to focus on population growth, industrialization, and commerce, or prioritize their contribution to the sciences, your empire’s influence, and your military might – the choice is yours based on the needs of your burgeoning empire. Establish districts that provide fortifications or further the production of various resources, take advantage of adjacency and terrain bonuses, and pursue technological advancements that allow you to upgrade established districts or unlock entirely new options. Every puzzle contains historical information about its date, artist and what it represents. The satisfying sound effects, original music and ambient soundscapes are aimed at deepening your focus and flow state to the maximum. Pazleum expands puzzle-solving with art appreciation and a semi-meditative escape from the everyday.              Pazleum is a genuinely new genre and we want to shape it alongside the players who get it first. The core loop is solid and the pipeline for creating puzzle content is established, but there's a lot left to build: more sculptures, more difficulty options, rewards, new music, more maps, and systems like a gallery room where you can display your completed pieces. Early Access lets us prioritize what matters most based on real feedback, not assumptions. Come help us carve marble and make the full release a work of art!              Our Early Access game is comprised of  twelve sculptures cut as 3D jigsaw puzzles . Several different eras and civilizations are included - Greek, Roman, Medieval, Egyptian, meso-American, African, Asian and more! Content will be uploaded monthly, with free and paid options. The four sculptures below will be a part of the full release and are included in our demo.               The familiar puzzle-solving experience you love is made intuitive through a smart orientation system that smoothly aligns each piece to the building surface . If you think about it, that is   exactly how you would move the pieces in real life if these were physical puzzles .  Simply grab from the board, drag it onto the sculpture, and watch your masterpiece come to life!               All the extraordinary artworks featured in Pazleum can be enjoyed in extreme resolution, even in entry level computers . These masterpieces would be diminished by typical game-ready generation processes, so we've harnessed cutting-edge 3D content creating pipeline and game engine technology to deliver cinematic-quality puzzles. Build your sculpture while admiring every intricate detail in stunning clarity.               In Early Access, you can assemble in two maps: a dream-like stylized classic museum room with natural elements and a high resolution scan of a Swedish King's Hall. The  levels are either hand-crafted, designed by an artist from scratch or real-life scans embellished to suit our style.  We are committed to creating environments that are perfectly aligned with our message and we want to honor the sculpture puzzles to the best of our ability.                 Every puzzle contains historical information about its date, artist and what it represents. title: Idle Knight
shortDescription: Idle Knight runs in the background, turning your clicks, keystrokes, and controller inputs into XP. Work or play your favorite game: your knight levels up in the background! Build your character, manage stats, open hourly chests, and fight others in ranked duels.
fullDescription: Idle Knight is an idle RPG where your character progresses as you use your PC. Every interaction matters, mouse clicks, keyboard inputs, controller actions. As long as you're using your computer, your knight is gaining XP. The game runs in the background and is designed to fit naturally into your daily routine. CORE IDEA The concept is simple: You don’t actively grind the game. You progress by simply using your computer. At first, progression feels fast and rewarding. Over time, it slows down significantly. At that point, the game shifts from passive growth to decision-making and optimization. PROGRESSION SYSTEM Each input generates XP. Leveling up gives you stat points that define your character: - HP : your health and survivability - DMG : your damage output - AGI : determines evasion and action speed Your build directly affects how efficiently you progress and how well you perform in combat. BUILDS AND STRATEGY There is no single correct build. You can focus on raw damage, survivability, or agility-based scaling. However, as difficulty increases, inefficient builds will slow your progress. This is where experimentation and optimization become important. RESETS AND FLEXIBILITY You are not locked into your decisions. Special items, such as the Phoenix Feather, allow you to reset your stats while keeping your level. This lets you test different builds and adjust your strategy over time. DUNGEONS Dungeons are structured challenges where you choose which one to enter based on its recommended level. Each dungeon has a difficulty rating, and selecting the right one is important for your progression. Once inside, you must climb through multiple floors, defeating enemies along the way until you reach the final boss. Beating the boss completes the dungeon and grants rewards. Rewards scale depending on the dungeon difficulty and your performance. Dungeons are designed to test your build in real conditions. A weak build will struggle to progress through the floors. A well-optimized build will clear dungeons efficiently and unlock better rewards. RANKED MODE The game features a ranked system with multiple tiers: Farmer → Stable Boy → Infantryman → Knight → Royal Knight → Warlord You have a limited number of ranked attempts per day. Winning increases your rank. Losing decreases it. Rank progression depends heavily on your build quality, not just playtime. HOW YOU PLAY Idle Knight supports two playstyles: - Passive play: progress in the background while using your PC - Active play: optimize builds and push ranked progression Most players naturally combine both approaches. COSMETICS Cosmetic items are available through gameplay or purchase. They are purely visual and have no impact on gameplay or progression. MONETIZATION Idle Knight is free-to-play. There is no pay-to-win system. All gameplay-relevant systems can be unlocked through normal progression. ANTI-CHEAT SYSTEM Because progression is based on real input detection, the game includes an anti-cheat system. It detects: - macros - automated inputs - unnatural input patterns The goal is to ensure fair competition in ranked mode. ENGINE Idle Knight runs on a custom engine developed specifically for this game by me (VECR). It is designed for: - real-time input tracking - stable background performance - long-term incremental progression systems Everything is built specifically for this type of gameplay. NOTE Idle Knight is a long-term progression game. Progress naturally slows down over time. The game is designed around optimization, planning, and gradual improvement rather than fast completion.

title: Pixel Darts: From Pub to Glory
shortDescription: A casual pixel-art darts game with 90s arcade flair. Play 501, Cricket, Shanghai & Bermuda, chase a worldwide high score in Arcade mode, or take over your father's struggling pub in Career mode and fight past 72 rivals. You can also create your own darts league and define venues, rules and rivals!
fullDescription: Pub Darts with the Soul of a 90s Arcade Game. This is what happens when a cozy English pub and a 90s arcade game have a kid together. Rival portraits. Dramatic VS screens. Big-score flashes. Crowd pressure. Nicknames that should be illegal. And that one little voice in your head saying: "Just one more leg." Wrapped around it all: a warm local, a throw you'll have down in thirty seconds, and a career built on finishing something your father never could. Climb the Worldwide Leaderboard. Play Arcade mode, have every run scored like in old-school arcade games, and climb the worldwide Steam leaderboard. A quiet pub leg becomes a global fight for the top spot! And you can see exactly whose score you have to beat. Even a lost match still scores points: a clean defeat can outrank a hard-fought win. In the free demo you can jump straight into the global Arcade leaderboard. Everything else awaits in the full game. Get ON FIRE. Hit the 180! Land a few big visits in a row and you go ON FIRE: the board lights up, the crowd goes wild, and your game gets noticeably better, because you're ON FIRE! And when three darts fly into the treble 20 and a 180 lights up on the scoreboard, the whole room wakes up. There are dedicated animations for 140+, 160+, and the 170 checkout too. Each one feels like its own little victory. Easy to Learn, but Challenging to Master! Aim. Pull back. Throw. Release. That's it. The throw is deliberately kept simple, but every throw still needs timing, drift, pressure, release quality - and gives off that quiet sting when you miss the double by just three pixels. A relaxed leg turns into a nail-biter. One bad throw throws away a whole match. One perfect dart gets the whole crowd going. You'll know the feeling. You Inherit a Pub! Finish What Your Father Started. Your father left you "The Lazy Trout". It's a warm, slightly crooked English pub with loyal regulars, unpaid bills, and an upstairs office full of things that raise more questions than they answer. Old scorecards. Practice recordings. A few scattered darts trophies from your late father. As you climb from local hopeful to bigger stages, the pub changes around you. Familiar faces react differently and old rivalries come back, because the Garrison family - who own a pub chain - will do everything to stop your rise to fame and glory in darts heaven. The three members of the Garrison family are the boss fights in Career mode, each with their own individual fight! All in the style of classic 90s arcade games! It's a darts story about grief, inheritance, and the slow realization that what you were trying to prove was always there inside you. 501, Cricket, Shanghai, and Bermuda Play whatever you're in the mood for. Classic X01 in 301, 501, and 701 (with Double In, Double Out, and best-of formats). Cricket for a more tactical game. Shanghai to practice the double and treble beds. Bermuda when you want something with more bite than another straight 501 leg. Play a quick round before bed, or settle in on the couch for long sessions - to climb the global leaderboard, or to live through the story around the English pub "The Lazy Trout" in Career mode. Build Your Own League Want to start your own darts season completely from scratch? The standalone League mode lets you set up your own season. Here you can define your own players, venues, rules, tables, and matchdays. Build a custom circuit, follow the table week by week, and watch real rivalries form over a whole season. 72 Opponents with Individual Traits! Every rival has their own portrait; some have their own throwing traits, their own rhythm, trash talk, and characteristics. Some stay ice-cold under pressure. Some play to the crowd. Some never stop talking. Some seem harmless until they hit the treble 20 like clockwork. You'll get to know them - and still be surprised later on. Features Intricate throwing mechanics: aim, pull back, throw, release Arcade mode with a worldwide Steam leaderboard: local and global rankings, climb up and defend your spot ON FIRE streaks and big-score moments for 140+, 160+, 170 checkouts, and 180s Classic X01: 301, 501, 701 (Double In, Double Out, best-of formats) Cricket, Shanghai, and Bermuda modes Story-driven Career mode with rankings, prize money, darts, trophies, practice, boss fights, and pub events A father-and-child story about legacy, self-doubt, and finishing the unfinished Standalone League mode: custom seasons, venues, rules, tables, matchdays, complete season history 72 opponents with portraits, traits, banter, and individual throwing styles Arcade and Practice for shorter sessions Mouse/keyboard and gamepad support

MyBiz is a desktop companion that turns your real focus sessions into in-game progress — every keystroke, every click, every Pomodoro funds a tiny pixel-art business that grows alongside your day. How it works Start a 25-minute Pomodoro and the office comes alive. Your typing fills a Keys bar, your clicks fill a Clicks bar, your music fills a Music bar — hit thresholds, earn cash and XP, level up, hire staff, expand to new floors. Take a break and the timer mode swaps to short or long break automatically. Skip out early? You still get prorated rewards. Build a working office — buy desks, chairs, plants, lamps, recreation. Each piece of decor boosts staff output. Renovate floors (1F → 2F → 3F+), swap walls, doors, stairs, flooring. Happier teams output more — and play better at the foosball table on breaks Customize your character — hair, hat, top, bottom, shoes — earned or bought, swap anytime. Ambience mixer — rain, forest, ocean, fireplace, wind, whatever puts you in the zone. Layer multiple sounds with individual volumes; resumes automatically next time you launch. Quick tools — sticky notes, to-do list, clipboard history, whiteboard scratchpad — all one click away. Compact mode + monitor dock Switch to the always-on-top mini window when you need the screen. Or attach the full window to the left or right edge of your monitor as a permanent productivity sidebar — your office, your timer, your stats, always glanceable. Themes you unlock by working Earn cash through Pomodoros and unlock 10 themes — solid palettes (Midnight Office, Forest Den, Cherry Blossom), gradient skies (Sunset Lobby, Ocean Tide, Aurora Borealis), and texture finishes (Paper Notebook, Wood Workshop, Marble Lounge). The whole UI re-skins instantly — buttons, backdrops, the office sky behind your sprites, even the mini window. Track your milestones 25 achievements, from "First Day at Work" to "Pomodoro Empire" — natural progression rewards for first profit, first decor, focus streaks, click champions, and the long climb to level 12. Native Steam achievements with unlocked icons, all syncing to your profile. Made for the workday Launch on startup, always-on-top, mute when unfocused — settings to fit your real workflow Backup & restore your save as a .mybiz file — never lose progress Hourly grandfather clock chimes (optional) Light footprint, low CPU — runs alongside your real work tools, not in front of them Stop pretending you're not going to Pomodoro again tomorrow. title: Keypress Express
shortDescription: A cozy desktop train that runs on your keystrokes. The more you type, the farther your hand-drawn locomotive rolls along the bottom of your screen — sell the haul, buy bigger engines and longer trains, and grow a railroad empire while you work. fullDescription: All aboard your keyboard. Keypress Express is a cozy desktop companion where your everyday typing powers a hand-drawn train across the countryside. Whether you are working, writing, coding, or chatting, every keystroke helps your locomotive travel a little faster. Your train lives in a slim overlay at the bottom of your screen, quietly rolling alongside your day without stealing focus. There is no separate game window to babysit and no pressure to keep typing. Even when you take a break, your train continues steadily toward its destination. Turn typing into travel Your keyboard is the throttle. Typing accelerates your train up to the speed its engine can handle, while lighter days become slower, more leisurely journeys. Send your train on a trip, get back to whatever you were doing, and glance down occasionally to watch it pass through rolling hills, farms, forests, wildflower fields, and small country stations. Build your perfect train Collect a growing roster of lovingly hand-drawn locomotives and rolling stock. Combine engines with coal hoppers, oil tankers, log cars, passenger coaches, livestock cars, and more. Every engine has its own balance of speed and hauling capacity. Start with a modest locomotive and a single car, then work your way toward faster engines and long, impressive consists stretching across your desktop. Plan profitable routes Each town produces different goods, and every market values cargo differently. Load up where supplies are plentiful, deliver them where demand is high, and plan routes that keep every leg of the journey profitable. The right destination can turn an ordinary shipment into a valuable haul—but repeatedly flooding the same market will reduce its value. Expand your railway, explore new destinations, and build a trade network that crosses the country. Grow your railway empire Complete trips, sell cargo, and reinvest your earnings in: • New steam engines • More cargo and passenger cars • Longer, higher-capacity trains • Station upgrades • New routes and destinations Progress at the pace of your own workday. A busy afternoon might send your train racing across the map, while a quiet day becomes a peaceful journey through the countryside. A companion, not a distraction Keypress Express is designed to remain ambient and unobtrusive. It fades out of the way when you move your mouse over it and can be hidden whenever you need a completely clear desktop. There are no timers demanding your attention, no punishments for stepping away, and no window constantly fighting for focus. Just the quiet satisfaction of watching your railway grow alongside the work you were already doing. Private by design Keypress Express counts how many keys you press—never which keys you press. Your words are never read or recorded. The game does not collect the contents of anything you type. Free to play Every destination, engine, and part of the core progression can be unlocked through play. Optional purchases can accelerate upgrades, but they are never required to build your railway empire.

title: Boring Car Stories - Maghrebine des transports et logistique
shortDescription: A driving game focused on driving slow cars fast. The UI is minimal, the drives are long, indications are sparse. No car in the game has more than 200hp. Half of them don’t even have 100hp. Yet very few games will let you feel this engaged driving something this slow. READ DESCRIPTION BEFORE BUYING
fullDescription: The slow car fast driving game you didn't know you needed. It appears that the game experience does not match the expectation of quite a bit of people. Here's a small guide to help you decide if this is for you or not.  PLEASE DO NOT BUY THIS GAME IF : You don't like long drives (every mission is at the very least a 20 minute drive) You don't like a sparse UI/you need the game to tell you where you are and what to do constantly. The sparse UI and very little direction are there on purpose. You don't get a speedometer, you don't get a map, and aside from direction arrows and invisible walls to prevent you from going the wrong way, you don't get much else. Even if the UI gets redesigned at some point, it will STILL BE PARSE.  You can't keep your wheels on the road or you crash frequently. The offroad driving sucks and the collision physics are BASIC. You're not supposed to drive offroad or crash.  You don't like empty worlds. The screenshots are taken in-game. WHAT YOU SEE IS WHAT YOU GET. You expect 8k textures and high visual fidelity. Again, look at the screenshots.  WHAT YOU SEE IS WHAT YOU GET. (on the upside, this game runs at 80+fps on a GTX 1650...) You don't like the old school "start with the boring parts" progression. You can grab a game guide in our ig bio if you really wanna skip to the "good" parts. But this game is about driving slow cars fast, so if you don't like the first missions, the game is probably not for you. PLEASE DO NOT BUY IT YOU WILL END UP UNHAPPY.  You don't like bumpy roads. This game is set in the 80s in north africa. The roads are only gonna get WORSE with future updates Expect the game to be retail ready. The core gameplay is there. But do no expect a polished experience (if you could message us on instagram with the bugs you find we'll be very grateful) Overall, this is a game for people who really like driving (preferably with a ffb wheel) above everything else, are bored by high powered cars on pristine roads , and appreciate having a story to go with their drive. If this doesn't sound like you, DO NOT BUY THE GAME . Now back to the regular description :  If you're bored by cars with a gazillion horsepower, by roads that are too wide, if you're disappointed by how much less fun the sub 300hp car is in game compared to real life, this is the game for you.  Step in the shoes of Yassine, a 20 something guy learning to be an adult in the 80's in the Maghreb region. Hired at a company called Maghrebine des Transports et Logistique, Yassine starts as a delivery guy then becomes a rep man, driving all kinds of vehicles on all kinds of roads at all kinds of speeds.  What to expect 80s cars with varying layouts (FF, FR, RR) and engines (diesel, petrol, NA, turbo, 4 to 6 cylinders), hovering between 80hp and 180hp, manual transmission and absolutely no electronics Roads and environments inspired by the Maghreb, tailored specifically to make these low powered cars fun Plausible, responsive and fun physics (Simcade leaning towards sim) Force feedback support, (tested and feels great on the Logitech G923, Fanatec CSL 8N.m, Moza R12, Simucube 20N.m, ...) Traffic cars with a personality.  AI cars in some stages Story driven gameplay Optimized game. Runs well on lower end PCs  Best enjoyed with a force feedback wheel, still fun with a controller. Playable with a keyboard if you insist.  This game is not for you if :  You only care about supercars/hypercars You care about top speed/measuring speed in general more than driving feel You only care about track driving, hotlapping, ... You care about extreme realism (LIDAR track scans, super accurate suspension geometry, reproduction of real life), AAA visual fidelity, basically any extreme attention to detail that would require a AA or AAA team but doesn't necessarily add to the fun.  If this is you, we might have a game for you in the future, but it's definitely not this one.  Inversely, This game is for you if :  You prefer driving slow cars fast You prefer accurate road widths You like driving in traffic You don't like electronics in cars (Stability control, Traction control, ...) You don't care about AAA visual fidelity  About Boring Car Stories The founding belief of Boring Car Stories is that our day to day driving experiences are the most fun ones. The focus is not on hypercars and on speed, but rather on somewhat regular cars doing irregular driving. If you're familiar with the term "slow car fast", then you know what we're on about.  In most games, cars under 300hp feel unjustly slow. We think it's mostly due to the approach these games have taken. Hypercars are the most marketable, so the games have to make them the main event, which means they have to be playable by anybody.  This leads to roads that are too wide, cars that are overly stable, sound that’s too boring, all for the sake of being able to drive the halo car at its top speed of 300+kph without crashing every 5 seconds.  And while this is great for casual gamers, this leaves everybody else alienated, as it makes every other car feel mind-numbingly slow. It also leads to some cars never being featured in games even though they’re an amazing experience in real life.  Slow cars aren't fast in real life either, but they still feel fast and fun for a couple of reasons. We're aiming to reproduce that.

fullDescription: Vilmonic is a living virtual world . Your goal is to bring life back from the brink of extinction. Protect and breed unique pixel-art life forms whose pixels and color have meaning. Experiment with natural and artificial selection. Craft tools, construct buildings and change the environment. Uncover the secrets of the past as you dig up ancient tech and fend off the mindless haywire zombitons. Don't be fooled by the SUPER CUTE look, Vilmonic is a deep and complex ARTIFICIAL LIFE SIMULATOR! Evolving genetic code generates each creature's pixel-art body. The shape, or morphology, of each animatroid or fungol is determined by its genes. Genes control the bending of internal bones or branches . Pixels cover the bones to create the shape of the body. The shape of the body and the number of different pixels determine the physiology of the life form. Pixels and body shape determine biological function: hydration, nutrient use, movement, perception... Each life form has a metabolism that processes hydration and nutrients at a rate determined by the metabo gene. The larger the life form (the more pixels in its body), the more hydration and nutrients it will need each metabolic cycle. Surface area determines how much hydration each life form evaporates. The more wrinkled the body is, the more surface area there is. Simple graph-shaped brains create emergent behavior: fear, aggression, attraction... A simple set of rules, derived from genes, controls the behavior of each animatroid. Animatroids have external sensors ( motion/scent/water ) and internal sensors ( hunger/stress/thirst ). Animatroids' brains have attraction/repulsion relationships between these sensors. It is these relationships that determine each animatroid's behavior. Natural selection and breeding are the only way to evolve your life forms - unless you "cheat" with genetic engineering! Your animatroids and fungols will evolve over many generations into new species. The genetic code of each life form is passed down to its offspring during reproduction, with a chance of mutation. Evolution is a slow process. To speed things up, try crafting and drinking a lot of sugary beverages. Toxic waste can also be useful (and dangerous!) It can cause drastic mutations in offspring. Export your creatures and share them with friends! fig. 1 Exported Creature Cards, don't edit that genetic code!

title: cyubeVR
shortDescription: Immerse yourself in a voxel game exclusively designed for VR. A beautiful infinite procedural world. Explore, gather resources, craft with your hands in 3D, and build anything you can imagine. Featuring great VR controls, near-infinite view distance, Steam Workshop mod support, and much more!
fullDescription: cyubeVR (pronounced Cube VR ) is a virtual reality voxel game fully designed for VR. The world in cyubeVR is entirely procedurally generated. Enter a seed or let the game generate one for you, and explore a unique and detailed infinite world that no one ever saw before. Find your way through complex cave networks going deep into the ground, climb up huge hills to get a great view over the world or try to build yourself a way up to massive floating islands. All of that fully optimized for VR to get you the most immersive experience possible. There are no limits how far you can travel – your unique world is infinite in size. Gather resources in the world and use those to build anything you have in mind. Allow your creativity and imagination to run free. Design a fortress on top of a mountain, construct a bridge to connect two floating islands or dig yourself deep into the ground and work on complex underground structures. Experience a building system exclusively optimized for roomscale VR in a way that was never seen before. You can even move blocks after you have placed them! Thanks to roomscale VR, even have a good conscience for the workout you did while you can marvel your new creations. In VR there is no need for any UI, menus or buttons for crafting. Just use your hands and naturally craft tools and other items directly in the world. A FEW SPECIAL FEATURES WORTH MENTIONING: Gravity Gloves! You never have to bend down or move much to reach items or tools - you can easily grab anything using gravity gloves: Dynamic Weather! The weather dynamically and smoothly changes between sunny, rain, and snow. And cyubeVR probably has the best-looking snow of all existing VR games! Great building controls, designed from the ground up for VR! You can mine, collect and charge magic crystals to conveniently place up to 9 blocks at once. Full finger tracking on the controllers that support it (Valve Index Controllers), and the closest possible approximation on other controllers (Touch Controllers, Vive Controllers) The game automatically detects which controller you are using and adjusts the controls to optimally work with your controller , and automatically shows you the tutorial fitting for your exact controller - currently, the game has 4 different control schemes, individually designed for: HTC Vive Controllers Valve Index Controllers Oculus Touch Controllers (Rift, Rift S, Quest, Quest 2) Windows Mixed Reality Controllers Use either Smooth Locomotion or Teleport, depending on what you prefer. For the locomotion, you can choose between controller-oriented and head-oriented Smooth Locomotion. For turning, you can choose between snap turning and smooth turning. Snap turning offers options for either 22.5° steps or 45° steps, while smooth turning allows you to freely adjust the turn speed with a slider. Dynamic Picture Frames that allow you to import any custom PNG/JPG files from your PC and display them in fully resizable and movable picture frames that you can decorate the wall of your virtual house with: Dual Wielding with all tools! Twice as fast, and twice the fun. There's an awesome furnace in the game, fully controlled with realistic VR mechanics! No UI interaction. Put combustible items into the lower chamber of the furnace, place items to melt in the upper chamber of the furnace, use flintstones to realistically generate sparks that light up the fire, and watch it operate! You can easily collect items into your inventory using the awesome vacuum bucket that can be enhanced further with magic crystals for an even stronger effect! Blue crystal energy makes the bucket suck, red crystal energy makes the bucket blow. Use sunlight to charge a crystal blue, or use moonlight to charge a crystal red.

title: True Mining Simulator
shortDescription: No more cubes
fullDescription: True Mining Simulator will teach you to mine. We’re not talking copper, iron or coal. We’re talking money. Real money, made straight out of nowh… out of electricity. You will like it. What do you even mean? Cryptocurrency . Cryptocurrency is the kind of currency that exists only in the digital realm, arousing controversies around it and is constantly on a drastic rise (or fall). You’ve heard all about it. Everybody’s heard about it, yet few know what’s what. Basically that’s the reason we are making this game. True Mining Simulator is a full fletched simulator of a miner. A miner is a person who mines cryptocurrency . Miners purchase video cards, assemble stands and use those to earn valuable coins, which they then sell. Or keep them, hoping to get a better exchange rate. This is what you are going to be doing. Buy hardware, farm coins, sell coins, buy more hardware. And that’s it? Doesn’t look too … Ain’t it too simple? Oh yeah? Think about this for a moment: hardware must at least pay off; it must not become outdated while being delivered; 8 graphics cards in one stand must not overheat; these stands must be assembled properly; you must choose you farming station correctly, and there are plenty to choose from; if you spend all your money on hardware, what are you going to eat? Basically, this is the reason we are making this game. Mining is like chess: simple on the outside, complicated on the inside. And we suggest you figure out all mining intricacies on your own, without having to buy 10 video cards, $500 each. Okay, what else do you have in the simulator? Everything you need for a full immersion: farms must be assembled with your own hands; hunger (must eat); you have a unique chance to forget your wallet password and lose everything. And our plans for upcoming updates included: day\night cycles, respective division of events; fatigue (must rest); ability to get employed (trust us, you will need it); you can move to a more spacious place, if you wish to do so … and if you can afford it; you can be burglarized, your house can burn down (nice, right?); Sounds interesting! When will the game be out? As soon as possible. The game is in its active development stage. You can facilitate the process by supporting us. Follow us, read, discuss and stay tuned for updates.

title: Void Bastards
shortDescription: Inspired by BioShock and System Shock 2, Void Bastards is a revolutionary new strategy-shooter that will test your wits as well as exercise your aim. Can you lead the misfit prisoners of the Void Ark through the derelict spaceships and myriad dangers of the Sargasso Nebula?
fullDescription: Forget everything you know about first-person shooters: Void Bastards asks you to take charge, not just point your gun and fire. Your task is to lead the rag-tag Void Bastards out of the Sargasso Nebula. You make the decisions: where to go, what to do and who to fight. And then you must carry out that strategy in the face of strange and terrible enemies. On board derelict spaceships you’ll plan your mission, taking note of the ship layout, what hazards and enemies you might encounter and what terminals and other ship systems you can use to your advantage.. Move carefully through the dangerous ships, searching for supplies and manipulating control systems. React to what you find - will you detour to the generator to bring the power back online or will you fight your way into the security module to disable the ship’s defenses? Choose carefully when to fight, when to run and when just to be a bastard. Use your hard won supplies to improvise tools and weapons, from the distracting robo-kitty to the horribly unstable clusterflak. Navigate your tiny escape pod through the vast nebula. Flee from void whales and pirates, and politely avoid the hungry hermits. All the while you must keep scavenging for the food, fuel, and other resources that keep you alive. Void Bastards features a 12-15 hour campaign that you can complete with an endless supply of prisoners, each with their own unique traits. When one dies, another steps forward to carry on the fight. Don’t worry though, as any crafting progress you’ve made is retained from one to another.

title: Nova Drift
shortDescription: Nova Drift distills the mechanical depth and strategy of an ARPG into classic arcade space combat. Control an endlessly evolving bio-mechanical ship, face legions of strange and deadly foes, and ride the wake of a dying star across the void.
fullDescription: - SURVIVE - EVOLVE - DOMINATE - Nova Drift is a 'rogue-lite' space shooter that melds a classic arcade experience with modern action-RPG elements, emphasizing build-crafting and deep customization. Your ship rapidly evolves as you defeat enemies, allowing you to take a build from inception to execution in a single, captivating game session. Build to play how you want , creating a unique build every game. Runs are quick, allowing for rapid experimentation and iteration. DEFINE YOUR BUILD, combining dozens of choices of Weapon, Shield, and Body GEAR, including: Weapon - Thermal Lance : Channel a focused lance of heat that makes targets vulnerable to further damage. Weapon - Swords : Wield a pair of monomolecular double-edged swords that parry projectiles. Shield - Warp : Teleport when your shield breaks, creating an entry and exit blast. Shield - Halo : Burn targets within your shields radius. Body - Carrier : Command a legion of Swarm Constructs. Body - Leviathan : Become an ever-growing serpent that shreds with its body. Body - Firefly : Sear targets with massive thrusters. Unlock an arsenal of over 200 MODULAR UPGRADES: Transform your build, choosing from dozens of SUPER MODS: Charged Mines : Your mines charge, unleashing your weapon on detonation. Dying Star : Take constant damage, but burn nearby targets based on proximity and how damaged you are. Barrage : Transform any weapon into a bullet hose. Singular Strike : Fuse all of your projectiles into one giant projectile. Ataraxia : Gain powerful passive buffs for each unspent upgrade point. Antimatter Rounds : Your weapon can punch through hostile projectiles. Void Slice : Teleport, slicing through anything in your path. Warp Strike : Your projectiles can screen-wrap. Sanctuary : Convert your shield into a massive roving bubble and gain power while within it. Enjoy varied GAME MODES: Endless : Find out just how far you can push your build after victory. Draft : Jump deep into enemy territory with a pre-constructed build. Wild Metamorphosis : Enjoy a challenging "rogue-like" experience that offers powerful, transformative mods. Unlock MODULAR CHALLENGE MODES as your skills grow. Greater risk means greater rewards! EXAMPLE BUILD - Celestial Striker: This unconventional build defeats enemies by slamming right through them, detonating its shields, and burning anything nearby. Hullbreaker is the cornerstone of our build, fast, resilient, and able to deal massive crash damage based on its velocity. Amp Shield increases our velocity and damage, which results in massive crash damage. Volatile Shields ensures that when our Amp Shield breaks on impact, nearby enemies receive a devastating explosion. Flash Shielding lets us get our shield back quickly. Celestial Lance converts our speed into a burning aura, letting us crowd control as we soar. Celestial Surge lets us convert our aura into a massive burning projectile on demand, igniting anything in its path. Nova Drift is a decade-long labor of love developed by Jeffrey Nielson ( Chimeric ) in collaboration with its community, featuring music and audio by Miles Tilmann ( Pixeljam ).

title: Tormentum II
shortDescription: Wake up inside the nightmare world you created in this standalone, hand-drawn dark fantasy point-and-click adventure with psychological horror elements. Explore islands, solve puzzles, and make morally ambiguous choices that lead to multiple endings. Inspired by H.R. Giger and Zdzisław Beksiński.
fullDescription: Tormentum II is a dark, surreal point-and-click adventure with elements of psychological horror. Explore a hand-drawn world, solve puzzles, and make morally ambiguous choices that shape the fates of the characters you meet. It tells a new, standalone story, so no knowledge of the original game is required. A world you created. A prison you don't remember. You play as David, who is building a simulation populated by beings capable of human-level thought. Every night, he dreams of a locked chest and hears a woman's voice calling to him. When an anonymous seller offers him a mysterious coprocessor, parts of the dream begin to surface while he is awake. David installs the new hardware. He wakes in a prison on an island surrounded by open sea. Somehow, he is inside his own simulation. David remembers little about how he arrived. He soon discovers that his creation contains layers he never designed and has a will he cannot control. The inhabitants speak of gods, beings that come from distant places and disappear just as suddenly. To find a way home, David must cross the islands, explore the unfamiliar layers of his creation, and discover why it no longer obeys him. Explore each location at your own pace. Conversations and puzzles gradually reveal more about the simulation. Your choices shape the fates of the characters David meets. There is rarely an obvious right answer, and your decisions lead to multiple endings. Key features Point-and-click exploration and puzzles across multiple surreal islands. Choices with consequences that shape the fates of the characters you meet and lead to multiple endings. 200 hand-drawn scenes. Dedicated close-ups bring the total to nearly 500 individual background images, roughly three times as many as in the original game. Surreal art inspired by H. R. Giger's biomechanical forms and the desolate worlds painted by Zdzisław Beksiński. 6 to 9 hours of gameplay , depending on your pace. A dark, atmospheric soundtrack with occasional heavier passages influenced by metal. A complete, standalone story. No knowledge of the original game is required. About the team We spent almost eight years making Tormentum II . The core development team consists of two people: Piotr Ruszkowski and Łukasz Rutkowski, both of whom helped create the original Tormentum: Dark Sorrow.

ENJOY THIS ADVENTURE WITH FRIENDS Up to 4 players can experience the adventure together! Player 1 can use either keyboard/mouse or a controller. Each co-op player requires the use of a controller. (any kind supported: Xbox, PS4, PS5...) They can: Participate in fights Gain experience and level up Examine the surroundings Collect hidden "shadow ads" Buy food and hints React with sounds and emojis 6 playable characters Online co-op supported through Steam Remote Play Together (only one copy of the game needed) ACCESSIBILITY BROK is the first full-fledged adventure game to be fully playable by blind or visually impaired players! Fully narrated via quality text-to-speech and audiodescriptions (characters, locations and scenes.) Puzzles adapted for blindness. All puzzles and fights can be skipped. Adapted tutorials. Buttons to repeat the last voice speech and instructions. Positional audio for fights. (on Windows) No online connectivity required (after the download). No specific device required: play with keyboard or a controller. Additional options: larger fonts and increased contrast (backgrounds and enemies.) To enter the accessibility menu, press SPACE (or X on a Xbox controller) on the title screen, then follow the audio instructions. For best audio prompts, choose your type of controller in the options. IMPORTANT: Accessibility speeches are only available in English. However, a new option has been added to the Windows version to play speeches in other languages: Enable "clipboard narration" at the bottom of the accessibility menu. All the text will be sent to the clipboard. Install a text-to-speech software on your computer such as NVDA with a "Clipboard Reader" plugin. Languages supported: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French (the other languages are partially supported) More information and plugin download on our website, accessibility menu button. title: The Sapling
shortDescription: The Sapling is a short simulation game where you design your own plants and animals, and put them in a world together. Or you turn on random mutations, and see what evolution does to your ecosystem!
fullDescription: Design algae and plants Whether you want a small flower that glows in the dark, black algae specialized for planets without a lot of sunlight, or a forest of giant trees covered in spikes, it's up to you. Design aquatic, land and flying animals Want a brightly colored fish that drags itself onto land to hide its eggs in burrows? Or perhaps a land animal that gives birth to live young and quickly runs from flower to flower to drink nectar? Or what about a flying carnivore specialized for diving and catching its prey underwater? Again, it's up to you. Scenarios: learn the simulation step by step While the simulation in this game can be deep and complex, it's introduced to the player step by step; it never becomes overwhelming. Each scenario tasks you to build an ecosystem that meets specific requirements, and introduces a small number of new concepts. Sandbox: build your own planet The sandbox offers the same functionality as the scenarios (but, obviously, with everything unlocked), but also much more: play with the procedural planet generator to get the exact planet you want, whether it's a desert world, an underwater world, or whatever you come up with. It even allows you to define up to 8 seasons to spice that ecosystem up a little. While playing, you can continue to change things: the next ice age is always only a few clicks away. Turn on random mutations and see what evolution does with your ecosystem The most exciting feature of the sandbox, at least according to solo dev Wessel Stoop, is random mutations . See your algae, plants and animals evolve to quickly fill available niches, see how some species are outcompeted immediately while others bloom for thousands of years... only to die out when their food source evolves a new trick to escape, and a completely different clade jumps in the now vacant niche.

title: Maiden and Spell
shortDescription: Maiden & Spell is a magical girl battle game, set in a cutesy fantasy world. Select from one of eight young ladies to battle 1 on 1 with a friend, or fight your way through a series of bosses and learn the secrets of The Kingdom of Stars.
fullDescription: Maiden & Spell is a one-on-one magical girl aerial projectile battler, featuring a colorful cast of ladies fighting with fantastic spells. Battling with magic is simple! Fire your spells, hit your opponent, and don't get hit yourself! Each maiden is color-coded and has a set of abilities unique to them, activated at a press of a button. There aren't any complicated combos or intricate inputs or grabs or melee attacks or block buttons! Just a 3-pixels-wide hitbox, a lot of shiny bullets, and your own dodging skills. title: RealFlight Trainer Edition
shortDescription: RealFlight Trainer Edition is the perfect way to learn radio control flying on your PC. fullDescription: Start your RC journey with RealFlight Trainer Edition Learn to fly with the #1 radio-control flight simulation brand in the world. RealFlight Trainer Edition is powered by the industry-leading RealPhysics™ engine, and designed by both full-scale and RC pilots. This unmatched realism makes RealFlight an essential tool for any new RC pilots learning to fly. Hone your skills in RealFlight's True-to-Life digital environment so you can pilot your physical models safely with confidence and style! Beginner Airplanes and Helicopters Included RealFlight Trainer Edition contains 8 essential trainer aircraft from Horizon Hobby. The flight characteristics are meticulously reproduced, and electronic assistance like SAFE, AS3X, and more are included on the simulated airplanes. Practice in the simulator and you’ll be ready to solo the real thing in no time. Aircraft included: Blade 230 S V2 Blade 330 S E-flite Apprentice STS 1.5m E-flite Habu STS 70mm EDF HobbyZone Aeroscout S HobbyZone Apprentice STOL S 700mm HobbyZone Carbon Cub S+ 1.3m HobbyZone Sport Cub S Unlock Additional Content for Free Gain experience in the form of flight time and RealFlight Trainer Edition will reward you with additional aircraft and airports--for free!  The unlockable aircraft are all "Next Step" models, perfect for beginner pilots who have learned to fly with trainer planes/helis and are ready to graduate to their next aircraft.  The unlockable airports broaden the range of available environments, including an indoor setting and a float flying site. Log 2 hours of flight time to earn the following: Aircraft Blade 150 S Blade Eclipse 360 E-flite Conscendo Evolution 1.5m E-flite Night Radian 2.0m E-flite Slow Ultra Stick 1.2m E-flite T-28 Trojan 1.1m E-flite UMX Conscendo E-flite UMX Radian E-flite UMX Slow Ultra Stick Airports Alpine Meadow Athletic Club Log 4 hours of flight time to earn the following: Aircraft Blade Fusion 360 E-flite Commander mPd 1.4m E-flite Habu SS 50mm EDF E-flite Habu SS 70mm EDF E-flite T-28 Trojan 1.2m E-flite Turbo Timber Evolution 1.5m E-flite UMX Timber X E-flite UMX Turbo Timber Evolution E-flite Valiant 1.3m Airports Alpine Lake Soccer Field Fly at Eli Field and Carl Henson Field Eli Field is a well-equipped flying field in Monticello, IL. It’s the home flying field for Horizon Hobby, and many of the aircraft in this title were developed there! With side-by-side paved and grass runways, and plenty of open space, it’s the perfect place to learn to fly. Carl Henson Field in Eugene, OR is home to the Eugene R/C Aeronauts flying club.  Its well-maintained grounds feature a lush grass runway surface that any golf course would envy.  This wide-open locale is another great place for beginners to build their skills. Learn from Experienced RC Pilots RealFlight's training modules help take the mystery out of flying model aircraft. An experienced pilot talks you through the use of flight assistance features and gives you the knowledge you need to succeed. Upgrade to RealFlight Evolution When you are ready for over 300 more aircraft, more than 75 flying sites, and other features like custom content and the full suite of Challenges, you can upgrade to RealFlight Evolution. A discount is available on the RealFlight Evolution store page. Controller Required RealFlight requires a controller to run and supports a large number of options: Option 1 (Recommended): For the best experience, we strongly recommend the Spektrum™ InterLink® DX simulator controller. It is specially designed for RealFlight and all your controls will come pre-configured by default. Option 2: Use your own RC Radio with an interface. The Spektrum WS2000 wireless dongle works well for this, and there are other 3rd-party wireless interfaces available.  (Requires additional user setup.) Option 3: Use your own RC Radio connected directly via USB.  This transmitter feature is becoming more commonplace.  (Requires additional user setup.) Option 4: Use any 4-axis game controller such as a gamepad or an advanced flight stick. (Requires additional user setup.) *Note: See the Announcements and Community Discussion for purchase links.
