Vs Multiplayer - Take control of the Insurgency to try and topple the government in your opponent’s Region, whilst trying to stabilise your own! Dynamically scaling difficulty ensures that players of different skill levels can have a good, challenging game. Co-Op Multiplayer - Work together to simultaneously stabilise two separate Regions, sending soldiers and resources to your partner to achieve your goals. Or jump into a Co-Op Campaign of escalating difficulty. Challenge Mode - Compete against the Steam Community on randomised Weekly Challenges, including an extra hard mode for the best of the best. Custom Scenarios & Scenario Creator - Explore a world of fresh new ways to play with official and community created Scenarios, or develop your own share them with other players via Steam Workshop. Who said Nation Building was hard? Advanced civilian and military AI - Sophisticated narrative algorithms model the needs of local populations, while deadly insurgent attacks put constant pressure on your operation. Gorgeous Graphics - Stabilise a beautifully rendered 3D world that responds to your actions and thrives as you provide jobs and services. Drone cams and civilian TV channels bring your operation to life and show you what's happening on the ground. Rebel Inc: Escalation builds on the original critically acclaimed gameplay of Rebel Inc. with multiple significant, all-new features, enhanced music, improved 3D graphics for PC/Mac, online multiplayer and steam workshop support. An important note: Although a fictional game, Rebel Inc. looks at important real world issues and we have made every effort to deal with them sensitively. The game has been extensively researched and has been developed in cooperation with leading regional politicians, business people and journalists as well as international charities, experts and governments.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Kinstrife
shortDescription: Medieval strategy RPG with revolutionary physically simulated combat. Become a wandering knight, journeying to castles and towns in your quest for fortune & glory, fighting in battles & tournaments. Build your wealth, equipment & following - and carve out your destiny in a time of strife!
fullDescription: Kinstrife is a non-linear singleplayer medieval RPG with physically simulated combat – become a knight errant in tumultuous 13th-century Germany! Journey through immersive landscapes filled with castles, monasteries, villages and forests. Travel with your sword at your side and your trusted retinue behind you, as you build up your skill, renown and wealth. Fight your way through realistic medieval battles, duels and sieges, rise up among the lords of the land and take part in tournaments to win fame and riches. Our cutting-edge physically simulated combat system makes the impact of each swing count – weapons don’t simply clip through but instead deliver staggering blows, characters fall when losing their balance and horse charges knock down your opponents. Feel like you’re wielding a sword yourself, mastering your moves with various historical weapons: Each attack, feint or parry creates unique, interesting, natural situations – rewarding experimentation, different playstyles and replayability. Key FeaturesNonlinear open world: Immerse yourself into an atmospheric medieval world as you freely roam between unique historical locations. Physically simulated combat: Become a master at the sword with cutting-edge physics animations, delivering unique impacts with each strike. Squire to knight: Create and train your own knight with skills and unique traits tailored to your play style. Prepare for battle with the finest arms, armors and garments of the time. Writing history: Gain influence through battles, chivalry and strategic finesse, while building and leading a loyal retinue of supporters. BackgroundTransport yourself to 13th-century Germany during the turbulent period of the Great Interregnum. Amidst the power struggles among great houses vying for the imperial throne, the land is plagued by banditry and lawlessness. The Rhine, a crucial artery for commerce and travel, falls victim to a higher class of brigand - the Raubritter (robber barons). Exploiting their positions for wealth and power, they impose back-breaking tolls and engage in kidnapping to ransom those who dare traverse their territories. To whom will you pledge your sword? Who will you welcome into your ascent to power, and who will dare to stand in your way?
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Falling Frontier
shortDescription: Conquer a vast procedurally generated star system in Falling Frontier, a sci-fi RTS where intel and logistics are decisive factors. Design ships and raid enemy supply lines, lay minefields and construct recon stations, and ambush enemy forces within asteroid fields and nebulae.
fullDescription: Falling Frontier is a revolutionary sci-fi RTS where ship design, recon, and logistics are critical elements. Your expeditionary force has just completed construction of its first space port in orbit of a new world, but you are not alone. Rivals from the old colonial wars between Earth, Titan, Venus, and the other lineages that divide humankind have also arrived in the same star system. A New Star SystemExplore a vast procedurally generated star system filled with planets, moons, asteroid fields, and nebulae. Build and upgrade shipyards, supply depots, refineries, and recon stations as you research new technologies to unlock ship hulls, weapons, orbital facilities, colonization options, and more. CombatBattles in Falling Frontier combine intuitive control with deep mechanics. Shots can strike unintended targets after missing or ricocheting off hulls and each ship has subsystems that can be damaged or destroyed upon impact. Smaller, more maneuverable craft can defeat much larger vessels through ambush or tactical superiority. LogisticsWars are won or lost through logistics. A weaker opponent can choose to engage in guerrilla warfare, raiding supply depots and refineries, blockading colonies, and otherwise attacking each point in the enemy supply chain. Likewise, a stronger force cannot simply combine their ships into a single massive and unstoppable fleet and must instead strategically distribute smaller defense flotillas throughout their territory. IntelUse probes, scout ships, and recon stations to explore and monitor the vast emptiness between planets. Recon stations scan defined angles with either passive scans that grant limited information or active scans that give away their position. Similarly, the enemy will continuously search for your forces, and you may hide your ships behind moons or mask their heat signatures near gas giants. DesignFalling Frontier incorporates over 20 different ship types, including frigates, destroyers, cruisers, and battlecruisers, alongside an array of civilian ships. You may create your own designs and choose weapons, utility modules, and other components to best serve your strategic needs. CrewYour command crews are not abstract and impersonal entities, but rather named individuals with ranks, portraits, and identities. Each officer has their own traits and abilities, making personnel choice a critical factor in efficient flotilla composition. Enemy officers not killed in action can be captured and interrogated, or left in their escape pods as bait in order to ambush any rescue ships. ModsFalling Frontier supports modding through an in-game scenario editor that allows players to design and share their own star systems, missions, and storyline campaigns.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Bosslords
shortDescription: Gather an army of monsters and misfits to march on the Imperial Capital in this fantasy roguelite auto battler. Explore procedurally generated worlds filled with powerful weapons and artifacts as you gather new recruits to take to battle and show them who's boss!
fullDescription: The Empire has reigned uncontested for far too long and ruined the world under its banner! Tranquil woodlands? Babbling brooks? The constant sounds of laughing babies and loving families? The world is truly the worst it has ever been! Bosslord, this tyranny must come to an end, and your monstrous crew of miscreants is just the group to make that happen! Bosslords is a roguelite auto battler where you lead the hardworking lowlifes and scoundrels of the world – command goblins and ghouls, raise the dead, and traverse across land, sea, and air to take on the Empire as it sends armies to hunt you down. Take charge as one of several bosslords, each with their own storyline, abilities, and upgrade trees that will shape your runs alongside unique starting armies and spells. While each is able to recruit a wide range of units and employ varied strategies, they all have their own advantages, preferences, and unique mechanics: The Goblin General relies on mass numbers of well-trained goblins, able to turn the typically-weak minions into a disciplined mass of hardened troops The Undead Necromancer can bring an elite guard that recovers after every battle, even if destroyed, using enhanced necromancy to summon and empower additional warriors The Warlord brings a small but elite force of veterans, making up for their lack of numbers with heightened stats The Mage is a master of summoning creatures into battle, with more powerful spells and elementals to support him on his warpath The Dragon Tamer commands an army of lizardmen, ready to be trained into hardened warriors – or fed to his pet dragon to make her stronger as she consumes all Despite your glorious purpose and unbeatable zeal, you’re nothing without your army. The inns and shops of the realm are full of would-be revolutionaries just waiting for the right person (and the right amount of coin), and you can even find lost souls wandering the lands in search of glory. Orc Drummers in your midst will hasten the attack speed of your units, while Banshees will paralyze enemies, and zombie banner-bearers will bolster allied health. Will you rely on a formation of skeleton bodyguards firing their rifles from the back lines as your spiders slow the enemy down with their webs? Or will your army be known for its dagger-wielding rogues and hulking Minotaurs supported by Goblin Sergeants that bolster their attack? What kind of bosslord would you be if you didn’t have a few tricks up your sleeve? From the Goblin General’s Flintlock Pistol to the Necromancer’s curse that turns enemies into allied skeleton warriors, unique abilities set each bosslord apart! Gather scrolls on your journey and unlock powerful spells that aid your minions in combat – raise walls of fire, harness the power of lightning, summon a meteor from the skies above, or cause the ground itself to crack open with earthquakes! Further empower your troops with special items – a Potion of Regeneration can keep a formation alive in dire straits, while a healthy serving of Slime Jam will turn fallen allies into slime monsters! Whether you’re coating weapons in poison or cursing enemies’ souls, it sure is good to be bad.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Junxions
shortDescription: Answer your true calling as a traffic engineer in Junxions! Featuring comprehensive simulation, construction, and management tools, use careful planning to build roadways, railways, and walkways, and the complex interactions between them.
fullDescription: Take on the challenge of traffic management with the comprehensive simulation and management systems of Junxions, where you’ll finally be able to solve the problem of gridlock once and for all. Devise interchanges unlike anything the world has ever seen, leveraging and working around the constraints of real traffic laws and systems to meet the demands of metropolitan municipalities. Build utopias of smoothly flowing roundabouts and bypasses, or employ the classic method of simply adding more lanes – the choice is yours! From single lane one-ways to six-lane monstrosities to dedicated bus lanes, bike lanes, and tram tracks, Junxions will present a multitude of options – it's up to you to decide how they come together. Plan routes around existing structures, relying on tunnels and bridges as necessary, plotting paths from where people are coming to wherever it is they need to go. Establish rules for intersections, determining not just the phases of individual traffic lights (if any are present in the first place), but also designating lanes for specific purposes as you see fit and introducing limitations as needed. Establish rights of way, create pedestrian islands and medians, and even place street lamps, railings, noise-cancelling barriers, and additional decorative elements to bring your spaces to life. A unique set of tools are at your disposal, purpose-built to allow for the fine-tuning of every aspect of your roads and the intersections between them. The game's challenge mode takes you from handcrafted map to handcrafted map with different pre-existing conditions, roads, and traffic problems to solve. Plot out your roads to maintain a consistent flow of traffic, prevent gridlock, and ensure average speeds are kept above a certain minimum, all while maintaining a reasonable budget. As the challenges go on, you'll take on the difficulties presented by additional vehicle types as they share the road with each other and pedestrians, introducing the need for more and more complex solutions to meet the demands of commuters. In sandbox mode, meanwhile, you can either build from the ground up to experiment on completely blank maps, or you can explore real-world challenges! Do you live in a city with terrible gridlock? Is there a specific intersection that you just know you'd do a better job designing? Simply provide coordinates to import any real-world location from around the globe and get to solving the local traffic issues. Start with a clean slate to establish new roads, introducing new dedicated lanes, or simplifying needlessly complicated intersections. Recreate existing roads as they are to then see how incremental adjustments can improve or degrade the flow of traffic in unexpected ways. Reinvent iconic junctions to see how they change the face of familiar cities – how does the Arc de Triomphe look without its famous roundabout? Can Shibuya function as a turbo roundabout with pedestrian bridges instead? Can LA traffic actually be fixed? Age-old problems often call for creative new solutions! With access to individual pathing tools for roads, tracks, pedestrian walkways, and bus lanes, you can choose to refine the familiar, or experiment with a multitude of non-conventional approaches to find revolutionary new solutions instead – who says pedestrian walkways don’t belong between two sets of train tracks? The intersection algorithm in Junxions will adapt to your intentions as you specify each intersection’s size, type, and exact placement – push the boundaries of traffic engineering as you seek the slightest increases in throughput. Junxions will launch with full support for modding – build maps to challenge other members of the community, share your traffic solutions to see if others can further refine them, and even import custom models into the game to add real-world vehicles and props to your maps. If you've ever wanted to dive deep into the world of traffic engineering, Junxions is the perfect opportunity to do so without the distraction of zoning laws and citizen satisfaction. Design solutions to complex problems, stress test them using advanced traffic simulations, and refine them to perfection for your own satisfaction.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Capital Command
shortDescription: Take the helm of a state-of-the-art warship as you fight epic space battles in a sandbox campaign. Upgrade and customize your ship, master the art of maneuvering, and use a blend of tactical prowess and heavy firepower to overcome deadly threats.
fullDescription: Capital Command is a space-sim that puts you in charge of a powerful capital ship doing battle in the far reaches of space. The AI in charge of local defense has gone rogue, and at this distant frontier outpost, you're the only chance of restoring order. Your crew follows your every command as you give orders to navigators, gunners, repair teams, and engineers, directing a large, cumbersome ship equipped with an expansive arsenal. Face the unique challenge of conflict in space - where threats can come from all sides and split-second judgments can be the difference between victory and defeat. Ships move realistically, and whether you automate navigation or adjust your thrust vectors manually, you'll both fight against and embrace inertia in the vacuum of space. Six degrees of freedom means you can move in all directions at any time, adjusting pitch, roll, and yaw as you try to find your targets while dodging their attacks. Spot your enemies from hundreds of kilometers away and plan your approach vector to isolate and outmaneuver them. Adjust your angles to make sure the right weapons can hit the right targets. Position your point defense turrets to lay down a protective screen against incoming missiles, while your own missiles and solid projectile salvos return fire. A capital ship like yours is kitted out with cutting-edge technology to spot, destroy, and defend against the enemy. From solid projectile artillery to missile pods and point defense turrets, you have many weapons – each with their own strengths and weaknesses. Damage control teams work constantly to repair damage to the ship, but your orders can prioritize bringing specific equipment back online to match current needs. Use salvaged resources and scrap from engagements to repair and upgrade your vessel, or commandeer an enemy capital ship entirely, adapting to its loadout and capabilities. You arrive at an outpost in a remote corner of space – shortly after, disaster strikes. An AI combat fleet has gone rogue, and it's up to you to assess and neutralize the threat. Procedurally generated campaigns will constantly challenge you with an ever-present and imminent threat, as well as present new opportunities to acquire resources and equipment. Make strategic decisions on which targets to engage, and how best to use the spoils of war. Acquire and use intel to overcome the enemy, tracking hyperspace jumps and choosing whether to evade or engage, all while keeping an eye on fuel reserves to ensure you're not caught out of position in the dark void of space. With a massive arsenal at your disposal, your command of the ship will need to adapt across multiple playthroughs to the options and challenges each campaign presents – no single playthrough will show you everything the universe has to offer. Test your skills and train against 13 AI ship classes in custom battles, honing your command ability for campaign mode, where any misstep could result in the loss of a sector. Capital Command will challenge you to think two steps ahead of your enemy – you'll be constantly outnumbered and the use of clever battle tactics is essential to your survival. As captain of a capital ship, you are responsible for both a formidable weapon and the countless lives aboard.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: The Way of Wrath
shortDescription: Forge your path as a Bronze Age tribal chieftain in this epic strategy RPG. Lead your tribe in a fight for survival against all odds as the elements, time, and a relentless foe seek to wipe your people out.
fullDescription: Your people have tasted defeat, and should you fail now, they will meet complete annihilation. In 10 days the enemy will be at your gates, and in this frozen valley, you must make your last stand. As Warchief, your people turn to you for guidance. Has your past prepared you for such a monumental task? Will your skills keep your people alive? Choose from one of five distinct origins that change how others in the world see and treat you. Explore each origin in depth through your dreams, and learn more about yourself as time goes on. Use a freeform progression system to become who you need to be in order to succeed. Classless skill progression keeps your options open as the situation evolves, allowing you to adapt and overcome the challenges you face in a variety of ways. Take control of your tribe beyond yourself — choose where to gather resources, determine which risks are worth taking, and prepare for the inevitable assault. Tackle disputes amongst your people — make rulings and enact laws, but be wary of the precedents you set. The tribe will act according to your laws, often leading to unforeseen consequences. Should you choose to break precedent to protect your closest friends, the tribe may take notice of your corruption. Your deeds and misdeeds will determine your reputation amongst your people. This will, in turn, impact how people treat you and what options are available to you. A Warchief known as "The Truthful" will be easily trusted, while being known as "The Terrible" gives you power over the weak-willed. The frozen valley is untamed and dangerous — the ground itself threatens to swallow you into an icy grave, and all manner of beast seeks to kill you. If you survive the predators, the cold, and the hunger, you only have the enemy horde to fear. Gather resources and make goods with your own two hands, or employ the skills of your allies. Build weapons and structures, fabricate clothes and tools, and take what you can from the land to survive. Learn to navigate treacherous terrain as great frozen lakes crack under your feet, and as the world itself gives you clues to its many dangers. Hunt for food using techniques of the Neolithic era — set traps, bait animals, and prepare ambushes for the more terrifying quarry. Use your skills to detect tracks and plan accordingly to ensure your success. There is little glory in being gored by a beast, and even less in dying of starvation. Craft sturdy clothes and huddle by the fire for warmth, or mix herbs and poultices to survive the sickness and injuries that await you in your struggle. Running across the freezing mountains in light garb will bring a quick end to your story, and maladies such as snow blindness and hypothermia are a constant threat. Your enemy is the predator, you are the prey. An animal caught in a trap, facing death. What will you do to survive? Battles are fought in your choice of real-time with pause or turn-based tactical combat. Your party will use a variety of tools and skills to overcome the enemy in lethal hand-crafted battles where the AI will take every advantage it can. Battles are difficult, equipment can be damaged when used, wounds can take many days to heal, and allies can die. Craft weapons, bombs, and traps not just to hunt for food, but to hunt your enemy as well. Flammable oils, poisons, choking clouds, and other insidious inventions can turn the tide of battle. Use superstition to gain an upper hand over your enemy — the curse of a shaman or dark portents can break your foe's spirit before you meet in battle, making your task far easier than it would otherwise have been. Take advantage of friction amongst your rivals — opportunities arise at every turn to cause dissonance and wreak havoc. Prepare for every encounter to give yourself the upper hand. Scout enemy positions and determine how best to approach them. Attack enemy camps or opt to bait your opponents out of a favorable position and into an ambush. With just 10 days to prepare, you need to establish your defenses and weaken your enemy as best you can before their final assault. You are not the only one with a story to tell — each character has a past, a future, and relationships which they care for. Death and struggle will take its toll not just on you, but the entirety of the tribe. Each individual character has their own branching stories, friend or foe. They pursue their own ambitions while living their own lives, and your existence intertwines with theirs. There are no generic NPCs — everybody is somebody, and each loss is keenly felt and mourned. Every action has consequences, and individual opinions are taken into account. Your reputation, your actions, and your decisions in conversation will compare against each individual character's own belief systems, and your stories together will evolve over the 10 days leading up to the assault. A fully fleshed out world with great tales to discover await you — the tribes, their cultures, their castes, and more will invite you to play multiple times, seeking out all the answers hidden across the land. The Way of Wrath is a world inspired by the true histories and superstitions of the past alike. The tale of desperate struggle against insurmountable odds is one as old as time — will your story end in glory, or defeat?
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Hero's Hour 2
shortDescription: Build grand cities, raise mighty armies, and fight massive battles to vanquish your foes in this turn-based strategy RPG auto battler. Powerful heroes at the head of unique factions bring endless possibilities as they lead armies of the dead, the living, and everything in between.
fullDescription: Knights in shining armor trample reanimated corpses as enraged minotaurs roar and charge through the fiery breath of a flock of fearsome dragons – this is Hero’s Hour 2, a turn-based strategy RPG auto battler where grand empires clash across procedurally generated maps, and where battles rely on powerful combinations of units and spells working in harmony. Take charge of your warriors, arm your heroes with powerful equipment, explore worlds of surprising synergies, and crush your foes as they seek to do the same in single and multiplayer clashes for power. Disparate factions fight for supremacy in the world of Hero’s Hour 2, each bringing their own strengths to bear, each able to develop in distinct ways to match your playstyle and preferences. Will you take charge of the forces of the Crown, with their gallant knights and soaring dragons? Or do you prefer worldly priests over flying beasts? Or perhaps you would rather lead one of the Crypt factions, raising the dead to fight alongside fell beasts, spreading death and decay through the lands? Whether you choose to lead a righteous force, beings of pure evil, forest creatures, or other mysterious monsters, each faction will feature unique heroes, units, buildings, and skills to ensure they play differently, presenting varied opportunities to use to your advantage. Those that find powerful and creative synergies will always reign above all! Violence is the supreme authority in this world, and as you spread your influence through conquest across a realm of unpredictable twists and turns, you’ll gain access to more powerful options to achieve strategic dominance. Conquer cities and make them your own, building varied structures to recruit a wide array of troops or to further strengthen those that already march under your banner. Capture mines, lumber yards, and other strategic points of interest to build the strong economic foundation upon which your empire stands, seizing them out from under your enemies to prevent them from doing the same. Stumble upon unique opportunities that can completely alter your path to power, and seek out artifacts that further strengthen your most powerful soldiers. From start to finish, strategic choice and alternatives dominate – will you sacrifice your weakest units to the Volcanic Cult you happened upon, taking their offer to raise Demons to fight in your service? Or perhaps you prefer to avoid such temptations, and instead seek devastating spells and upgrades that make even a lowly militiaman more powerful than anything the Cult could offer you? Each faction is home to multiple powerful heroes of varying classes, each with their own strengths, weaknesses, and unique skill trees, and each able to turn the tide of battle when properly utilized. Recruit these mighty characters to lead your armies in glorious combat, equipping them with devastating weapons, enchanted armors, and mysterious trinkets that work together to empower your battlefield strategies and overcome even the most seemingly insurmountable challenge. Will you enhance their ability to fight in hand-to-hand combat with Dragonform, momentarily transforming them into powerful Dragons as they engage in melee, opt to devour your own units to grow stronger, or focus on the hexing skills that allow you to turn even the strongest opponent into buckets of frogs? Build powerful empires in the fantastical world of Hero’s Hour 2 and experience turn-based strategic nation-building blended with RPG and auto battling mechanics. Whether you’re playing alone or with friends, prepare for endless replayability as you lead armies of Vampires, Liches, Gryphons, Skeletons, and strange never-before-seen creatures, spread across multiple factions with mighty heroes wielding powerful artifacts. Overcome your adversaries by any means necessary and reign supreme over all!
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Substructure
shortDescription: Harness the power of automation in this factory game set on a rogue planet in the far reaches of the solar system. Dig down and explore the depths of an alien world, exploit its resources across complex production chains, and travel towards the core to uncover its deepest secrets.
fullDescription: An interstellar body detected on a collision course with our solar system inspires equal parts fear and curiosity – could this rogue planet threaten our fragile home, or does it offer some great, unknown opportunity? Establish complex automated factories and production facilities on the lush surface of an alien world as you delve below its surface in search of answers as part of a hastily-prepared expeditionary mission. Work alone or with friends in multiplayer as you build within intricate caverns and take advantage of the strange and unfamiliar resources hidden beneath the surface – industrialize the very depths of this world to uncover its secrets, awakening dangerous threats and encountering inexplicable phenomena along the way. Despite its location far beyond the habitable zone, lush green fields dominate the planet and present unexpected agricultural opportunities to pair with your industrial capabilities. Will you seek the delicate but sometimes inefficient balance between fields and factories, or will the fires of industry burn this world in the interests of your expedition? Starting with individually planted seeds to power your first combustion generators, developing towards drone-operated megafarms that sustain entire sections of your mission, agriculture isn’t just a stepping stone in the world of Substructure, but a vital process that enables your manufacturing and research capabilities. Seek out new raw materials that can be processed and combined to manufacture advanced equipment and increase your efficiency as you journey towards the planet core. Whether you’re pulling water out of the air to produce nitrogen and lubricants or assembling logic units needed for the advanced logistic mechanisms that optimize your throughput, increasingly complex production chains drive your journey forward. A surface-level expedition will only ever grant you surface-level answers. To truly understand the situation at hand, you must dig deeper. Build massive platforms to transport yourself, materials, and entire production chains between the cavernous layers beneath the planet's surface, revealing new biomes and the resources, opportunities, and threats they bring with them. Optimizing your production will require you to analyze and fine-tune not just each individual layer, but the interactions between them as well. Take on the monumental task of digging through layers of the planet and build programmable platforms that transport raw materials, processed goods, and factory infrastructure. Drilling through subsequent layers will introduce new challenges to overcome in the dark underbelly of this mysterious world – you’ll need to manufacture additional tools to pierce through increasingly complex layers while accounting for limited space and light. Though many resources on this alien planet show familiar properties, others will require ingenuity to harness – from rocks that are impossible to mine when in direct sunlight to plants that only grow underground and materials that are easier to process closer to the planet’s core, you’ll need to take into consideration humidity, heat, light, and more. Improvement and complexity doesn’t just flow in one direction – as you uncover more resources below the planet’s surface, doubling back to use them in the layers above might further improve your efficiency or open new opportunities. From catalysts to research units to more advanced sources of fuel and power, there’s plenty to discover beneath the surface. You need not journey alone – Substructure has been built with multiplayer integrated from its inception! Whether you prefer to play solo or with dozens of friends, you can easily host new or existing saves to go from one mode of play to another. Built from the ground up with modding in mind, you can use basic script edits to rebalance the game or add new resources, buildings, and recipes, or tap into a simple art pipeline to add new visuals as well. Substructure makes it easy to customize your experience and share it with the world!
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Darkwood 2
shortDescription: Roam freely around the scorched deserts of a dying sea as you secure resources and explore the mysteries of Darkwood. But beware nightfall – seek shelter, shore up your defenses, and pray for the morning light as the horrors of the world hunt the ill-prepared.
fullDescription: Set merely a few years after the events of the critically acclaimed survival horror game Darkwood, the sequel brings with it new lands and waters to explore, new creatures to fear, and new reasons to pray for the morning light. Featuring an entirely new story and new characters, the unfolding events of Darkwood 2 stand on their own, and can be equally enjoyed regardless of whether you’ve played the first game in the series. In the aftermath of the Soviet Union's collapse, the dying Aral Sea has become the site of an anomaly – an eerie forest that swallows everything in its path. No one knows where it came from, or why – retribution, perhaps, for humanity’s abuse of nature. All around lie the ruins of a vanished world – deserted villages, rusting ships marooned in sand, derelict oil rigs, power stations, and factories on the verge of collapse. A secret biological lab sits in silence on a remote island as roving gangs of looters, bikers, and former soldiers control the remaining population through fear. Nomads travel through these lands with no rest or respite, day or night – even walls can't guarantee safety. As the world loses its humanity, and as the so-called corruption of the forest spreads, one can't help but wonder – is it really better to remain human? Or would it be best to give in? Only the heart of the forest holds the answer. Darkwood 2 sends you on dangerous meandering paths across barren deserts, through thick marsh, and on deep waters alike. As the locals fight to keep the slowly spreading woods at bay, you must rely on your wits to overcome your fears and find your way – there are no quest markers or waypoints to guide you. Scavenge for resources, craft weapons to protect yourself, and seek out shelter by night, building barricades and traps to hide behind, securing yourself against an enemy that can strike from any direction. Will you cower in a cellar as the doors creak open and close a few floors above you, or will you stand against the horrors that stalk the night? Or perhaps you'll choose to rely on strange concoctions to gain new skills and capabilities that may just keep you alive – in a manner of speaking. Meet twisted characters, each with their own motivations – learn their dark backstories and make decisions that will determine their fates and impact the world itself, changing your story as you move through it.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Rogue Carrier
shortDescription: Lead a perilous expedition to study the mysteries of a sentient world in this roguelite colony management game. Build and manage a city atop an ocean-faring ship, and try to survive as the planet fights back!
fullDescription: Travel the vast oceans of an alien planet in this roguelite colony management game where you must build and thrive aboard a massive ocean-faring ship. Stranded on an unknown world, you must seek essential resources to power vital production chains, manage crew morale and needs as you build your mobile colony, and defend yourself against all manner of existential threats in your quest for answers. Rogue Carrier puts you in charge of an interstellar expedition gone wrong. As the sentient planet reacts to your presence, will you secure a path to escape the world? Or does your fate rest at the bottom of its endless oceans, taking your experience forward into future attempts? Your primary objective on arrival was to explore the surface of this distant planet and analyze its anomalies to see what scientific secrets they might unlock – the objectives remain the same despite the catastrophic loss of your mothership, but their ultimate purpose has changed from understanding to survival. Travel across the expansive ocean world and navigate treacherous waters as you seek vital resources and information that can help you survive and escape, building and sending out freighters and recon craft to explore the islands, cities, and points of interest that dot the planet. Progress through objectives and side-quests to unlock technological advances that in turn enable you to achieve additional objectives, but be careful of the choices you make along the way. Your decisions determine what options become available to you when engaging with the world, what buildings and production chains you’ll be able to establish, and how smoothly your expedition progresses for any given run. Learn as much as you can about the planet before it overwhelms and destroys you, engaging with unique narrative events and interacting with indigenous species to unlock information and progression that can aid in future runs. As your R&D labs find ways to exploit the local environment, you’ll periodically be presented with choices of technological advances, each unlocking new buildings that tap into or provide additional resources for your expedition and its crew. Solar panels and the batteries that power your infrastructure, farms that produce various kinds of food, housing for your crew, and factories that manufacture construction material, mining tools, defensive equipment and more – there are over 80 building options that can influence your run in various ways. Unlock unique combinations and opportunities under the right circumstances, taking advantage of adjacency bonuses as you work with limited space and challenging layouts. Establish production chains with interchangeable resources that best suit what you’re able to find and acquire, all while carefully managing the various needs of your people and the ship alike, from food and entertainment to power for various essential components. Space is limited on the ship, forcing you to choose between available options, and improper planning can lead to more precarious layouts – as the ocean responds to your presence, an imbalanced ship will capsize more readily, and without redundancies, you might find yourself powerless or otherwise incapacitated after a particularly vicious attack. Experiment with unique combinations of buildings, layouts, and resources to unlock powerful synergies and secure your future. Your presence on the planet, and the very actions you must take to keep the expedition alive, will inevitably draw attention. The planet is a living thing, and your disruptions will cause it to fight back, responding with everything at its disposal from inclement weather that can capsize your ship to deadly wildlife that can tear it apart. The more you damage the local ecosystem, the more dangers you will face – will you pursue clean energy and reduced waste output to prolong each run at the cost of slow progress? Or will you embrace polluting the world and going to war with the planet in order to progress more quickly, arming yourself against the trouble that may bring, and hoping to survive? Develop powerful weapons to defend yourself against increasingly dangerous threats as a run goes on, relying on a combination of evasive actions, devastating firepower, and strategic prowess to stay alive. From giant aquatic beasts that close the gap to ram and rip apart your hull to landbound creatures that strike from afar, you’ll need to prepare for a variety of threats as you make progress on your expedition. The destruction of your ship is not the end of your journey – the efforts and learnings of one run can be used to make progress across others. Explore multiple timelines, unlocking variations within each, and face the unique challenges and opportunities each one provides. Uncover the mysteries of your oceanic prison across five potential endings and fifty scenarios and variants – your journey exists across multiple parallel universes, each different in many ways, though all providing insight into the mysterious planet, its inhabitants, and the system within which it exists. — Take on the challenge of managing an expedition through treacherous waters, and face the wrath of a planet that responds to your every move as you seek answers to questions unknown.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: C-Beams
shortDescription: Pilot your ship through a perilous black hole system in this Space Action RPG. Engage in advanced ship combat, haul rare elements, and upgrade your vessel to survive. Stunning visuals, a deep narrative, and a rewarding progression system await as you uncover the abyss's dark secrets.
fullDescription: C-Beams is a top-down space action RPG where you pilot your ship through a perilous black hole system. Navigate treacherous anomalies, engage in intense ship-to-ship combat, and upgrade your vessel to face ever-greater challenges. In the future, humanity has begun reaching out into the stars. The discovery of a new black hole system has sparked a gold rush, drawing corporations and daring pilots eager to claim its riches. Those brave enough to face hazardous anomalies and hostile competitors can amass great fortunes by extracting rare, never-before-seen elements. As a new pilot with nothing to lose, you'll decide how to carve your legacy in this unforgiving frontier. Pilot a variety of ships, each featuring highly realistic handling characteristics. Engage retro burns to decelerate rapidly, cut your engines to drift silently through space, and master maneuvering thrusters to evade enemy fire. Docking at space stations or derelict ships is a skillful art. The better you become at piloting, the faster you'll complete missions and earn rewards. However, overloading your cargo hold will increase your ship's mass, making it sluggish and harder to maneuver. Keep an eye on your fuel reserves—running out of boost fuel at the wrong moment could be the difference between victory and defeat. Tear enemy ships apart in chaotic close-range firefights using rapid-fire gatling turrets and recoilless cannons, or pick them off from a distance with guided missiles, railguns, and powerful C-Beams. Sub-system targeting allows you to disable engines, weapons, or radar for a tactical edge. The approach you take in combat is entirely up to you. Asteroids can serve as cover from incoming fire or as strategic ambush points. Stealth upgrades open up opportunities for surprise attacks or avoiding unnecessary confrontations. Destroyed ships drop valuable cargo and components. Disable a vessel, dock with it, and raid its cargo hold for even greater rewards. Traverse a vast network of jump points connecting asteroid fields, space stations, planets, moons, and nebulas. While local station contracts provide clear objectives, wandering into uncharted space may yield even greater rewards. Space-time anomalies offer both danger and opportunity—they can tear your ship apart, but with the right tools, they can also yield rare elements worth a fortune. Derelict ships, smuggler caches, and hidden mysteries await those bold enough to seek them out. In C-Beams, fortune favors the brave. Upgrade your ship with enhanced firepower, cargo capacity, engine performance, and unique strategic or combat abilities. Ship components can be looted, purchased from vendors, or earned through missions. Acquiring larger, more advanced ships will expand your capabilities, but specialized vessels may still be essential for certain tasks. Your hangar will serve as your base of operations, storing your ships and equipment. Build your skills, gain reputation with various factions, and hunt for rare items to unlock deeper layers of the universe in C-Beams. Whether you're a fearless explorer, a cunning trader, or a ruthless combat pilot, your journey is yours to define.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Architect of Ruin
shortDescription: Architect of Ruin is a completely hand drawn sword and sorcery colony simulation game. Farm, hunt, build, and survive as you rebuild an ancient temple under the gaze of a vengeful god.
fullDescription: Architect of Ruin is a completely hand drawn sword and sorcery colony simulation game. Farm, hunt, build, and survive as you rebuild an ancient temple under the gaze of a vengeful god. The old temple lies in ruins, its power dormant, its faithful scattered. As the new master of these broken halls, guide a growing cult against adversity and meddling heroes. Balance resource management, construction, and survival to the glory of dark gods. Untomb forbidden knowledge, perform sinister rituals, and rebuild a long-forgotten sanctuary one blood-soaked stone at a time. Thus does the age of darkness begin. A thriving cult demands more than faith: it needs foundations. Lead your followers to construct a formidable base, complete with farms, ritual chambers, and defensive fortifications. Irascible sorcerers and unstable zealots make for poor tools, bend their volatile natures to your will and forge them into instruments of domination. Every structure serves a purpose and every follower, a role in your dark vision. Your enemies are many: righteous paladins, rival cults, and the occasional angry mob. Meet them with steel, sorcery, and an army of reanimated thralls. Each battle tests your growing cult against those who would see your temple remain in ruins. Every fallen hero becomes a new resource to harvest.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Drill Keeper
shortDescription: Roguelike deckbuilding meets siege defense as you travel the galaxy and dig through fully destructible worlds to strip them of their riches, defending against relentless hordes of aliens as you build impenetrable fortresses of mining.
fullDescription: Play as a heroic Drill Keeper in this deckbuilding roguelike siege defense game where you travel the galaxy in an effort to secure vital resources for your people. As a dutiful symbol of the future, you will be tasked with protecting your Planetary Drill – build fortresses around your mining operations to protect it from the dangers that lurk in the depths of distant planets, designing labyrinthine pathways and traps to stall and bewilder the enemy. And if a sense of duty isn’t enough of a motivator, you should know that your parent corporation has installed a neural implant that will kill you should your Drill be destroyed – it’s expensive equipment, after all! Join the Orion Prospectors Team today! Does the vast expanse of the galaxy call to you? Do you want to work with state of the art drilling technology? Have you dreamt of strip-mining entire planets to their core while building massive defensive fortifications to hold back and gun-down alien attackers? Then you’ll dig this gig! Each planet you visit on a run will feature unique challenges and opportunities every time, with a variety of possible objectives to keep you on your toes, unlocking new cards and planets as you complete them. Occasional supply drops will assist your operation by providing additional resources, including rare artifacts, and even more cards for your ongoing run. Procedurally generated dig sites are influenced by unique planetary modifiers – at times you’ll find yourself fortunate enough to be surrounded by bountiful treasures and easily removed brittle walls with only a distant enemy spawning pool, while at others, the riches may be distant, and the enemy right by your side. Surrounded by resources, enemy spawning pools, and unique points of interest, you will always have a fresh set of considerations to build your mining strategy around. Every tile around you can be destroyed, either in a calculated manner when digging in pursuit of gold, shards, and mysterious treasures, or by environmental effects that may inadvertently help or hinder your position. Manually digging between drill activations takes stamina, and pushing yourself too hard will invite negative consequences. This means the need for a carefully planned approach as digging is not only the primary source of resources with which to play your cards, but a powerful tool for defense as well. Every time you activate your drill, the mindless enemy swarm responds with ruthless aggression, moving along a predictable path – the shortest available from where they spawn to your drill. Influence this path by placing obstructions and digging alternative routes shaped in your favor – will you build long narrow corridors and place defensive buildings that fire piercing shots in straight lines, or pursue zig-zagging paths to maximize enemy travel time instead? Different weapons at your disposal behave in completely different ways, and while anyone can find synergies among the cards in their deck, a true Drill Keeper will pair those synergies with the perfect dig strategy. Make your mark as one of the greatest Drill Keepers ever known – will you be heralded across the galaxy as a master of magic? Or will they speak of your uncanny luck? Perhaps yours is a legend of loot and plunder, known to have a drill adorned with artifacts and runes of great power? Every famed Drill Keeper has their own calling card – choose yours today! Cards are the core tool in your hand, available for use between and during attacks, used to place and upgrade individual buildings, to apply status effects to the enemy, and to enhance your own capabilities. You will begin each run with a small starting deck, and while you can grow this deck with additional cards acquired through periodic supply drops and treasures found while digging during an ongoing run, completing objectives on a planet will unlock cards as new options for the starting deck of future runs. This can fundamentally change your overall strategy. Will you focus on buffing your own abilities, using magic to dig and defend more efficiently? Will you prioritize barricades that influence enemy movement to funnel them into killboxes? Or will you squeeze every possible ounce of damage output out of your deck, combining status effects and defensive buildings to overcome the vast hordes? Prioritize your current expedition by focusing on the acquisition of gold needed to activate cards, or plan for the future with a focus on acquiring shards and the runes they allow you to purchase and use in future expeditions. Bolster your economic capabilities, improve your damage output and attack speeds, or otherwise sway luck itself in your favor with the help of these magical attachments, and bring a variety of runes together to create powerful combinations and unique strategies, with upgrades available to make them even more powerful. Seek out artifacts buried deep within the planets and use their unique offerings to further bolster your expeditions – from modifying the outcome of familiar actions to providing buffs and debuffs, artifacts are another piece of the puzzle as you seek synergies and opportunities in what they have to offer. As an equal opportunity employer, all are welcome as Drill Keepers – all it takes is a passion for digging, and the courage to stand against unfathomable horrors! Be warned that not all Drill Keepers live to see retirement – becoming a master of this craft is a perilous path, but at its end lies glory, and the knowledge that you’ve helped a megacorporation grow stronger, wealthier, and wiser! What greater honor is there? Apply now! Choose from one of multiple hero archetypes, each with their own unique artifacts and special abilities they can use to aid their expeditions in various ways – adjust your strategy to match your archetype, or choose one that matches your style. Heroes belong to one of many factions, each offering entirely unique experiences at the dig site, introducing different equipment, alternate strategies, and entirely new types of resources and considerations – from classic spike traps and stone walls to towers that decay over time, using their own biomass to do battle. Drill Keeper is a roguelike siege defense game set in the far future, putting you in charge of mining expeditions across the galaxy. Build powerful synergies in your deck as it grows over the course of a run, optimize your dig strategy to acquire resources for immediate and future use, and experiment with a multitude of heroes and factions, each featuring their own unique strengths, weaknesses, and strategic considerations.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Vaunted
shortDescription: The score of a lifetime hangs in the balance – can three cut-throat criminals look past their differences to pull it off? A story of bullets, bravado, and brazen lies unfolds across a galaxy of treasure hunters and crime syndicates in this sci-fi tactical RPG.
fullDescription: A millennium since the fall of the last galactic empire, chaos reigns supreme. Mercenaries and treasure hunters vie for priceless imperial relics, exploring far-flung ancient ruins and battling ruthless rivals, monstrous aliens, and giant robots in search for the ultimate score. When three mismatched scoundrels return empty-handed from a disastrous expedition, the powerful syndicate that funded them demands answers. Vaunted is a tactical RPG with explosive action and dynamic combat where turn-based planning is paired with real-time action that opens up unique opportunities. Leap into cover on your turn to dodge enemy counterattacks, set overwatch angles to return the favor as your foes scramble into position, or send enemies flying through the air with the help of a well-placed grenade to riddle them with bullets before they hit the ground. It all begins with your capture at the hands of a benefactor who has come to collect, curious about the missing return on his investment, and looking for answers with the help of his armed thugs. Tell the story of an expedition gone horribly wrong with the help of three extremely unreliable narrators, where every exposed lie and half-truth opens up new branches, allowing you to switch between their perspectives for wildly different outcomes with every new run: Dyse is an incorrigible liar, thief, and con artist with a list of enemies too long to count. An excellent flanker, a mastermind at finding loot, and quick to make friends with Scientists and Outsiders, Dyse always finds the shortest path to the richest treasure. Gendril is a tough-talking mercenary with deep underworld contacts and the arsenal to take on any foe. A battle-scarred Fighter and consummate Professional, he knows that, in this business, violence is usually the answer. Kyvaath is a powerful young warlock, and the last of her kind. Hailing from a destroyed world, and empowered by cybernetic enhancements, she wields a kind of magic not seen for a millennium. Utterly ruthless and driven equally by ambition and vengeance, she views others as a means to an end. With their backs against a wall, three ruthless scoundrels will say whatever it takes to make it out with their lives – even if it means betrayal. You’ll have to work together with a ship full of criminals, mercenaries, and bounty hunters in a desperate bid for survival. Explore their backstories to see how their paths crossed with your intrepid anti-heroes, kit them out with powerful class-based equipment ranging from sentry turrets and jetpacks to sniper rifles and handguns, and build relationships and reputations that might just make the difference between life and death. Assemble the right party for the task at hand as you tackle a variety of missions and watch as each of your heroes and companions levels up and improves their capabilities individually, falling behind or bounding ahead based on how well they do in combat. Create diverse builds, explore powerful upgrades, and develop unique synergies between the characters at play with every re-telling of the tale. All three heroes have their own version of events, and though the story continues when companions die, the death of your heroes gives you a chance to rewrite the current chapter from a different perspective. Each brings a different set of circumstances and opportunities for unique conversations alongside new loot, skills, and secrets across the multitude of procedurally generated and hand-crafted missions. Will you power through an ambush in Dyse’s telling of the tale, putting your tactical prowess to the test, or will you stick with Gendril’s version where the trap is never sprung, and you’re able to pick the very same ambushers off from a safe distance instead? Every conversation you have, and every decision you make – and who you make it as – can change how things play out, for better or for worse. Even in death, some things carry over – each of your heroes starts to build a reputation based on the decisions they make, potentially impacting future interactions and unlocking new opportunities. What’s more – your story starts to gain credibility as you progress through it, and with each death, you can spend this credibility to unlock new advantages offered by each of the three heroes. Pack more grenades, keep your guns operational for longer, exploit status effects beyond the usual, and generally bolster your capabilities to make friends, and dispatch enemies. Whether you’re dealing with the Syndicate, other treasure-hunters, mysterious alien lifeforms, or giant flamethrower-wielding robots, violence is the likely answer to most of your problems, and Vaunted’s blend of turn-based tactics and dynamic, real-time action ensures you’ve always got options when the bullets start to fly and you find yourself dodging counter-attacks on your turn as you scramble for cover, look down your sights, and take down your foes. Respond to enemy actions in kind, baiting them into traps and reacting to evolving situations to keep your squad alive. With no initiative orders to worry about, you’re always in control of who goes when, alternating activations with the enemy to go back and forth until the shooting stops. Use the environment to your advantage, not just as cover, but as a weapon in its own right, and as a way to hide and sneak around the battlefield to set up flanking maneuvers and surprise attacks. Make careful use of special abilities, grenades, and even powerful spells as you run, jump, and duck for cover. Pinpoint enemy weaknesses and leverage the ability to aim freely to take them down efficiently and keep the story going. — Vaunted takes the high-intensity action of a third-person shooter and blends it with the calculated tension of a high-stakes turn-based tactical RPG, all while putting you in charge of three extremely unreliable storytellers in the middle of an expedition that went horribly wrong.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Gilded Destiny
shortDescription: Forge empires, incite revolutions, and reshape society in Gilded Destiny, the definitive grand strategy game of the Industrial Age. Take command of your chosen nation and lead it to glory through masterful diplomacy, sweeping industrialization, and decisive warfare.
fullDescription: Forge empires, incite revolutions, and reshape society in Gilded Destiny, the definitive grand strategy game of the Industrial Age. Take command of your chosen nation and lead it to glory through masterful diplomacy, sweeping industrialization, and decisive warfare. THE GLOBE, REIMAGINED Experience our world as it was from the Nineteenth to the early Twentieth Century, hand-crafted from over a million hexes that reflect real-world biomes and terrain types. This is not a flat map; it is a globe where countries are shown true to scale, tactical positioning shapes your every move, and global strategy takes on an entirely new meaning. Terrain and environment directly influence your military campaigns and industrial expansion. Place cities, buildings, and railways directly on the map as you industrialize your country. Full world editing and modding tools included on release, empowering you to reshape history or create entirely new scenarios — whether alt-history or fantasy. MASTER THE ART OF WAR Take direct command of your armies in a deep military simulation that rewards careful planning, smart composition, and efficient logistics. Control units individually or automate them to focus on grand strategy while retaining tactical power. Customize your armies, manage vital supply lines, and secure critical transport hubs to sustain your war efforts. Embrace the technological breakthroughs of the era and adapt your strategies as the world around you evolves. BUILD AN INDUSTRIAL EMPIRE Dominate the global economy through an intricate simulation of production and trade. Establish vast production chains, convert raw resources into finished goods, and control supply and demand on a global scale. Choose from a vast array of factories and industries, each impacting your nation’s growth and your people’s prosperity. Transform your society by introducing sweeping reforms that impact labor, healthcare, conscription, and more. Encounter dynamic events that challenge your strategy and reward your mastery with every campaign. SHAPE SOCIETY AND CULTURELead more than just armies and industries; rule over a society undergoing profound change. Influence religion, culture, migration, and assimilation as populations change and adapt to industrialization, with different groups within your society behaving in unique ways. Encourage your population to pursue new careers, turning peasants into factory workers, engineers, or soldiers. Manage your government and its policies, taking into account the interests of various historically accurate political parties. MOD, CREATE, AND EXPAND FROM DAY ONE Gilded Destiny comes with a powerful editor and full modding support, giving you the freedom to rewrite history or create your own alternate scenarios. Redraw borders, reshape landscapes, and create brand-new scenarios with intuitive world editing tools. Share and discover mods through Steam Workshop, from total overhauls to fine-tuned enhancements. Shape your world and your rules, ensuring that no two campaigns ever play the same. BRING ICONIC LEADERS TO LIFELead your nation with a roster of beautifully illustrated historical characters. Appoint leaders to political, military, and research positions, each offering unique strengths and abilities. Enjoy a vibrant art style that brings leaders and population groups to life, making every decision feel personal and significant. Use the editor to create new characters that can be added directly into the game.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Beyond These Stars
shortDescription: Build a city on the back of a Space Whale and learn to coexist as you journey through the stars. Manage intricate supply chains and the needs of your people as you build outposts, meet aliens, and uncover the mysteries of the universe.
fullDescription: Recovering from uncertain times, your Peeps find themselves on the back of Kewa - a lonely Space Whale journeying across the universe. Building a city on the back of a sentient creature comes with its own set of challenges, but as you build your relationship and travel across the galaxy, you'll come across great opportunities for exploration and stable expansion. Meet other species, pursue the needs and wants of your Peeps, and seek the truth about their ancestors and the Space Whales alike. The vastness of space is full of mysteries, and as you first arrive at your new home atop the Space Whale Kewa, your Peeps will quickly learn the need to work together – with each other, but also with their new home. A Home Among the Stars - Build a sprawling city on the back of a universe-traveling Space Whale as your Peeps seek places to live and work. Your new home is largely desolate and inhospitable when you arrive, save for a small patch of green by the water – work around the contours of the land as you plan your city, taking into account the efficiency of your production chains. Will you simply place buildings as the land allows, or will you change its very shape to take advantage of adjacency bonuses and reduced travel times? Reach Far and Wide - Terraform the land around you to better suit your needs. Create a thriving ecosystem by digging canals and adding top soil in preparation for farming. Plant trees to maintain a steady flow of raw materials, and maintain entire forests to help spread the atmosphere and facilitate the expansion of your city. A Fragile Equilibrium - Prepare to seek out additional resources as you research new technologies and gain access to advanced goods. Your people’s needs will grow, and complex logistics networks and mining infrastructure will follow. You must be careful not to tip the delicate balance of the ecosystem, however – the land on Kewa is fragile, and if not tended to with care, your habitat will shrink. Will you walk a fine line of sustainability by risking Kewa’s ecosystem, or will you seek opportunities to instead gather resources on other worlds to keep Kewa happy? Unveil the shared history of the galaxy as you travel from system to system with Kewa – seek answers about your past, learn about the history of the Space Whales, and understand the unique relationships that bind everyone together. Reliable Outposts - Kewa’s environment is plentiful, but not without limits – there will often be a dearth of essential resources and space, and you’ll want to ensure the environment is not over-exploited. Create outposts on nearby planets and seek out supplementary sources of what you need – but unless you build a strong relationship with Kewa, you may find it difficult to predict how long you have at an outpost before Kewa decides it's time to leave a system behind. A Travel Companion - Kewa longs for connection, and is no mere pet – your home has hopes and dreams for the journey through space. Through understanding Kewa’s needs and desires you can better build a symbiotic relationship. This will give you the opportunity to work in collaboration and allow you to decide on a path together as you journey across the universe. Friends Along the Way - On your journey, you will cross paths with alien species offering unique opportunities – additional objectives and their subsequent rewards, opportunities for trade, and new technologies with the doors they open. Balance your people’s survival, prosperity, and progress with the need to co-exist with Kewa in a journey across space. Beyond These Stars asks you to consider the logistics of your supply chains and production lines within the context of a living, breathing, sentient world.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Espiocracy
shortDescription: Espiocracy is an espionage grand strategy game where you lead the intelligence agency of one of 74 playable countries. Rewrite history from the shadows as you influence ideologies, stage coups, and wage proxy wars. Subterfuge takes center stage as you establish a new world order.
fullDescription: Take charge of the intelligence agency of your choice as the Cold War begins. Working from the shadows in this grand strategy game, you will influence the world using a variety of tools including agents, propaganda, proxy wars, assassinations, and coups. As an Iron Curtain descends across Europe, the era of the espiocrat begins. As the world recovers from the devastation of World War 2, new alliances are already being drawn. Relations have begun to deteriorate between the two superpowers, and new political ideologies have taken hold. From the division of Germany to the Italian Referendum and Czechoslovak elections, tensions are building, and your agency fights at the front lines of a silent war. Choose one of 74 countries and lead its intelligence agency from the start of the Cold War. Whether your chosen nation loses a war, suffers a coup, or has a change of leadership due to foreign actions, your agency remains resolute, working to further your country’s interests through the twists and turns of the 20th century and beyond. Prepare for nuclear brinkmanship, the Space Race, decolonization, and the instability and proxy wars that follow as you navigate a world balanced on a knife edge. Deploy foreign and domestic agents to manipulate public opinion, support and establish political factions, stoke the flames of independence, ignite proxy wars, and shatter the status quo with coups. Your country’s leader may request your input on major decisions such as invading a neighbor or forming an alliance, and you can use your influence to trigger wars or turn the tide of diplomatic negotiations. Target and manipulate geopolitically active individuals, organizations, and sectors. These “actors” have their own agendas and will seek to spread their ideologies and policies as they move among nations. Actors can include historically accurate individuals like celebrities, inventors, and authors, organizations like political parties, trade unions, and guerilla forces, or even entire sectors, such as a nation's military, law enforcement, or media. Actors differ in influence, competence, goals, and resources. An incompetent executive leading a nuclear power is a threat to domestic and foreign agencies alike. In an era where open conflict is constrained, military conquest is rare, and technological asymmetry is prevalent, the subtle hand of espionage takes center stage. A shift in public opinion can influence an election or create unlikely allies, while a falsified casus belli can be claimed to justify acts of aggression. Whether arming and training guerilla forces or creating disinformation to discredit influential politicians, your agency fights a shadow war. Make use of 34 different types of operations: install operatives in foreign agencies, use propaganda to spread ideologies, and perform assassinations. Hand-pick and develop your own cadre of top-level operatives. Some are more technologically inclined, while others are experts at manipulating people and their emotions. Agents act with relative autonomy based on your orders, influenced by their own traits, histories, and biases. Operatives with certain skills might present you with unique opportunities, while others might fall under the influence of illicit substances to cope with their assignments, or worse — fall under the influence of a foreign power. Operatives within your agency interact with one another and can create subgroups, potentially introducing political motivations into your agency. When these operatives retire from service they can also become influential actors outside your control. Espiocracy will see you manage operations, budgets, and staff across a variety of nations with different geopolitical and socioeconomic circumstances. Work in service of a fledgling nation, a superpower, or an independence movement, using unique capabilities, diverse tactics, and ruthless cunning to overcome adversity in a time of great technological and political change.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Fragile Existence
shortDescription: Save humanity from the brink of extinction in this sci-fi strategy game of survival. Travel among the stars to seek out resources, establish and develop colonies to sustain civilization, and grow your military might to push back against an overwhelming threat.
fullDescription: After three centuries of unhindered exploration and expansion beyond Sol, humanity has come under threat. Earth has been attacked by a fleet of unknown origin - the Near Earth Territories have been annihilated, and only a handful of ships carry what is left of the millennia-old species. With a relentless threat intent on extinguishing the flame of humanity, the various factions must set aside their old rivalries if they wish to survive The Collapse. As Fleet Commander of what remains, it falls on your shoulders to secure the future. There is no threat too great for humanity to overcome, and through grit and sheer force of will you must lead your people to survival. Scout ahead and plot a course from system to system and to points of interest in between, exploring the worlds within as you seek resources essential to your survival. Each misstep can be expensive, and one wrong move can see you enveloped by the enemy. The non-linear story campaign begins amongst the rubble of the Near Earth Territories, but leads you deep into the final frontier. The vagaries of faster than light travel are behind you - Breach Gates determine safe laneways through space, taking you to a different solar system with each breach. No two playthroughs will lead you down the same lanes, allowing you to explore alternative paths and approaches in subsequent games. Organize the fleet for optimal results - do you seek strength in numbers, or separate into smaller autonomous groups pursuing different objectives? A smaller group is less likely to survive a direct assault, but their martyrdom could keep the rest of the flotilla alive for the future. There are multiple viable ways to tackle each scenario. In the endless black of space, the potential resources at your disposal are infinite. Acquiring them, however, is not only essential, but full of danger. Each planet you come across holds potential for risk and reward alike. Your shipboard scanning systems can be used to determine the viable resources available on a planet and their exact locations, helping you choose an ideal place to make landfall. Ground expeditions are directly under your control, transporting you to the planet surface where you must lead them. Between the fleet anchored in orbit and the away teams contending with local factions, survivors, and the remains of former colonies, you will find yourself tackling a variety of complications. Traditional RTS systems such as base building and unit management on the surface introduce a completely different set of mechanics compared to your operations in space. Pacify planets, one way or another, establishing temporary settlements to mine and refine local resources into usable parts, or to seek out blueprints and samples that act as the impetus for new research and development. The survival of the fleet is paramount, but without materiel and core necessities, unlikely. Shift resources around as needed, where needed. Physicalized resources mean you won't readily have access to everything - your soldiers are defenseless without ammunition in their hands, your vehicles are immobile without fuel in their tanks, and your people will die without food on their plates. Managing resources isn't just about acquisition, but about refinement and distribution as well. Drones can only do so much - people are your most vital resource. There is nothing to be gained from an unmanned gun, a fighter craft without a pilot, or a construction project without an engineer. Ship modules need crew, science labs need scientists, and only medics can keep everyone alive and healthy. The hunt must eventually come to an end - whether by your own volition, or through the cruelty of fate, you will at times find yourself face to face with your demise. The enemy is well armed and capable - and it will stop at nothing to see humankind destroyed. From interceptors and fighter craft to capital ships and more, the threat comes in various shapes and sizes, and you will need to prepare yourself appropriately for the inevitable. Strive for technological supremacy that might help overcome the dangers posed by The Collapse. Assign scientists to blueprints and materials found on former colonies and unexplored planets in order to develop new offensive, defensive, and civilian capabilities. Prepare the right tools for the right job - old designs will be overwhelmed and outperformed should you rest on your laurels. Use a modular system to customize your ships and ground units, managing power reserves, weaponry, and space to ensure a proper balance for the task at hand. Ground and orbital combat can be both expensive and deadly, but at times, entirely necessary. Space combat typically takes place within the orbit of a planet with fleets moving along the orbital sphere, engaging each other with nimble fighter craft and hulking capital ships alike. Space stations, weapon platforms, and cunning tactics can make the difference in orbit, while ground combat relies on traditional RTS mechanics and unit archetypes, alongside base building, and resource collection. Sometimes, escape is the only option. An organized tactical retreat with a rearguard will allow you to collect your supplies and passengers and move on to another system where you can continue your progress. A full-fledged Planet Editor will give you the option to construct your own planets, where procedural generation, blended with hand-crafted placement of features, resources, and points of interest allows for a great deal of flexibility. These planets can be placed in a solar system designed through the System Editor, and your systems can be brought together using the Scenario Editor. Craft your own stories by placing enemies and building event triggers using a simple, visual, node-based system.
steamDeckNotes: Playable - May require minor controller adjustments or keyboard overlay.

title: Mars Tactics
shortDescription: The Red Planet is at war. Lead either Capital’s corporate army or Labor’s worker revolutionaries and wage war across a vast strategic map, then assume direct control in turn-based tactical battles featuring artillery, vehicles, and fully-destructible environments.
